### Task 6: Исполнитель HTTP и диспетчер шагов

Решение: `Executors.kafka` — `Option<Box<dyn StepExecutor>>`, а не `Option<KafkaExecutor>`: Task 6 компилируется до Task 7, а `KafkaExecutor` (Task 7) реализует тот же трейт и кладётся в `Box`.
Решение: схемы ответов для `expect.schema: response` передаются в `HttpExecutor::with_schemas(BTreeMap<op_id, SchemaSummary>)` (из реестра — Task 8); `new(base_url, defaults, secrets)` возвращает `Result<Self, String>` (ошибка сборки клиента).
Решение: ошибка рендера выражения на шаге (например, `{{steps.create.order_id}}` после упавшего шага при `on_fail: continue`) — `EXTRACT_MISSING` с сообщением `expression: …`; невозможность собрать запрос (плохой id операции, незаданный параметр пути, плохой заголовок) — `CONNECT` с `cannot build request: …`.
Решение: `extract` кладётся в `IterationCtx` под текущим шагом (`begin_step` зовёт планировщик), поэтому `StepOutcome` не расширяется; тело разбирается как JSON только при `Content-Type` с `json`, иначе `body: None`.

**Files:**
- Create: `crates/glafira-load-engine/src/http.rs`
- Modify: `crates/glafira-load-engine/src/{executor,lib}.rs`
- Test: `mod tests` в `http.rs` (заглушка на `axum` на свободном порту) и в `executor.rs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `glafira_load_model::schema::SchemaSummary`, `suite::{Action, HttpDefaults, HttpStep, Step}`, `suite::expr::{Context, ExprError, parse_template, render_json, render_string}`, `context::IterationCtx`, `errors::{StepCode, StepError, sample}`, `expect::check_expect`, `extract::extract_all`, `executor::{StepExecutor, StepOutcome}`.
- Produces (по шапке): `executor::Executors`, `http::HttpExecutor::new`.
- Produces (сверх шапки): `http::{parse_operation, build_path, HttpExecutor::{with_schemas, base_url}}`.

- [ ] **Step 1: `http.rs`**

```rust
//! Исполнитель HTTP-шагов на `reqwest` с `rustls` (спека L2 §5.2): пул соединений,
//! без редиректов, проверки `expect`, извлечение `extract`, примеры ошибок с маскированием.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use async_trait::async_trait;
use glafira_load_model::schema::SchemaSummary;
use glafira_load_model::suite::expr::{
    Context, ExprError, parse_template, render_json, render_string,
};
use glafira_load_model::suite::{Action, HttpDefaults, HttpStep, Step};
use percent_encoding::{AsciiSet, NON_ALPHANUMERIC, utf8_percent_encode};
use reqwest::header::{CONTENT_TYPE, HeaderMap, HeaderName, HeaderValue};
use reqwest::{Client, Method, redirect};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::context::IterationCtx;
use crate::errors::{StepCode, StepError, sample};
use crate::executor::{StepExecutor, StepOutcome};
use crate::expect::check_expect;
use crate::extract::extract_all;

/// Сегмент пути: кодируется всё, кроме unreserved RFC 3986.
const PATH_SEGMENT: &AsciiSet = &NON_ALPHANUMERIC
    .remove(b'-')
    .remove(b'.')
    .remove(b'_')
    .remove(b'~');

/// Метод и шаблон пути из id операции `http:<service>:<METHOD> <path>`.
pub fn parse_operation(id: &str) -> Option<(Method, &str)> {
    let rest = id.strip_prefix("http:")?;
    let (_service, call) = rest.split_once(':')?;
    let (method, path) = call.split_once(' ')?;
    let method = Method::from_bytes(method.as_bytes()).ok()?;
    if path.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some((method, path))
}

fn expr_error(e: ExprError) -> StepError {
    StepError::new(
        StepCode::ExtractMissing,
        format!("expression: {}", e.message),
    )
}

fn build_error(message: impl Into<String>) -> StepError {
    StepError::new(
        StepCode::Connect,
        format!("cannot build request: {}", message.into()),
    )
}

fn render_str(text: &str, ctx: &dyn Context) -> Result<String, StepError> {
    render_string(&parse_template(text).map_err(expr_error)?, ctx).map_err(expr_error)
}

/// Подставляет `{name}` шаблона пути значениями `params` (после рендера выражений),
/// кодируя их как сегмент пути.
pub fn build_path(
    template: &str,
    params: &BTreeMap<String, String>,
    ctx: &dyn Context,
) -> Result<String, StepError> {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(template.len());
    let mut rest = template;
    while let Some(start) = rest.find('{') {
        out.push_str(&rest[..start]);
        let after = &rest[start + 1..];
        let end = after
            .find('}')
            .ok_or_else(|| build_error(format!("unclosed `{{` in path `{template}`")))?;
        let name = &after[..end];
        let raw = params
            .get(name)
            .ok_or_else(|| build_error(format!("path parameter `{name}` is not set")))?;
        let value = render_str(raw, ctx)?;
        out.extend(utf8_percent_encode(&value, PATH_SEGMENT));
        rest = &after[end + 1..];
    }
    out.push_str(rest);
    Ok(out)
}

fn is_json(content_type: Option<&HeaderValue>) -> bool {
    content_type
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .is_some_and(|v| v.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("json"))
}

fn header_lines(headers: &HeaderMap) -> String {
    headers
        .iter()
        .map(|(k, v)| format!("{k}: {}", v.to_str().unwrap_or("<binary>")))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n")
}

fn map_send_error(e: reqwest::Error, timeout_ms: u64) -> StepError {
    if e.is_timeout() {
        StepError::new(StepCode::Timeout, format!("no response in {timeout_ms} ms"))
    } else if e.is_connect() {
        StepError::new(StepCode::Connect, format!("connection failed: {e}"))
    } else {
        StepError::new(StepCode::Connect, e.to_string())
    }
}

pub struct HttpExecutor {
    client: Client,
    base_url: String,
    defaults: HttpDefaults,
    secrets: Vec<String>,
    schemas: BTreeMap<String, SchemaSummary>,
}

impl HttpExecutor {
    /// `base_url` — адрес стенда (`env.http`), `secrets` — значения для маскирования.
    pub fn new(
        base_url: &str,
        defaults: &HttpDefaults,
        secrets: &[String],
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let client = Client::builder()
            .redirect(redirect::Policy::none())
            .pool_max_idle_per_host(1024)
            .tcp_keepalive(Duration::from_secs(30))
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| format!("http client: {e}"))?;
        Ok(Self {
            client,
            base_url: base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
            defaults: defaults.clone(),
            secrets: secrets.to_vec(),
            schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
        })
    }

    /// Схемы ответов операций из реестра — для `expect.schema: response`.
    pub fn with_schemas(mut self, schemas: BTreeMap<String, SchemaSummary>) -> Self {
        self.schemas = schemas;
        self
    }

    pub fn base_url(&self) -> &str {
        &self.base_url
    }

    async fn run_http(
        &self,
        step: &Step,
        http: &HttpStep,
        ctx: &mut IterationCtx<'_>,
    ) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError> {
        let (method, path_template) = parse_operation(&http.operation)
            .ok_or_else(|| build_error(format!("bad http operation id `{}`", http.operation)))?;
        let path = build_path(path_template, &http.path, ctx)?;
        let url = format!("{}{path}", self.base_url);
        let timeout_ms = http.timeout_ms.unwrap_or(self.defaults.timeout_ms);

        let mut query = Vec::with_capacity(http.query.len());
        for (k, v) in &http.query {
            query.push((k.clone(), render_str(v, ctx)?));
        }
        let mut headers = HeaderMap::new();
        for (k, v) in self.defaults.headers.iter().chain(http.headers.iter()) {
            let name = HeaderName::from_bytes(k.as_bytes())
                .map_err(|_| build_error(format!("bad header name `{k}`")))?;
            let value = HeaderValue::from_str(&render_str(v, ctx)?)
                .map_err(|_| build_error(format!("bad header value for `{k}`")))?;
            headers.insert(name, value);
        }
        let body: Option<Vec<u8>> = if let Some(json) = &http.body {
            let rendered = render_json(json, ctx).map_err(expr_error)?;
            if !headers.contains_key(CONTENT_TYPE) {
                headers.insert(CONTENT_TYPE, HeaderValue::from_static("application/json"));
            }
            Some(serde_json::to_vec(&rendered).map_err(|e| build_error(e.to_string()))?)
        } else if let Some(text) = &http.body_text {
            Some(render_str(text, ctx)?.into_bytes())
        } else {
            None
        };
        let bytes_out = body.as_ref().map(|b| b.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);

        let mut builder = self
            .client
            .request(method.clone(), &url)
            .query(&query)
            .headers(headers.clone())
            .timeout(Duration::from_millis(timeout_ms));
        if let Some(b) = &body {
            builder = builder.body(b.clone());
        }
        let request = builder.build().map_err(|e| build_error(e.to_string()))?;
        let full_url = request.url().to_string();
        let request_sample = || {
            let body_text = body
                .as_deref()
                .map(|b| String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            sample(
                &format!(
                    "{method} {full_url}\n{}\n\n{body_text}",
                    header_lines(&headers)
                ),
                &self.secrets,
            )
        };

        let started = Instant::now();
        let response = self
            .client
            .execute(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| map_send_error(e, timeout_ms))
            .map_err(|e| {
                let masked = sample(&e.message, &self.secrets);
                StepError {
                    message: masked,
                    ..e
                }
                .with_sample(Some(request_sample()), None)
            })?;
        let status = response.status().as_u16();
        let resp_headers = response.headers().clone();
        let bytes = response
            .bytes()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| map_send_error(e, timeout_ms).with_sample(Some(request_sample()), None))?;
        let latency = started.elapsed();
        let latency_us = latency.as_micros() as u64;
        let latency_ms = latency.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0;
        let bytes_in = bytes.len() as u64;
        let parsed: Option<Value> = if is_json(resp_headers.get(CONTENT_TYPE)) {
            serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).ok()
        } else {
            None
        };
        let response_sample = || {
            sample(
                &format!(
                    "{status}\n{}\n\n{}",
                    header_lines(&resp_headers),
                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes)
                ),
                &self.secrets,
            )
        };
        let with_samples =
            |e: StepError| e.with_sample(Some(request_sample()), Some(response_sample()));

        if step.expect.status.is_none() && status >= 400 {
            let code = if status >= 500 {
                StepCode::Http5xx
            } else {
                StepCode::Http4xx
            };
            return Err(with_samples(StepError::new(
                code,
                format!("status {status}"),
            )));
        }
        check_expect(
            &step.expect,
            Some(status),
            parsed.as_ref(),
            latency_ms,
            self.schemas.get(&http.operation),
        )
        .map_err(with_samples)?;
        let extracted = extract_all(&step.extract, parsed.as_ref()).map_err(with_samples)?;
        for (name, value) in extracted {
            ctx.store(&name, value);
        }
        Ok(StepOutcome {
            latency_us,
            bytes_in,
            bytes_out,
            body: parsed,
            status: Some(status),
        })
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StepExecutor for HttpExecutor {
    async fn execute(
        &self,
        step: &Step,
        ctx: &mut IterationCtx<'_>,
    ) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError> {
        match &step.action {
            Action::Http(http) => self.run_http(step, http, ctx).await,
            other => Err(StepError::new(
                StepCode::Connect,
                format!("http executor cannot run a {} step", other.kind().as_str()),
            )),
        }
    }

    async fn lag(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, i64> {
        BTreeMap::new()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::agent_api::EnvAddresses;
    use crate::context::{DataFormat, RunContext, parse_table};
    use axum::Router;
    use axum::extract::{Json, Path, Query};
    use axum::http::{HeaderMap as AxumHeaders, StatusCode, header::LOCATION};
    use axum::routing::{get, post};
    use glafira_load_model::suite::{ExistsTag, Expect, Matcher, SchemaExpect, StatusExpect};
    use serde_json::json;
    use std::collections::HashMap;

    /// Заглушка стенда на свободном порту.
    async fn stub() -> String {
        let app = Router::new()
            .route(
                "/v1/orders",
                post(|Json(body): Json<Value>| async move {
                    (
                        StatusCode::CREATED,
                        Json(json!({"id": "A-1", "echo": body})),
                    )
                }),
            )
            .route(
                "/v1/orders/{id}",
                get(
                    |Path(id): Path<String>,
                     Query(q): Query<HashMap<String, String>>,
                     headers: AxumHeaders| async move {
                        let h: HashMap<String, String> = headers
                            .iter()
                            .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.to_str().unwrap_or("").to_string()))
                            .collect();
                        Json(json!({"id": id, "query": q, "headers": h}))
                    },
                ),
            )
            .route(
                "/fail",
                get(|| async { (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "boom") }),
            )
            .route(
                "/teapot",
                get(|| async { (StatusCode::IM_A_TEAPOT, "short and stout") }),
            )
            .route(
                "/slow",
                get(|| async {
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
                    "late"
                }),
            )
            .route(
                "/redirect",
                get(|| async { (StatusCode::FOUND, [(LOCATION, "/v1/orders/1")], "") }),
            )
            .route("/text", get(|| async { "plain" }));
        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap() });
        format!("http://{addr}")
    }

    fn run_ctx() -> RunContext {
        RunContext {
            run_id: "run-1".into(),
            agent_id: "gen-1".into(),
            env: EnvAddresses::default(),
            secrets: BTreeMap::from([("API_TOKEN".to_string(), "s3cr3t".to_string())]),
            data: BTreeMap::from([
                (
                    "users".to_string(),
                    parse_table(DataFormat::Csv, "id\n7\n").unwrap(),
                ),
                (
                    "skus".to_string(),
                    parse_table(DataFormat::JsonLines, "{\"sku\":\"S1\"}\n").unwrap(),
                ),
            ]),
        }
    }

    fn executor(base: &str) -> HttpExecutor {
        let defaults = HttpDefaults {
            timeout_ms: 2000,
            headers: BTreeMap::from([("Accept".to_string(), "application/json".to_string())]),
        };
        HttpExecutor::new(base, &defaults, &["s3cr3t".to_string()]).unwrap()
    }

    fn http_step(operation: &str) -> HttpStep {
        HttpStep {
            operation: operation.into(),
            path: BTreeMap::new(),
            query: BTreeMap::new(),
            headers: BTreeMap::new(),
            body: None,
            body_text: None,
            timeout_ms: None,
        }
    }

    fn step(http: HttpStep, expect: Expect, extract: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Step {
        Step {
            id: Some("s".into()),
            action: Action::Http(http),
            expect,
            extract: extract
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.to_string()))
                .collect(),
        }
    }

    fn get_step(path: &str) -> Step {
        step(
            http_step(&format!("http:orders:GET {path}")),
            Expect::default(),
            &[],
        )
    }

    #[test]
    fn operation_id_gives_method_and_path() {
        let (m, p) = parse_operation("http:orders:POST /v1/orders").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((m, p), (Method::POST, "/v1/orders"));
        let (m, p) = parse_operation("http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((m, p), (Method::GET, "/v1/orders/{id}"));
        assert!(parse_operation("kafka_produce:orders.paid").is_none());
        assert!(parse_operation("http:orders:GET").is_none());
        assert!(parse_operation("http:orders:GET ").is_none());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn post_json_body_then_extract() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let ex = executor(&base);
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        ctx.begin_step("create");
        let mut http = http_step("http:orders:POST /v1/orders");
        http.body = Some(
            json!({"customerId": "{{users.id}}", "items": [{"sku": "{{pick skus.sku}}", "qty": "{{int 2 2}}"}]}),
        );
        let expect = Expect {
            status: Some(StatusExpect::One(201)),
            jsonpath: BTreeMap::from([("$.id".to_string(), Matcher::Exists(ExistsTag::Exists))]),
            schema: None,
            max_ms: Some(2000),
        };
        let out = ex
            .execute(&step(http, expect, &[("order_id", "$.id")]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.status, Some(201));
        let body = out.body.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(body["id"], json!("A-1"));
        assert_eq!(
            body["echo"],
            json!({"customerId": "7", "items": [{"sku": "S1", "qty": 2}]}),
            "одно выражение сохраняет тип"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            out.bytes_out,
            serde_json::to_vec(&body["echo"]).unwrap().len() as u64
        );
        assert!(out.bytes_in > 0 && out.latency_us > 0);
        assert_eq!(ctx.step("create", "order_id"), Some(json!("A-1")));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn http_errors_carry_masked_samples() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let ex = executor(&base);
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        let mut http = http_step("http:orders:GET /fail");
        http.headers
            .insert("Authorization".into(), "Bearer {{secret API_TOKEN}}".into());
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(http, Expect::default(), &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            (e.code, e.message.as_str()),
            (StepCode::Http5xx, "status 500")
        );
        let req = e.request.unwrap();
        assert!(req.starts_with(&format!("GET {base}/fail\n")), "{req}");
        assert!(req.contains("authorization: Bearer ***"), "{req}");
        assert!(req.contains("accept: application/json"), "{req}");
        assert!(!req.contains("s3cr3t"));
        let resp = e.response.unwrap();
        assert!(
            resp.starts_with("500\n") && resp.ends_with("\n\nboom"),
            "{resp}"
        );

        let e = ex
            .execute(&get_step("/teapot"), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            (e.code, e.message.as_str()),
            (StepCode::Http4xx, "status 418")
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn expect_status_overrides_http_codes() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let ex = executor(&base);
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        let ok = step(
            http_step("http:orders:GET /fail"),
            Expect {
                status: Some(StatusExpect::One(500)),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &[],
        );
        assert_eq!(ex.execute(&ok, &mut ctx).await.unwrap().status, Some(500));
        let class = step(
            http_step("http:orders:GET /teapot"),
            Expect {
                status: Some(StatusExpect::Class("2xx".into())),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &[],
        );
        let e = ex.execute(&class, &mut ctx).await.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::ExpectStatus);
        assert_eq!(e.message, "expected status 2xx, got 418");
        assert!(e.request.is_some() && e.response.is_some());
        let out = ex.execute(&get_step("/redirect"), &mut ctx).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.status, Some(302), "редирект отдаётся как есть");
        let out = ex.execute(&get_step("/text"), &mut ctx).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!((out.body, out.bytes_in), (None, 5));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn timeout_and_connect_errors() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let ex = executor(&base);
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        let mut http = http_step("http:orders:GET /slow");
        http.timeout_ms = Some(200);
        let started = Instant::now();
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(http, Expect::default(), &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            (e.code, e.message.as_str()),
            (StepCode::Timeout, "no response in 200 ms")
        );
        assert!(started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(2));
        assert!(e.request.is_some() && e.response.is_none());

        let free = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let addr = free.local_addr().unwrap();
        drop(free);
        let ex = executor(&format!("http://{addr}"));
        let e = ex.execute(&get_step("/x"), &mut ctx).await.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::Connect);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn path_query_and_headers_are_rendered() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let ex = executor(&base);
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        ctx.begin_step("create");
        ctx.store("order_id", json!("A 1/2"));
        ctx.begin_step("get");
        let mut http = http_step("http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}");
        http.path
            .insert("id".into(), "{{steps.create.order_id}}".into());
        http.query.insert("expand".into(), "items".into());
        http.query.insert("user".into(), "{{users.id}}".into());
        http.headers
            .insert("X-Run".into(), "{{run.id}}/{{agent.id}}".into());
        let out = ex
            .execute(&step(http, Expect::default(), &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let body = out.body.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            body["id"],
            json!("A 1/2"),
            "сегмент пути закодирован и раскодирован сервером"
        );
        assert_eq!(body["query"], json!({"expand": "items", "user": "7"}));
        assert_eq!(body["headers"]["x-run"], json!("run-1/gen-1"));
        assert_eq!(
            body["headers"]["accept"],
            json!("application/json"),
            "заголовок по умолчанию"
        );

        let mut missing = http_step("http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}");
        missing.path.insert("other".into(), "1".into());
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(missing, Expect::default(), &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::Connect);
        assert!(
            e.message.contains("path parameter `id` is not set"),
            "{}",
            e.message
        );
        let mut unknown = http_step("http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}");
        unknown.path.insert("id".into(), "{{steps.nope.x}}".into());
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(unknown, Expect::default(), &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::ExtractMissing);
        assert!(e.message.starts_with("expression:"), "{}", e.message);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn jsonpath_schema_max_ms_and_extract_missing() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let schema = SchemaSummary::object(
            "body",
            vec![SchemaSummary::leaf("id", "string").required(true)],
        );
        let strict = SchemaSummary::object(
            "body",
            vec![SchemaSummary::leaf("missing", "string").required(true)],
        );
        let op = "http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}";
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        let mut http = http_step(op);
        http.path.insert("id".into(), "A-1".into());

        let ex = executor(&base).with_schemas(BTreeMap::from([(op.to_string(), schema)]));
        let good = Expect {
            jsonpath: BTreeMap::from([(
                "$.id".to_string(),
                Matcher::Equals {
                    equals: json!("A-1"),
                },
            )]),
            schema: Some(SchemaExpect::Response),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(
            ex.execute(&step(http.clone(), good, &[]), &mut ctx)
                .await
                .is_ok()
        );
        let bad = Expect {
            jsonpath: BTreeMap::from([(
                "$.id".to_string(),
                Matcher::Equals { equals: json!("B") },
            )]),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(http.clone(), bad, &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::ExpectJsonpath);
        assert!(e.response.unwrap().starts_with("200\n"));
        let slow = Expect {
            max_ms: Some(0),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(http.clone(), slow, &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::ExpectMaxMs);

        let ex = executor(&base).with_schemas(BTreeMap::from([(op.to_string(), strict)]));
        let schema_expect = Expect {
            schema: Some(SchemaExpect::Response),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(http.clone(), schema_expect, &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::ExpectSchema);
        assert!(
            e.message.contains("$.missing: required field is missing"),
            "{}",
            e.message
        );

        let e = ex
            .execute(&step(http, Expect::default(), &[("x", "$.nope")]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(e.code, StepCode::ExtractMissing);
        assert!(e.request.is_some() && e.response.is_some());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn body_text_is_sent_as_is() {
        let base = stub().await;
        let ex = executor(&base);
        let run = run_ctx();
        let mut ctx = IterationCtx::new(&run, 0);
        let mut http = http_step("http:orders:POST /v1/orders");
        http.body_text = Some("{\"raw\": \"{{users.id}}\"}".into());
        http.headers
            .insert("Content-Type".into(), "application/json".into());
        let out = ex
            .execute(&step(http, Expect::default(), &[]), &mut ctx)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.body.unwrap()["echo"], json!({"raw": "7"}));
        assert_eq!(out.bytes_out, 12);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: `executor.rs` целиком — трейт плюс диспетчер `Executors`**

```rust
//! Исполнитель шага: результат, трейт и диспетчер по виду действия (спека L2 §5.2).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use glafira_load_model::suite::{Action, Step};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::context::IterationCtx;
use crate::errors::{StepCode, StepError};
use crate::http::HttpExecutor;

/// Удачный шаг: задержка, байты, разобранное тело (если JSON) и статус (у HTTP).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct StepOutcome {
    pub latency_us: u64,
    pub bytes_in: u64,
    pub bytes_out: u64,
    pub body: Option<Value>,
    pub status: Option<u16>,
}

/// Исполняет один шаг: рендерит выражения из `ctx`, проверяет `expect`, кладёт `extract`
/// в `ctx` под текущим шагом (`IterationCtx::begin_step`).
#[async_trait]
pub trait StepExecutor: Send + Sync {
    async fn execute(
        &self,
        step: &Step,
        ctx: &mut IterationCtx<'_>,
    ) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError>;

    /// Лаг потребителя по операциям `kafka_consume`; у HTTP пусто.
    async fn lag(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, i64>;
}

/// Диспетчер: HTTP — всегда, Kafka — если настроен (Task 7 даёт `KafkaExecutor`,
/// реализующий `StepExecutor`; он кладётся сюда в `Box`).
pub struct Executors {
    pub http: HttpExecutor,
    pub kafka: Option<Box<dyn StepExecutor>>,
}

#[async_trait]
impl StepExecutor for Executors {
    async fn execute(
        &self,
        step: &Step,
        ctx: &mut IterationCtx<'_>,
    ) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError> {
        match &step.action {
            Action::Http(_) => self.http.execute(step, ctx).await,
            Action::KafkaProduce(_) | Action::KafkaConsume(_) => match &self.kafka {
                Some(k) => k.execute(step, ctx).await,
                None => {
                    let code = match &step.action {
                        Action::KafkaProduce(_) => StepCode::KafkaProduce,
                        _ => StepCode::KafkaConsume,
                    };
                    Err(StepError::new(code, "kafka not configured"))
                }
            },
        }
    }

    async fn lag(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, i64> {
        match &self.kafka {
            Some(k) => k.lag().await,
            None => BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
```

### Task 7: Kafka — продюсер, потребитель с буфером и Avro по Schema Registry

**Решение:** потребитель будит ожидающие шаги через `tokio::sync::watch<u64>` (счётчик принятых сообщений; `subscribe()` перед проверкой буфера исключает потерю пробуждения). Рендер шаблонов шага выполняется до первого `await` (`prepare_produce` / `prepare_consume`), чтобы будущее `execute` было `Send` и чтобы интеграционные тесты могли вызывать исполнитель с простой реализацией `expr::Context`, не зная конструктора `IterationCtx`. Ошибка рендера во время прогона (нет значения `steps.<id>.<name>`, набора, колонки) — код `EXTRACT_MISSING`. Интеграционные тесты — `#[ignore]` в `tests/kafka.rs`, запуск `cargo test -p glafira-load-engine --test kafka -- --ignored`; Task 17 добавляет эту команду в job `linux` (Docker есть на `ubuntu-22.04`), переменных окружения не нужно.

Вставь перед `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
//! Avro по схеме контракта в формате Confluent (спека L2 §5.2).
//!
//! Схема — текст `.avsc` операции реестра (карта «операция → схема» передаётся при создании
//! исполнителя), id схемы — `GET {schema_registry}/subjects/{topic}-value/versions/latest`,
//! кэш на прогон. Кадр: магический байт `0x00`, id как u32 big-endian, тело Avro.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use apache_avro::types::Value as AvroValue;
use apache_avro::{Schema, from_avro_datum, to_avro_datum};
use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::errors::{StepCode, StepError, truncate};

/// Магический байт формата Confluent.
pub const MAGIC: u8 = 0;
/// Предел текста значения в примере ошибки (Global Constraints: тела до 4 КБ).
const PREVIEW_MAX: usize = 4096;

/// Кадр Confluent: `0x00`, id схемы (u32 big-endian), тело.
pub fn frame(id: u32, datum: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(5 + datum.len());
    out.push(MAGIC);
    out.extend_from_slice(&id.to_be_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(datum);
    out
}

/// Разбор кадра Confluent: id схемы и тело.
pub fn unframe(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(u32, &[u8]), String> {
    if bytes.len() < 5 {
        return Err(format!("not a Confluent Avro frame: {} byte(s)", bytes.len()));
    }
    if bytes[0] != MAGIC {
        return Err(format!("not a Confluent Avro frame: magic byte {:#04x}", bytes[0]));
    }
    let id = u32::from_be_bytes([bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3], bytes[4]]);
    Ok((id, &bytes[5..]))
}

/// JSON → значение Avro по схеме (объекты → record/map, числа → int/long/double, union по
/// варианту, отсутствующие поля — из `default`) → тело без заголовка.
pub fn encode(schema: &Schema, value: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let avro = AvroValue::from(value.clone())
        .resolve(schema)
        .map_err(|e| format!("value does not match the Avro schema: {e}"))?;
    to_avro_datum(schema, avro).map_err(|e| format!("avro encode: {e}"))
}

/// Тело → JSON по той же схеме (тесты и чтение сообщений).
pub fn decode(schema: &Schema, datum: &[u8]) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    let mut cursor = datum;
    let value = from_avro_datum(schema, &mut cursor, None).map_err(|e| format!("avro decode: {e}"))?;
    serde_json::Value::try_from(value).map_err(|e| format!("avro to json: {e}"))
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct LatestVersion {
    id: u32,
}

/// Клиент Schema Registry: только id последней версии субъекта `<topic>-value`, кэш на прогон.
pub struct SchemaRegistry {
    base: String,
    http: reqwest::Client,
    ids: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, u32>>,
}

impl SchemaRegistry {
    pub fn new(base: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            base: base.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
            http: reqwest::Client::builder()
                .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10))
                .build()
                .expect("reqwest client"),
            ids: Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new()),
        }
    }

    pub async fn latest_id(&self, topic: &str) -> Result<u32, String> {
        let subject = format!("{topic}-value");
        if let Some(id) = self.ids.lock().expect("registry cache").get(&subject) {
            return Ok(*id);
        }
        let url = format!("{}/subjects/{subject}/versions/latest", self.base);
        let resp = self.http.get(&url).send().await.map_err(|e| format!("schema registry {url}: {e}"))?;
        let status = resp.status();
        if !status.is_success() {
            return Err(format!("schema registry {url}: HTTP {}", status.as_u16()));
        }
        let latest: LatestVersion = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| format!("schema registry {url}: {e}"))?;
        self.ids.lock().expect("registry cache").insert(subject, latest.id);
        Ok(latest.id)
    }
}

/// Схемы операций `kafka_produce` с `encoding: avro` и реестр стенда.
pub struct AvroCodec {
    registry: Option<SchemaRegistry>,
    schemas: BTreeMap<String, Schema>,
}

fn avro_err(message: impl Into<String>, request: Option<String>) -> StepError {
    StepError { code: StepCode::AvroEncode, message: message.into(), request, response: None }
}

impl AvroCodec {
    /// `schema_texts`: id операции → текст `.avsc`. Ошибка — нечитаемая схема.
    pub fn new(registry: Option<String>, schema_texts: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let mut schemas = BTreeMap::new();
        for (operation, text) in schema_texts {
            let schema = Schema::parse_str(text).map_err(|e| format!("Avro schema of `{operation}`: {e}"))?;
            schemas.insert(operation.clone(), schema);
        }
        Ok(Self { registry: registry.as_deref().map(SchemaRegistry::new), schemas })
    }

    pub fn has_schema(&self, operation: &str) -> bool {
        self.schemas.contains_key(operation)
    }

    /// Кадр Confluent для значения операции; `topic` — субъект `<topic>-value`.
    pub async fn encode_message(&self, operation: &str, topic: &str, value: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<Vec<u8>, StepError> {
        let preview = || Some(truncate(&value.to_string(), PREVIEW_MAX));
        let schema = self
            .schemas
            .get(operation)
            .ok_or_else(|| avro_err(format!("no Avro schema for `{operation}`"), preview()))?;
        let registry = self
            .registry
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| avro_err("schema registry is not configured for the environment", preview()))?;
        let id = registry.latest_id(topic).await.map_err(|m| avro_err(m, preview()))?;
        let datum = encode(schema, value).map_err(|m| avro_err(m, preview()))?;
        Ok(frame(id, &datum))
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Шаги `kafka_produce` и `kafka_consume` на rdkafka (спека L2 §5.2, решение плана 6).
//!
//! Продюсер один на агента. Потребитель один на все `kafka_consume`-топики сьюта: группа
//! `glafira-load-<run_id>-<agent_id>`, чтение с конца, фоновая задача складывает сообщения в буфер
//! (не больше `BUFFER_MAX` и не старше `BUFFER_TTL`), шаг ждёт в буфере совпадение по `match`.
//! Лаг снимается раз в секунду по смещениям. Рендер шаблонов — до первого `await`.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use async_trait::async_trait;
use glafira_load_model::suite::expr::{Context, ExprError, parse_template, render_json, render_string};
use glafira_load_model::suite::{Action, ConsumeStep, Encoding, Match, ProduceStep, Step};
use rdkafka::ClientConfig;
use rdkafka::consumer::{Consumer, StreamConsumer};
use rdkafka::message::{Header, Message, OwnedHeaders};
use rdkafka::producer::{FutureProducer, FutureRecord};
use rdkafka::util::Timeout;
use serde_json_path::JsonPath;
use tokio::sync::watch;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use crate::avro::AvroCodec;
use crate::context::IterationCtx;
use crate::errors::{StepCode, StepError, truncate};
use crate::executor::{StepExecutor, StepOutcome};

/// Буфер потребителя: не больше стольких сообщений…
pub const BUFFER_MAX: usize = 10_000;
/// …и не старше стольки.
pub const BUFFER_TTL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
/// Ожидание назначения партиций после `subscribe` (решение плана 6).
pub const ASSIGNMENT_WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// Сколько ждать места в очереди продюсера.
pub const PRODUCE_QUEUE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
/// Период снятия лага.
pub const LAG_PERIOD: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
/// Предел текста запроса в примере ошибки (Global Constraints).
const PREVIEW_MAX: usize = 4096;

/// Топик из id операции `kafka_produce:<topic>` или `kafka_consume:<topic>`.
pub fn topic_of(operation: &str) -> Option<&str> {
    operation
        .strip_prefix("kafka_produce:")
        .or_else(|| operation.strip_prefix("kafka_consume:"))
        .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
}

pub fn consumer_group(run_id: &str, agent_id: &str) -> String {
    format!("glafira-load-{run_id}-{agent_id}")
}

/// Общая часть конфигурации клиентов: `defaults.kafka` сьюта и адрес стенда (адрес побеждает).
fn base_config(bootstrap: &str, defaults: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> ClientConfig {
    let mut c = ClientConfig::new();
    for (k, v) in defaults {
        c.set(k, v);
    }
    c.set("bootstrap.servers", bootstrap);
    c
}

pub fn producer_config(bootstrap: &str, defaults: &BTreeMap<String, String>, agent_id: &str) -> ClientConfig {
    let mut c = base_config(bootstrap, defaults);
    c.set("client.id", format!("glafira-load-{agent_id}"));
    if !defaults.contains_key("message.timeout.ms") {
        c.set("message.timeout.ms", "30000");
    }
    c
}

pub fn consumer_config(bootstrap: &str, defaults: &BTreeMap<String, String>, run_id: &str, agent_id: &str) -> ClientConfig {
    let mut c = base_config(bootstrap, defaults);
    c.set("client.id", format!("glafira-load-{agent_id}"))
        .set("group.id", consumer_group(run_id, agent_id))
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "latest")
        .set("enable.auto.commit", "false")
        .set("enable.partition.eof", "false");
    c
}

fn step_err(code: StepCode, message: impl Into<String>, request: Option<String>) -> StepError {
    StepError { code, message: message.into(), request, response: None }
}

/// Ошибка рендера во время прогона: отсутствует значение шага, набора или колонки.
fn render_err(e: ExprError) -> StepError {
    step_err(StepCode::ExtractMissing, format!("render: {}", e.message), None)
}

fn render_str(text: &str, ctx: &dyn Context) -> Result<String, StepError> {
    let template = parse_template(text).map_err(render_err)?;
    render_string(&template, ctx).map_err(render_err)
}

/// Строковое представление узла JSON для сравнения с ожидаемым значением `match.jsonpath`.
pub fn as_text(v: &serde_json::Value) -> String {
    match v {
        serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        other => other.to_string(),
    }
}

/// Сообщение в буфере потребителя.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Received {
    pub topic: String,
    pub key: Option<String>,
    /// Тело как JSON; не JSON — `None`.
    pub body: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    /// Длина тела в байтах (`bytes_in` шага).
    pub len: u64,
    pub at: Instant,
}

impl Received {
    fn from_message(m: &impl Message) -> Self {
        let payload = m.payload();
        Self {
            topic: m.topic().to_string(),
            key: m.key().map(|k| String::from_utf8_lossy(k).into_owned()),
            body: payload.and_then(|p| serde_json::from_slice(p).ok()),
            len: payload.map_or(0, |p| p.len() as u64),
            at: Instant::now(),
        }
    }
}

/// Условие `match` шага после рендера.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct MatchSpec {
    pub topic: String,
    pub key: Option<String>,
    /// Путь → ожидаемое значение строкой; совпадение — любой узел результата, все пути сразу.
    pub jsonpath: Vec<(JsonPath, String)>,
}

impl MatchSpec {
    pub fn render(topic: &str, m: &Match, ctx: &dyn Context) -> Result<Self, StepError> {
        let key = m.key.as_deref().map(|k| render_str(k, ctx)).transpose()?;
        let mut jsonpath = Vec::with_capacity(m.jsonpath.len());
        for (path, expected) in &m.jsonpath {
            let compiled = JsonPath::parse(path)
                .map_err(|e| step_err(StepCode::KafkaConsume, format!("match.jsonpath `{path}`: {e}"), None))?;
            jsonpath.push((compiled, render_str(expected, ctx)?));
        }
        Ok(Self { topic: topic.into(), key, jsonpath })
    }

    pub fn matches(&self, m: &Received) -> bool {
        if m.topic != self.topic {
            return false;
        }
        if let Some(key) = &self.key {
            if m.key.as_deref() != Some(key.as_str()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if self.jsonpath.is_empty() {
            return true;
        }
        let Some(body) = &m.body else {
            return false;
        };
        self.jsonpath
            .iter()
            .all(|(path, expected)| path.query(body).iter().any(|node| as_text(node) == *expected))
    }

    /// Текст условия для примера ошибки по таймауту.
    pub fn describe(&self) -> String {
        let mut out = format!("topic={}", self.topic);
        if let Some(k) = &self.key {
            out.push_str(&format!(" key={k}"));
        }
        for (path, expected) in &self.jsonpath {
            out.push_str(&format!(" {path}={expected}"));
        }
        out
    }
}

/// Буфер последних сообщений: по размеру и по возрасту.
pub struct MessageBuffer {
    items: VecDeque<Received>,
    max: usize,
    ttl: Duration,
}

impl MessageBuffer {
    pub fn new(max: usize, ttl: Duration) -> Self {
        Self { items: VecDeque::new(), max, ttl }
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, m: Received) {
        self.prune(m.at);
        if self.items.len() >= self.max {
            self.items.pop_front();
        }
        self.items.push_back(m);
    }

    /// Выбрасывает сообщения старше `ttl` относительно `now`.
    pub fn prune(&mut self, now: Instant) {
        while let Some(front) = self.items.front() {
            if now.saturating_duration_since(front.at) > self.ttl {
                self.items.pop_front();
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Первое совпавшее сообщение; оно удаляется из буфера.
    pub fn take(&mut self, spec: &MatchSpec) -> Option<Received> {
        let i = self.items.iter().position(|m| spec.matches(m))?;
        self.items.remove(i)
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.items.len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.items.is_empty()
    }
}

/// Шаг `kafka_produce` после рендера.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct ProduceMessage {
    pub operation: String,
    pub topic: String,
    pub key: Option<String>,
    /// `value` как JSON; при `encoding: avro` кодируется по схеме.
    pub value: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    /// `value_text` как есть; при `encoding: avro` разбирается как JSON.
    pub text: Option<String>,
    pub encoding: Encoding,
    pub headers: Vec<(String, String)>,
}

pub fn prepare_produce(step: &ProduceStep, ctx: &dyn Context) -> Result<ProduceMessage, StepError> {
    let topic = topic_of(&step.operation)
        .ok_or_else(|| step_err(StepCode::KafkaProduce, format!("operation `{}` has no topic", step.operation), None))?
        .to_string();
    let key = step.key.as_deref().map(|k| render_str(k, ctx)).transpose()?;
    let value = step.value.as_ref().map(|v| render_json(v, ctx).map_err(render_err)).transpose()?;
    let text = step.value_text.as_deref().map(|t| render_str(t, ctx)).transpose()?;
    let mut headers = Vec::with_capacity(step.headers.len());
    for (k, v) in &step.headers {
        headers.push((k.clone(), render_str(v, ctx)?));
    }
    Ok(ProduceMessage { operation: step.operation.clone(), topic, key, value, text, encoding: step.encoding, headers })
}

/// Шаг `kafka_consume` после рендера.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct ConsumeRequest {
    pub topic: String,
    pub spec: MatchSpec,
    pub timeout: Duration,
}

pub fn prepare_consume(step: &ConsumeStep, ctx: &dyn Context) -> Result<ConsumeRequest, StepError> {
    let topic = topic_of(&step.operation)
        .ok_or_else(|| step_err(StepCode::KafkaConsume, format!("operation `{}` has no topic", step.operation), None))?
        .to_string();
    let spec = MatchSpec::render(&topic, &step.match_, ctx)?;
    Ok(ConsumeRequest { topic, spec, timeout: Duration::from_millis(step.timeout_ms) })
}

/// Потребитель всех consume-топиков прогона и его фоновые задачи.
struct ConsumerHub {
    consumer: StreamConsumer,
    topics: Vec<String>,
    buffer: Mutex<MessageBuffer>,
    /// Счётчик принятых сообщений: будит ожидающие шаги.
    seq: watch::Sender<u64>,
    /// Операция `kafka_consume:<topic>` → лаг, обновляется раз в секунду.
    lag: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, i64>>,
    cancel: CancellationToken,
}

async fn read_loop(hub: Arc<ConsumerHub>) {
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            _ = hub.cancel.cancelled() => break,
            next = hub.consumer.recv() => match next {
                Ok(m) => {
                    let received = Received::from_message(&m);
                    hub.buffer.lock().expect("consumer buffer").push(received);
                    hub.seq.send_modify(|n| *n += 1);
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "kafka consumer");
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                }
            },
        }
    }
}

/// Лаг по каждому consume-топику: high watermark минус позиция потребителя, сумма по партициям.
/// Партиция без позиции (ещё ничего не прочитано) считается догнавшей.
fn compute_lag(consumer: &StreamConsumer, topics: &[String]) -> BTreeMap<String, i64> {
    let mut out: BTreeMap<String, i64> = topics.iter().map(|t| (format!("kafka_consume:{t}"), 0)).collect();
    let Ok(position) = consumer.position() else {
        return out;
    };
    for e in position.elements() {
        let topic = e.topic();
        if !topics.iter().any(|t| t == topic) {
            continue;
        }
        let Ok((_low, high)) = consumer.fetch_watermarks(topic, e.partition(), Duration::from_secs(1)) else {
            continue;
        };
        let pos = e.offset().to_raw().filter(|o| *o >= 0).unwrap_or(high);
        *out.entry(format!("kafka_consume:{topic}")).or_insert(0) += (high - pos).max(0);
    }
    out
}

async fn lag_loop(hub: Arc<ConsumerHub>) {
    let mut tick = tokio::time::interval(LAG_PERIOD);
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            _ = hub.cancel.cancelled() => break,
            _ = tick.tick() => {}
        }
        let h = hub.clone();
        // fetch_watermarks блокирует до секунды — вне исполнителя tokio.
        let computed = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || compute_lag(&h.consumer, &h.topics)).await.unwrap_or_default();
        *hub.lag.lock().expect("lag map") = computed;
    }
}

async fn wait_assignment(consumer: &StreamConsumer, limit: Duration) -> Result<(), String> {
    let started = Instant::now();
    loop {
        match consumer.assignment() {
            Ok(a) if a.count() > 0 => return Ok(()),
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(e) => return Err(format!("kafka consumer assignment: {e}")),
        }
        if started.elapsed() > limit {
            return Err(format!("kafka consumer got no partitions within {} s", limit.as_secs()));
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
    }
}

/// Исполнитель шагов Kafka одного прогона на агенте.
pub struct KafkaExecutor {
    producer: FutureProducer,
    hub: Option<Arc<ConsumerHub>>,
    avro: AvroCodec,
    cancel: CancellationToken,
}

impl KafkaExecutor {
    /// `consume_topics` — топики всех `kafka_consume` сьюта (пусто — потребитель не создаётся);
    /// `avro_schemas` — id операции `kafka_produce` с `encoding: avro` → текст `.avsc`.
    /// Возвращает после назначения партиций (до `ASSIGNMENT_WAIT`), чтобы не терять первые сообщения.
    pub async fn new(
        bootstrap: &str,
        defaults: &BTreeMap<String, String>,
        consume_topics: &[String],
        run_id: &str,
        agent_id: &str,
        schema_registry: Option<String>,
        avro_schemas: &BTreeMap<String, String>,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let producer: FutureProducer = producer_config(bootstrap, defaults, agent_id)
            .create()
            .map_err(|e| format!("kafka producer: {e}"))?;
        let avro = AvroCodec::new(schema_registry, avro_schemas)?;
        let cancel = CancellationToken::new();
        let hub = if consume_topics.is_empty() {
            None
        } else {
            let consumer: StreamConsumer = consumer_config(bootstrap, defaults, run_id, agent_id)
                .create()
                .map_err(|e| format!("kafka consumer: {e}"))?;
            let names: Vec<&str> = consume_topics.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
            consumer.subscribe(&names).map_err(|e| format!("kafka subscribe: {e}"))?;
            let (seq, _) = watch::channel(0u64);
            let hub = Arc::new(ConsumerHub {
                consumer,
                topics: consume_topics.to_vec(),
                buffer: Mutex::new(MessageBuffer::new(BUFFER_MAX, BUFFER_TTL)),
                seq,
                lag: Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new()),
                cancel: cancel.clone(),
            });
            // Ребаланс идёт внутри poll: читающая задача стартует до ожидания назначения.
            tokio::spawn(read_loop(hub.clone()));
            if let Err(e) = wait_assignment(&hub.consumer, ASSIGNMENT_WAIT).await {
                cancel.cancel();
                return Err(e);
            }
            tokio::spawn(lag_loop(hub.clone()));
            Some(hub)
        };
        Ok(Self { producer, hub, avro, cancel })
    }

    /// Останавливает фоновые задачи потребителя.
    pub fn shutdown(&self) {
        self.cancel.cancel();
    }

    /// Байты сообщения и текст для примера ошибки.
    async fn payload(&self, m: &ProduceMessage) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, String), StepError> {
        match m.encoding {
            Encoding::Json => Ok(match (&m.value, &m.text) {
                (Some(v), _) => {
                    let s = v.to_string();
                    (s.clone().into_bytes(), s)
                }
                (None, Some(t)) => (t.clone().into_bytes(), t.clone()),
                (None, None) => (Vec::new(), String::new()),
            }),
            Encoding::Avro => {
                let json = match (&m.value, &m.text) {
                    (Some(v), _) => v.clone(),
                    (None, Some(t)) => serde_json::from_str(t).map_err(|e| {
                        step_err(StepCode::AvroEncode, format!("value_text is not JSON: {e}"), Some(truncate(t, PREVIEW_MAX)))
                    })?,
                    (None, None) => serde_json::Value::Null,
                };
                let bytes = self.avro.encode_message(&m.operation, &m.topic, &json).await?;
                Ok((bytes, json.to_string()))
            }
        }
    }

    pub async fn produce(&self, m: ProduceMessage) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError> {
        let (payload, preview) = self.payload(&m).await?;
        let mut headers = OwnedHeaders::new();
        for (k, v) in &m.headers {
            headers = headers.insert(Header { key: k, value: Some(v.as_str()) });
        }
        let queue = Timeout::After(PRODUCE_QUEUE_TIMEOUT);
        let started = Instant::now();
        let sent = match &m.key {
            Some(k) => {
                let record = FutureRecord::<String, Vec<u8>>::to(&m.topic).key(k).payload(&payload).headers(headers);
                self.producer.send(record, queue).await
            }
            None => {
                let record = FutureRecord::<(), Vec<u8>>::to(&m.topic).payload(&payload).headers(headers);
                self.producer.send(record, queue).await
            }
        };
        let latency_us = started.elapsed().as_micros() as u64;
        match sent {
            Ok(_) => Ok(StepOutcome {
                latency_us,
                bytes_in: 0,
                bytes_out: (payload.len() + m.key.as_ref().map_or(0, String::len)) as u64,
                body: None,
                status: None,
            }),
            Err((e, _)) => Err(step_err(
                StepCode::KafkaProduce,
                format!("produce to `{}`: {e}", m.topic),
                Some(truncate(&preview, PREVIEW_MAX)),
            )),
        }
    }

    pub async fn consume(&self, r: ConsumeRequest) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError> {
        let hub = self
            .hub
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| step_err(StepCode::KafkaConsume, format!("consumer for `{}` is not running", r.topic), None))?;
        if !hub.topics.iter().any(|t| *t == r.topic) {
            return Err(step_err(StepCode::KafkaConsume, format!("topic `{}` is not subscribed", r.topic), None));
        }
        let started = Instant::now();
        let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + r.timeout;
        // Подписка до проверки буфера: сообщение, пришедшее между проверкой и ожиданием, не теряется.
        let mut seq = hub.seq.subscribe();
        loop {
            if let Some(m) = hub.buffer.lock().expect("consumer buffer").take(&r.spec) {
                return Ok(StepOutcome {
                    latency_us: started.elapsed().as_micros() as u64,
                    bytes_in: m.len,
                    bytes_out: 0,
                    body: m.body,
                    status: None,
                });
            }
            match tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, seq.changed()).await {
                Ok(Ok(())) => continue,
                Ok(Err(_)) => return Err(step_err(StepCode::KafkaConsume, "consumer stopped", None)),
                Err(_) => {
                    return Err(step_err(
                        StepCode::Timeout,
                        format!("no message matched in `{}` within {} ms", r.topic, r.timeout.as_millis()),
                        Some(r.spec.describe()),
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for KafkaExecutor {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.cancel.cancel();
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StepExecutor for KafkaExecutor {
    async fn execute(&self, step: &Step, ctx: &mut IterationCtx<'_>) -> Result<StepOutcome, StepError> {
        match &step.action {
            Action::KafkaProduce(p) => {
                let message = prepare_produce(p, &*ctx)?;
                self.produce(message).await
            }
            Action::KafkaConsume(c) => {
                let request = prepare_consume(c, &*ctx)?;
                self.consume(request).await
            }
            Action::Http(h) => Err(step_err(
                StepCode::KafkaProduce,
                format!("http operation `{}` cannot run on the kafka executor", h.operation),
                None,
            )),
        }
    }

    async fn lag(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, i64> {
        self.hub.as_ref().map(|h| h.lag.lock().expect("lag map").clone()).unwrap_or_default()
    }
}
```

```rust
fn free_port() -> u16 {
    TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port()
}

async fn redpanda() -> (ContainerAsync<GenericImage>, String) {
    let port = free_port();
    let cmd: Vec<String> = [
        "redpanda", "start", "--mode", "dev-container", "--smp", "1", "--memory", "512M", "--overprovisioned",
        "--kafka-addr", "PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092",
    ]
    .iter()
    .map(|s| s.to_string())
    .chain([format!("--advertise-kafka-addr=PLAINTEXT://127.0.0.1:{port}")])
    .collect();
    let container = GenericImage::new("redpandadata/redpanda", "v24.2.7")
        .with_exposed_port(ContainerPort::Tcp(9092))
        .with_wait_for(WaitFor::message_on_stderr("Successfully started Redpanda!"))
        .with_mapped_port(port, ContainerPort::Tcp(9092))
        .with_cmd(cmd)
        .start()
        .await
        .expect("docker with redpandadata/redpanda");
    (container, format!("127.0.0.1:{port}"))
}

async fn create_topics(bootstrap: &str, topics: &[&str]) {
    let admin: AdminClient<DefaultClientContext> =
        ClientConfig::new().set("bootstrap.servers", bootstrap).create().unwrap();
    let specs: Vec<NewTopic> = topics.iter().map(|t| NewTopic::new(t, 1, TopicReplication::Fixed(1))).collect();
    for result in admin.create_topics(&specs, &AdminOptions::new()).await.unwrap() {
        result.unwrap();
    }
}

fn produce_step(operation: &str, encoding: Encoding, value: serde_json::Value) -> ProduceStep {
    ProduceStep {
        operation: operation.into(),
        key: Some("{{steps.create.order_id}}".into()),
        value: Some(value),
        value_text: None,
        headers: BTreeMap::from([("source".to_string(), "glafira-load".to_string())]),
        encoding,
    }
}

fn consume_step(key: Option<&str>, paths: &[(&str, &str)], timeout_ms: u64) -> ConsumeStep {
    ConsumeStep {
        operation: "kafka_consume:orders.created".into(),
        match_: Match {
            key: key.map(str::to_string),
            jsonpath: paths.iter().map(|(p, v)| (p.to_string(), v.to_string())).collect(),
        },
        timeout_ms,
    }
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
#[ignore]
async fn produce_json_then_consume_by_key_and_jsonpath() {
    let (_rp, bootstrap) = redpanda().await;
    create_topics(&bootstrap, &["orders.created"]).await;
    let ex = KafkaExecutor::new(&bootstrap, &BTreeMap::new(), &["orders.created".to_string()], "r1", "a1", None, &BTreeMap::new())
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let step = produce_step("kafka_produce:orders.created", Encoding::Json, json!({"orderId": "{{steps.create.order_id}}", "qty": 2}));
    let out = ex.produce(prepare_produce(&step, &TestCtx).unwrap()).await.unwrap();
    assert!(out.bytes_out > 0 && out.body.is_none() && out.status.is_none());

    let got = ex
        .consume(prepare_consume(&consume_step(Some("{{steps.create.order_id}}"), &[("$.qty", "2")], 10_000), &TestCtx).unwrap())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(got.body, Some(json!({"orderId": "o-1", "qty": 2})));
    assert!(got.bytes_in > 0);

    // Совпавшее сообщение изъято из буфера: повторное ожидание того же ключа истекает.
    let again = ex.consume(prepare_consume(&consume_step(Some("o-1"), &[], 1_500), &TestCtx).unwrap()).await;
    match again {
        Err(e) => assert!(matches!(e.code, StepCode::Timeout), "{e:?}"),
        Ok(_) => panic!("message must be consumed once"),
    }
    ex.shutdown();
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
#[ignore]
async fn produce_avro_with_schema_registry_stub() {
    let (_rp, bootstrap) = redpanda().await;
    create_topics(&bootstrap, &["orders.paid"]).await;
    let hits = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let counter = hits.clone();
    let app = Router::new().route(
        "/subjects/{subject}/versions/latest",
        get(move |Path(subject): Path<String>| {
            let counter = counter.clone();
            async move {
                counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
                Json(json!({"id": 7, "version": 1, "subject": subject, "schema": SCHEMA}))
            }
        }),
    );
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let registry = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
    tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap() });

    let schemas = BTreeMap::from([("kafka_produce:orders.paid".to_string(), SCHEMA.to_string())]);
    let ex = KafkaExecutor::new(&bootstrap, &BTreeMap::new(), &[], "r1", "a1", Some(registry), &schemas).await.unwrap();
    let step = produce_step("kafka_produce:orders.paid", Encoding::Avro, json!({"orderId": "{{steps.create.order_id}}", "amount": 250}));
    ex.produce(prepare_produce(&step, &TestCtx).unwrap()).await.unwrap();
    ex.produce(prepare_produce(&step, &TestCtx).unwrap()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hits.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1, "id схемы запрошен один раз на прогон");

    // Сырое сообщение читается обычным потребителем с начала топика.
    let reader: BaseConsumer = ClientConfig::new()
        .set("bootstrap.servers", &bootstrap)
        .set("group.id", "test-reader")
        .set("auto.offset.reset", "earliest")
        .create()
        .unwrap();
    reader.subscribe(&["orders.paid"]).unwrap();
    let started = Instant::now();
    let message = loop {
        if let Some(m) = reader.poll(Duration::from_secs(1)) {
            break m.unwrap().detach();
        }
        assert!(started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(30), "no message within 30 s");
    };
    let (id, body) = avro::unframe(message.payload().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(id, 7);
    let schema = apache_avro::Schema::parse_str(SCHEMA).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(avro::decode(&schema, body).unwrap(), json!({"orderId": "o-1", "amount": 250, "note": null}));
    assert_eq!(message.key(), Some(b"o-1".as_slice()));
}
```

```rust
mod tests {

    #[test]
    fn writer_creates_files_and_finishes_run_yaml() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let dir = tmp.path().join("runs").join("2026-11-02T14-30-00");
        let mut w = RunWriter::create(&dir, &meta()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(w.dir(), dir.as_path());
        let run = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(RUN_FILE)).unwrap();
        assert!(run.starts_with("run_id: r1\nsuite: orders\nprofile: peak\nenv: test\n"), "{run}");

            ops: vec![OpTick { id: "a".into(), n: 1, err: BTreeMap::new(), dropped: 0, p50: 1.0, p90: 1.0, p95: 1.0, p99: 1.0, max: 1.0, bytes_in: 0, bytes_out: 0, lag: None }],

        assert_eq!(errors.lines().count(), 1);

        assert_eq!(back.code, "HTTP_5xx");

        let summary = AgentSummary { status: RunStatus::Completed, ops: vec![op_summary("b"), op_summary("a")], scenarios: vec![], seconds: 2 };
        w.finish(&summary, RunStatus::Completed).unwrap();
        let run = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(RUN_FILE)).unwrap();
        assert!(run.contains("\nended_at: ") && run.contains("\nstatus: completed\n"), "{run}");
        let written: RunMeta = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&run).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((written.status, written.run_id.as_str()), (Some(RunStatus::Completed), "r1"));
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(SUMMARY_FILE)).unwrap();
        assert!(text.find("id: a").unwrap() < text.find("id: b").unwrap(), "операции отсортированы: {text}");
        let back: AgentSummary = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&text).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back.ops.len(), 2);

    #[test]
    fn atomic_write_replaces_existing_file() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = tmp.path().join("x.yaml");
        write_atomic(&path, b"one").unwrap();
        write_atomic(&path, b"two").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap(), "two");

    #[test]
    fn hist_tag_round_trips_operation_ids() {
        for id in ["http:orders:POST /v1/orders", "kafka_consume:a,b", "x%20y", "plain"] {
            let tag = hist_tag(id);
            assert!(!tag.contains(' ') && !tag.contains(','), "{tag}");
            assert_eq!(hist_untag(&tag), id);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn hist_log_has_one_tagged_line_per_operation_and_scenario() {
        let mut hist = Histogram::<u64>::new_with_bounds(1, 60_000_000, 3).unwrap();
        for v in [1_000, 2_000, 3_000] {
            hist.record(v).unwrap();
        }
        let op = |h: &Histogram<u64>| OpTotals { hist: h.clone(), n: 3, err: BTreeMap::new(), dropped: 0, bytes_in: 0, bytes_out: 0, per_second_max: 3 };
        let totals = Totals {
            ops: BTreeMap::from([("http:orders:POST /v1/orders".to_string(), op(&hist)), ("kafka_produce:orders.paid".to_string(), op(&hist))]),
            scenarios: BTreeMap::from([("order-flow".to_string(), ScTotals { hist: hist.clone(), n: 3, err: BTreeMap::new(), dropped: 1, per_second_max: 3 })]),
            seconds: 5,
        };
        let log = hist_log(&totals).unwrap();
        let tags: Vec<String> = IntervalLogIterator::new(&log)
            .filter_map(|e| match e {
                Ok(LogEntry::Interval(h)) => Some(hist_untag(h.tag().map(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or(""))),
                _ => None,
            })
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(tags, ["http:orders:POST /v1/orders", "kafka_produce:orders.paid", "scenario:order-flow"]);

        // Обратное чтение: гистограммы и число замеров восстанавливаются, секунды — из длительности.
        let back = totals_from_hist_log(&log).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back.ops.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(), ["http:orders:POST /v1/orders", "kafka_produce:orders.paid"]);
        let post = &back.ops["http:orders:POST /v1/orders"];
        assert_eq!((post.n, post.hist.len(), post.hist.max()), (3, 3, hist.max()));
        assert_eq!((back.scenarios["order-flow"].n, back.scenarios["order-flow"].hist.len()), (3, 3));
        assert_eq!(back.seconds, 5);
        // Две записи одного тега складываются (так контроллер сливает агентов, писавших по строке на секунду).
        let tagged_lines: Vec<u8> = log
            .split(|b| *b == b'\n')
            .filter(|l| l.starts_with(b"Tag="))
            .flat_map(|l| l.iter().copied().chain(std::iter::once(b'\n')))
            .collect();
        let mut twice = log.clone();
        twice.extend_from_slice(&tagged_lines);
        let merged = totals_from_hist_log(&twice).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(merged.ops["http:orders:POST /v1/orders"].hist.len(), 6);
        assert!(totals_from_hist_log(b"garbage,1,2\n").is_err(), "строка не interval log");
        assert!(totals_from_hist_log(b"Tag=x,0.000,1.000,0.000,!!!\n").is_err(), "испорченная гистограмма");
        assert!(totals_from_hist_log(b"#only a comment\n").unwrap().ops.is_empty());
    }
}
```
