- [ ] **Step 3: Реализация `run_files.rs`**

Вставь перед `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
//! Файлы прогона `runs/<дата>/` (спека L2 §6): `run.yaml`, `metrics.jsonl`, `phases.yaml`,
//! `errors.jsonl`, `summary.yaml`, `smoke.yaml`; файлы агента `hist.bin` (interval log).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, BufWriter, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

use base64::Engine as _;
use hdrhistogram::Histogram;
use hdrhistogram::serialization::interval_log::{IntervalLogIterator, IntervalLogWriterBuilder, LogEntry, Tag};
use hdrhistogram::serialization::{Deserializer, V2Serializer};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use time::OffsetDateTime;
use time::format_description::well_known::Rfc3339;

use crate::agent_api::{AgentSummary, ErrorSample, Mode, PhaseEvent, RunStatus, Tick};
use crate::metrics::{OpTotals, ScTotals, Totals, new_histogram};
use crate::summary::{SmokeReport, sorted_summary};

pub const RUNS_DIR: &str = "runs";
pub const RUN_FILE: &str = "run.yaml";
pub const METRICS_FILE: &str = "metrics.jsonl";
pub const PHASES_FILE: &str = "phases.yaml";
pub const ERRORS_FILE: &str = "errors.jsonl";
pub const SUMMARY_FILE: &str = "summary.yaml";
pub const SMOKE_FILE: &str = "smoke.yaml";
pub const HIST_FILE: &str = "hist.bin";
pub const AGENTS_DIR: &str = "agents";
/// Префикс тега сценария в `hist.bin`; id операций начинаются с `http:`, `kafka_produce:`, `kafka_consume:`
/// и с ним не пересекаются.
pub const SCENARIO_TAG: &str = "scenario:";

fn one() -> u32 {
    1
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct RunAgent {
    pub id: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub url: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default = "one")]
    pub weight: u32,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub version: Option<String>,
}

/// `run.yaml`: пишется при создании папки и дописывается `ended_at`/`status` в `finish`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct RunMeta {
    pub run_id: String,
    pub suite: String,
    pub profile: String,
    pub env: String,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub agents: Vec<RunAgent>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub project_commit: Option<String>,
    /// Сервис → версия из реестра (`last_seen.version`).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "BTreeMap::is_empty")]
    pub services: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// RFC 3339, UTC.
    pub started_at: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub ended_at: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub status: Option<RunStatus>,
}

/// Строка `metrics.jsonl`: операция (`op`) или сценарий (`scenario`) за секунду `t`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct MetricLine {
    pub t: u64,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub op: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub scenario: Option<String>,
    pub n: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub err: BTreeMap<String, u64>,
    pub dropped: u64,
    pub p50: f64,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub p90: Option<f64>,
    pub p95: f64,
    pub p99: f64,
    pub max: f64,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub bytes_in: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub bytes_out: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub lag: Option<i64>,
}

/// Строки `metrics.jsonl` одного тика: сначала операции, потом сценарии.
pub fn tick_lines(t: &Tick) -> Vec<MetricLine> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(t.ops.len() + t.scenarios.len());
    for o in &t.ops {
        out.push(MetricLine {
            t: t.t,
            op: Some(o.id.clone()),
            scenario: None,
            n: o.n,
            err: o.err.clone(),
            dropped: o.dropped,
            p50: o.p50,
            p90: Some(o.p90),
            p95: o.p95,
            p99: o.p99,
            max: o.max,
            bytes_in: Some(o.bytes_in),
            bytes_out: Some(o.bytes_out),
            lag: o.lag,
        });
    }
    for s in &t.scenarios {
        out.push(MetricLine {
            t: t.t,
            op: None,
            scenario: Some(s.id.clone()),
            n: s.n,
            err: s.err.clone(),
            dropped: s.dropped,
            p50: s.p50,
            p90: None,
            p95: s.p95,
            p99: s.p99,
            max: s.max,
            bytes_in: None,
            bytes_out: None,
            lag: None,
        });
    }
    out
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct PhasesFile {
    pub phases: Vec<PhaseEvent>,
}

/// Имя папки прогона: старт в UTC, `2026-11-02T14-30-00` или `smoke-…`.
pub fn run_dir_name(started_at: OffsetDateTime, smoke: bool) -> String {
    let t = started_at.to_offset(time::UtcOffset::UTC);
    let stamp = format!(
        "{:04}-{:02}-{:02}T{:02}-{:02}-{:02}",
        t.year(),
        u8::from(t.month()),
        t.day(),
        t.hour(),
        t.minute(),
        t.second()
    );
    if smoke { format!("smoke-{stamp}") } else { stamp }
}

pub fn now_rfc3339() -> String {
    OffsetDateTime::now_utc().format(&Rfc3339).expect("rfc3339")
}

/// Запись через временный файл рядом и переименование (Global Constraints: записи атомарны).
pub fn write_atomic(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut name = path.file_name().map(|n| n.to_os_string()).unwrap_or_default();
    name.push(".tmp");
    let tmp = path.with_file_name(name);
    {
        let mut f = File::create(&tmp)?;
        f.write_all(bytes)?;
        f.sync_all()?;
    }
    fs::rename(&tmp, path)
}

/// Тег interval log не может содержать пробел, запятую и перевод строки.
pub fn hist_tag(operation: &str) -> String {
    operation
        .replace('%', "%25")
        .replace(' ', "%20")
        .replace(',', "%2C")
        .replace('\n', "%0A")
        .replace('\r', "%0D")
}

pub fn hist_untag(tag: &str) -> String {
    tag.replace("%0D", "\r").replace("%0A", "\n").replace("%2C", ",").replace("%20", " ").replace("%25", "%")
}

/// `hist.bin`: interval log `hdrhistogram`, по строке на операцию и на сценарий за весь прогон
/// (решение плана 7); тег сценария — `scenario:<id>`.
pub fn hist_log(totals: &Totals) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut serializer = V2Serializer::new();
    {
        let mut log = IntervalLogWriterBuilder::new()
            .add_comment("glafira-load hist.bin: tag = operation id or scenario:<id>, space encoded as %20")
            .begin_log_with(&mut out, &mut serializer)
            .map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin: {e}"))?;
        let duration = Duration::from_secs(totals.seconds.max(1));
        for (operation, op) in &totals.ops {
            let tag = hist_tag(operation);
            log.write_histogram(&op.hist, Duration::ZERO, duration, Tag::new(&tag))
                .map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin `{operation}`: {e:?}"))?;
        }
        for (scenario, sc) in &totals.scenarios {
            let tag = hist_tag(&format!("{SCENARIO_TAG}{scenario}"));
            log.write_histogram(&sc.hist, Duration::ZERO, duration, Tag::new(&tag))
                .map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin scenario `{scenario}`: {e:?}"))?;
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Обратное чтение `hist.bin`: гистограммы по тегам (строки одного тега складываются), `n` — число
/// замеров в гистограмме, `per_second_max` — наибольшее число замеров в одной строке, `seconds` —
/// наибольший конец интервала. Ошибки по кодам, `dropped` и байты в interval log не хранятся и остаются
/// нулями — их контроллер берёт из суммы тиков. Строки без тега пропускаются; испорченная гистограмма — ошибка.
pub fn totals_from_hist_log(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Totals, String> {
    let mut totals = Totals { ops: BTreeMap::new(), scenarios: BTreeMap::new(), seconds: 0 };
    for (no, entry) in IntervalLogIterator::new(bytes).enumerate() {
        let entry = entry.map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin entry {}: {e:?}", no + 1))?;
        let LogEntry::Interval(interval) = entry else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(tag) = interval.tag().map(|t| hist_untag(t.as_str())) else {
            continue;
        };
        let raw = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
            .decode(interval.encoded_histogram())
            .map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin `{tag}`: base64: {e}"))?;
        let hist: Histogram<u64> = Deserializer::new()
            .deserialize(&mut &raw[..])
            .map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin `{tag}`: histogram: {e}"))?;
        let end = interval.start_timestamp() + interval.duration();
        totals.seconds = totals.seconds.max(end.as_secs_f64().ceil() as u64);
        let count = hist.len();
        if let Some(id) = tag.strip_prefix(SCENARIO_TAG) {
            let e = totals.scenarios.entry(id.to_string()).or_insert_with(|| ScTotals { hist: new_histogram(), ..Default::default() });
            e.hist.add(&hist).map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin `{tag}`: merge: {e}"))?;
            e.n += count;
            e.per_second_max = e.per_second_max.max(count);
        } else {
            let e = totals.ops.entry(tag.clone()).or_insert_with(|| OpTotals { hist: new_histogram(), ..Default::default() });
            e.hist.add(&hist).map_err(|e| format!("hist.bin `{tag}`: merge: {e}"))?;
            e.n += count;
            e.per_second_max = e.per_second_max.max(count);
        }
    }
    Ok(totals)
}

/// Писатель папки прогона. `metrics.jsonl` и `errors.jsonl` открываются при первой записи:
/// смок их не создаёт (решение плана 5).
pub struct RunWriter {
    dir: PathBuf,
    meta: RunMeta,
    metrics: Option<BufWriter<File>>,
    errors: Option<BufWriter<File>>,
    phases: Vec<PhaseEvent>,
}

impl RunWriter {
    pub fn create(dir: &Path, meta: &RunMeta) -> io::Result<Self> {
        fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
        let w = Self { dir: dir.to_path_buf(), meta: meta.clone(), metrics: None, errors: None, phases: Vec::new() };
        w.write_run()?;
        Ok(w)
    }

    pub fn dir(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.dir
    }

    pub fn meta(&self) -> &RunMeta {
        &self.meta
    }

    fn write_run(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
        write_atomic(&self.dir.join(RUN_FILE), glafira_load_model::to_yaml(&self.meta).as_bytes())
    }

    fn append(file: &mut Option<BufWriter<File>>, dir: &Path, name: &str, line: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
        if file.is_none() {
            *file = Some(BufWriter::new(OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(dir.join(name))?));
        }
        let f = file.as_mut().expect("opened above");
        f.write_all(line.as_bytes())?;
        f.write_all(b"\n")
    }

    pub fn tick(&mut self, t: &Tick) -> io::Result<()> {
        for line in tick_lines(t) {
            Self::append(&mut self.metrics, &self.dir, METRICS_FILE, &serde_json::to_string(&line)?)?;
        }
        if let Some(f) = self.metrics.as_mut() {
            f.flush()?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn phase(&mut self, p: &PhaseEvent) -> io::Result<()> {
        self.phases.push(p.clone());
        let file = PhasesFile { phases: self.phases.clone() };
        write_atomic(&self.dir.join(PHASES_FILE), glafira_load_model::to_yaml(&file).as_bytes())
    }

    pub fn error(&mut self, e: &ErrorSample) -> io::Result<()> {
        Self::append(&mut self.errors, &self.dir, ERRORS_FILE, &serde_json::to_string(e)?)?;
        if let Some(f) = self.errors.as_mut() {
            f.flush()?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn smoke(&self, report: &SmokeReport) -> io::Result<()> {
        write_atomic(&self.dir.join(SMOKE_FILE), glafira_load_model::to_yaml(report).as_bytes())
    }

    /// `summary.yaml` (операции и сценарии по id) и `run.yaml` с `ended_at` и `status`.
    pub fn finish(&mut self, summary: &AgentSummary, status: RunStatus) -> io::Result<()> {
        if let Some(f) = self.metrics.as_mut() {
            f.flush()?;
        }
        if let Some(f) = self.errors.as_mut() {
            f.flush()?;
        }
        write_atomic(&self.dir.join(SUMMARY_FILE), glafira_load_model::to_yaml(&sorted_summary(summary)).as_bytes())?;
        self.meta.ended_at = Some(now_rfc3339());
        self.meta.status = Some(status);
        self.write_run()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Сводка прогона и отчёт смока (спека L2 §6.1–§6.2).

use glafira_load_model::suite::{OnFail, Suite};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::agent_api::{AgentSummary, ErrorSample};

/// Код шага, который не выполнялся из-за ошибки предыдущего при `on_fail: stop`.
pub const SKIPPED: &str = "SKIPPED";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct SmokeStep {
    pub id: String,
    /// Id операции шага — отчёт читается без сьюта (вкладка «Прогон», Task 16).
    pub operation: String,
    pub ok: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub code: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub message: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct SmokeScenario {
    pub id: String,
    pub steps: Vec<SmokeStep>,
}

/// `smoke.yaml`: сценарий → шаг → `ok` либо код и причина.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct SmokeReport {
    pub scenarios: Vec<SmokeScenario>,
}

impl SmokeReport {
    /// Шаги сьюта в порядке объявления; ошибка шага — первый пример с его сценарием и id.
    pub fn from_errors(suite: &Suite, errors: &[ErrorSample]) -> Self {
        let scenarios = suite
            .scenarios
            .iter()
            .map(|sc| {
                let mut failed = false;
                let steps = sc
                    .step_ids()
                    .into_iter()
                    .zip(sc.steps.iter())
                    .map(|(id, step)| {
                        let operation = step.action.operation().to_string();
                        if failed && sc.on_fail == OnFail::Stop {
                            return SmokeStep { id, operation, ok: false, code: Some(SKIPPED.into()), message: Some("previous step failed".into()) };
                        }
                        match errors.iter().find(|e| e.scenario == sc.id && e.step == id) {
                            Some(e) => {
                                failed = true;
                                SmokeStep { id, operation, ok: false, code: Some(e.code.clone()), message: Some(e.message.clone()) }
                            }
                            None => SmokeStep { id, operation, ok: true, code: None, message: None },
                        }
                    })
                    .collect();
                SmokeScenario { id: sc.id.clone(), steps }
            })
            .collect();
        Self { scenarios }
    }

    pub fn failed_steps(&self) -> usize {
        self.scenarios.iter().flat_map(|s| s.steps.iter()).filter(|s| !s.ok).count()
    }

    pub fn is_ok(&self) -> bool {
        self.failed_steps() == 0
    }
}

/// Копия сводки с операциями и сценариями по id: `summary.yaml` стабилен.
pub fn sorted_summary(s: &AgentSummary) -> AgentSummary {
    let mut out = s.clone();
    out.ops.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.cmp(&b.id));
    out.scenarios.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.cmp(&b.id));
    out
}

scenarios:

        let back: SmokeReport = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&text).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back, report);
    }
}
```

```rust
/// Разбор набора данных из памяти (бандл агента): формат — по расширению `file_name`
/// (путь из `suite.data[*].path`), содержимое — UTF-8.
pub fn parse_data(file_name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<DataTable, String> {
    let format = DataFormat::from_path(file_name)?;
    let text = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|e| format!("`{file_name}` is not UTF-8: {e}"))?;
    parse_table(format, text)
}

/// Колонки и число строк файла данных для `suite::check`: CSV с заголовком или JSON Lines
/// (колонки — объединение ключей всех строк, по алфавиту). `None` — файла нет или он не читается.
/// `path` — относительно `root`, как в `suite.data[*].path`.
pub fn data_info(root: &Path, path: &str) -> Option<glafira_load_model::suite::check::DataInfo> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(path)).ok()?;
    if path.to_ascii_lowercase().ends_with(".jsonl") {
        let mut columns = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        let mut rows = 0;
        for line in text.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()) {
            let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(line).ok()?;
            if let Some(object) = value.as_object() {
                columns.extend(object.keys().cloned());
            }
            rows += 1;
        }
        return Some(glafira_load_model::suite::check::DataInfo { columns: columns.into_iter().collect(), rows });
    }
    let mut reader = csv::Reader::from_reader(text.as_bytes());
    let columns = reader.headers().ok()?.iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let rows = reader.records().filter(|r| r.is_ok()).count();
    Some(glafira_load_model::suite::check::DataInfo { columns, rows })
}
```

Вставь перед `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
//! Связь контроллера с агентом: трейт `AgentLink`, ошибки и встроенный агент `LocalAgent`
//! (решение плана 8): тот же путь «start → events → stop → files», что у HTTP-агента, но в процессе.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::io;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use async_trait::async_trait;
use futures::StreamExt;
use futures::future::BoxFuture;
use futures::stream::BoxStream;
use glafira_load_model::suite::{self, Suite};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
use tokio_stream::wrappers::UnboundedReceiverStream;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use crate::agent_api::{AgentInfo, AgentSummary, ErrorSample, Event, PhaseEvent, RunRequest, RunStatus, Tick};
use crate::context::{DataTable, RunContext, parse_data};
use crate::executor::{Executors, StepExecutor};
use crate::metrics::{Recorder, SharedRecorder, summary};
use crate::run_files::{ERRORS_FILE, HIST_FILE, METRICS_FILE, SUMMARY_FILE, hist_log, tick_lines};
use crate::scheduler::{Scheduler, SchedulerConfig};
use crate::summary::sorted_summary;

/// Версия движка: сравнивается с версией контроллера по `major.minor` (Global Constraints).
pub const VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");
/// Префикс переменных окружения с секретами стенда.
pub const SECRET_PREFIX: &str = "GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_";
/// Сколько встроенный агент ждёт активные итерации после конца таймлайна или остановки.
pub const DRAIN: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);

/// Ошибка связи с агентом; коды: `AGENT_UNREACHABLE`, `AGENT_BUSY`, `AGENT_VERSION`,
/// `SECRET_MISSING`, `SUITE_INVALID`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `NOT_FOUND`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("{code}: {message}")]
pub struct LinkError {
    pub code: String,
    pub message: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub names: Vec<String>,
}

impl LinkError {
    pub fn new(code: &str, message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self { code: code.into(), message: message.into(), names: Vec::new() }
    }

    pub fn with_names(mut self, names: Vec<String>) -> Self {
        self.names = names;
        self
    }
}

/// Ошибка контроллера и локального прогона; `agent` — виновный агент, если есть.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("{code}: {message}")]
pub struct EngineError {
    pub code: String,
    pub message: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub names: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub agent: Option<String>,
}

impl EngineError {
    pub fn new(code: &str, message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self { code: code.into(), message: message.into(), names: Vec::new(), agent: None }
    }

    pub fn with_names(mut self, names: Vec<String>) -> Self {
        self.names = names;
        self
    }

    pub fn with_agent(mut self, agent: &str) -> Self {
        self.agent = Some(agent.into());
        self
    }

    /// Ошибка файловой системы: код `IO`.
    pub fn io(message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self::new("IO", message)
    }

    /// Ошибка связи с конкретным агентом: код, текст и имена — из `LinkError`, `agent` — виновник.
    pub fn from_link(e: LinkError, agent: &str) -> Self {
        Self { code: e.code, message: e.message, names: e.names, agent: Some(agent.into()) }
    }
}

impl From<LinkError> for EngineError {
    fn from(e: LinkError) -> Self {
        Self { code: e.code, message: e.message, names: e.names, agent: None }
    }
}

impl From<io::Error> for EngineError {
    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::new("IO", e.to_string())
    }
}

/// Итог прогона; поля — snake_case, как `run.yaml` (фронтенд Task 14 читает `run_id`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct RunResult {
    pub run_id: String,
    /// Абсолютный путь папки прогона.
    pub dir: String,
    pub status: RunStatus,
    pub summary: AgentSummary,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum AgentState {
    Ready,
    Running,
    Lost,
    Done,
    Failed,
}

/// События контроллера для CLI и окна прогона: тег `type`, поля без переименования (`run_id`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ControllerEvent {
    Started { run_id: String, dir: String },
    Tick(Tick),
    Phase(PhaseEvent),
    Agent { id: String, state: AgentState },
    Error(ErrorSample),
    Done(RunResult),
}

#[async_trait]
pub trait AgentLink: Send + Sync {
    fn id(&self) -> &str;
    async fn info(&self) -> Result<AgentInfo, LinkError>;
    /// `data`: имя набора из `suite.data` → байты файла (для `slice` — строки этого агента).
    async fn start(&self, req: &RunRequest, suite_text: &str, data: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Result<(), LinkError>;
    async fn events(&self, run_id: &str, last_id: Option<u64>) -> Result<BoxStream<'static, (u64, Event)>, LinkError>;
    async fn stop(&self, run_id: &str) -> Result<(), LinkError>;
    /// tar с `metrics.jsonl`, `errors.jsonl`, `summary.yaml`, `hist.bin` (и `agent.log` у HTTP-агента).
    async fn files(&self, run_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LinkError>;
}

/// `major.minor` версий совпадают.
pub fn same_minor(a: &str, b: &str) -> bool {
    let head = |v: &str| v.split('.').take(2).map(str::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    head(a) == head(b)
}

/// Секреты по именам через `get(GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_<ИМЯ>)`; ошибка — отсортированные имена отсутствующих.
pub fn secrets_from(names: &[String], get: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<String>) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, Vec<String>> {
    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    for name in names {
        match get(&format!("{SECRET_PREFIX}{name}")) {
            Some(v) => {
                out.insert(name.clone(), v);
            }
            None => missing.push(name.clone()),
        }
    }
    if missing.is_empty() {
        Ok(out)
    } else {
        missing.sort();
        Err(missing)
    }
}

pub fn secrets_from_env(names: &[String]) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, Vec<String>> {
    secrets_from(names, |k| std::env::var(k).ok())
}

/// Таблицы наборов сьюта из байтов бандла; формат — по расширению `data[*].path`.
pub fn data_tables(suite: &Suite, data: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, DataTable>, String> {
    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
    for (name, set) in &suite.data {
        let bytes = data.get(name).ok_or_else(|| format!("data set `{name}` was not provided"))?;
        let table = parse_data(&set.path, bytes).map_err(|e| format!("data set `{name}` ({}): {e}", set.path))?;
        out.insert(name.clone(), table);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// tar в памяти из именованных файлов.
pub fn agent_tar(files: &[(&str, &[u8])]) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mtime = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut builder = tar::Builder::new(Vec::new());
    for (name, bytes) in files {
        let mut header = tar::Header::new_gnu();
        header.set_size(bytes.len() as u64);
        header.set_mode(0o644);
        header.set_mtime(mtime);
        builder.append_data(&mut header, name, *bytes)?;
    }
    builder.into_inner()
}

/// Фабрика исполнителей прогона: HTTP всегда, Kafka — если в сьюте есть шаги Kafka.
/// Контекст даёт значения секретов (маскирование в примерах ошибок).
pub type ExecutorFactory =
    Arc<dyn Fn(RunRequest, Suite, Arc<RunContext>) -> BoxFuture<'static, Result<Executors, EngineError>> + Send + Sync>;

struct ActiveRun {
    run_id: String,
    cancel: CancellationToken,
    events: Option<mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<(u64, Event)>>,
    task: Option<JoinHandle<Vec<u8>>>,
}

/// Встроенный агент: исполняет прогон в текущем процессе.
pub struct LocalAgent {
    id: String,
    factory: ExecutorFactory,
    /// Секреты `имя → значение` вместо окружения процесса (агент Task 10 собирает их сам).
    secrets: Option<BTreeMap<String, String>>,
    active: Mutex<Option<ActiveRun>>,
}

/// Файлы агента, собираемые из потока событий.
#[derive(Default)]
struct AgentFiles {
    metrics: Vec<u8>,
    errors: Vec<u8>,
    summary: Option<AgentSummary>,
    hist: Vec<u8>,
    next_id: u64,
}

impl AgentFiles {
    fn tar(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let summary = self.summary.as_ref().map(|s| glafira_load_model::to_yaml(&sorted_summary(s))).unwrap_or_default();
        agent_tar(&[
            (METRICS_FILE, self.metrics.as_slice()),
            (ERRORS_FILE, self.errors.as_slice()),
            (SUMMARY_FILE, summary.as_bytes()),
            (HIST_FILE, self.hist.as_slice()),
        ])
        .unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

/// Нумерует события, копит `metrics.jsonl`/`errors.jsonl` агента и отдаёт их наружу.
async fn forward_events(mut rx: mpsc::Receiver<Event>, out: mpsc::UnboundedSender<(u64, Event)>) -> AgentFiles {
    let mut files = AgentFiles { next_id: 1, ..Default::default() };
    while let Some(ev) = rx.recv().await {
        match &ev {
            Event::Tick(t) => {
                for line in tick_lines(t) {
                    if serde_json::to_writer(&mut files.metrics, &line).is_ok() {
                        files.metrics.push(b'\n');
                    }
                }
            }
            Event::Error(e) => {
                if serde_json::to_writer(&mut files.errors, e).is_ok() {
                    files.errors.push(b'\n');
                }
            }
            Event::Done(s) => files.summary = Some(s.clone()),
            Event::Phase(_) | Event::Gap => {}
        }
        let id = files.next_id;
        files.next_id += 1;
        // Получатель мог отключиться: события дальше не нужны, но планировщик должен дожить до конца.
        let _ = out.send((id, ev));
    }
    files
}

async fn run_task(
    req: RunRequest,
    suite: Arc<Suite>,
    run_ctx: Arc<RunContext>,
    executors: Arc<Executors>,
    out: mpsc::UnboundedSender<(u64, Event)>,
    cancel: CancellationToken,
) -> Vec<u8> {
    let recorder: SharedRecorder = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Recorder::new()));
    let cfg = SchedulerConfig {
        targets: req.targets.clone(),
        timeline: req.timeline.clone(),
        total_minutes: req.total_minutes,
        arrival: req.arrival,
        max_in_flight: req.max_in_flight,
        mode: req.mode,
        drain: DRAIN,
    };
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<Event>(1024);
    let forward = tokio::spawn(forward_events(rx, out.clone()));
    let executor: Arc<dyn StepExecutor> = executors;
    let status = Scheduler::run(suite, cfg, run_ctx, executor, recorder.clone(), tx, cancel).await;
    // Отправитель планировщика сброшен: пересылка доходит до конца.
    let mut files = forward.await.unwrap_or_default();
    let totals = recorder.lock().expect("recorder").finish();
    files.hist = hist_log(&totals).unwrap_or_default();
    if files.summary.is_none() {
        let s = summary(&totals, &req.targets, status);
        files.summary = Some(s.clone());
        let id = files.next_id;
        files.next_id += 1;
        let _ = out.send((id, Event::Done(s)));
    }
    files.tar()
}

impl LocalAgent {
    pub fn new(id: &str, factory: ExecutorFactory) -> Self {
        Self { id: id.into(), factory, secrets: None, active: Mutex::new(None) }
    }

    /// Секреты из карты `имя → значение` (без префикса) вместо переменных окружения процесса.
    pub fn with_secrets(mut self, secrets: BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Self {
        self.secrets = Some(secrets);
        self
    }

    fn secrets_for(&self, names: &[String]) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, Vec<String>> {
        match &self.secrets {
            Some(map) => secrets_from(names, |key| key.strip_prefix(SECRET_PREFIX).and_then(|name| map.get(name).cloned())),
            None => secrets_from_env(names),
        }
    }

    /// `run_id` идущего прогона.
    pub fn is_busy(&self) -> Option<String> {
        let guard = self.active.lock().expect("active run");
        guard
            .as_ref()
            .filter(|r| r.task.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| !t.is_finished()))
            .map(|r| r.run_id.clone())
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl AgentLink for LocalAgent {
    fn id(&self) -> &str {
        &self.id
    }

    async fn info(&self) -> Result<AgentInfo, LinkError> {
        Ok(AgentInfo {
            version: VERSION.into(),
            os: std::env::consts::OS.into(),
            arch: std::env::consts::ARCH.into(),
            cpus: std::thread::available_parallelism().map(|n| n.get()).unwrap_or(1),
            busy: self.is_busy(),
        })
    }

    async fn start(&self, req: &RunRequest, suite_text: &str, data: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        if let Some(run_id) = self.is_busy() {
            return Err(LinkError::new("AGENT_BUSY", format!("agent is running {run_id}")).with_names(vec![run_id]));
        }
        if !same_minor(&req.controller_version, VERSION) {
            return Err(LinkError::new("AGENT_VERSION", format!("controller {} and agent {VERSION} differ", req.controller_version)));
        }
        if req.suite_format != suite::FORMAT {
            return Err(LinkError::new("AGENT_VERSION", format!("suite format {} is not supported, agent expects {}", req.suite_format, suite::FORMAT)));
        }
        let parsed = suite::parse(suite_text).map_err(|e| {
            let at = e.line.map(|l| format!("line {l}: ")).unwrap_or_default();
            LinkError::new("SUITE_INVALID", format!("{at}{}", e.message))
        })?;
        let secrets = self
            .secrets_for(&req.secrets)
            .map_err(|names| LinkError::new("SECRET_MISSING", format!("missing {SECRET_PREFIX}* variables")).with_names(names))?;
        let tables = data_tables(&parsed, data).map_err(|m| LinkError::new("SUITE_INVALID", m))?;
        let run_ctx = Arc::new(RunContext {
            run_id: req.run_id.clone(),
            agent_id: req.agent_id.clone(),
            env: req.env.clone(),
            secrets,
            data: tables,
        });
        let executors = (self.factory)(req.clone(), parsed.clone(), run_ctx.clone())
            .await
            .map_err(|e| LinkError { code: e.code, message: e.message, names: e.names })?;
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let cancel = CancellationToken::new();
        let task = tokio::spawn(run_task(req.clone(), Arc::new(parsed), run_ctx, Arc::new(executors), tx, cancel.clone()));
        *self.active.lock().expect("active run") =
            Some(ActiveRun { run_id: req.run_id.clone(), cancel, events: Some(rx), task: Some(task) });
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Поток читается один раз; `last_id` не нужен — события в процессе не теряются.
    async fn events(&self, run_id: &str, _last_id: Option<u64>) -> Result<BoxStream<'static, (u64, Event)>, LinkError> {
        let mut guard = self.active.lock().expect("active run");
        let run = guard
            .as_mut()
            .filter(|r| r.run_id == run_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| LinkError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("run {run_id} is not on this agent")))?;
        let rx = run.events.take().ok_or_else(|| LinkError::new("RUN_BUSY", "events of a local run are read once"))?;
        Ok(UnboundedReceiverStream::new(rx).boxed())
    }

    async fn stop(&self, run_id: &str) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        let guard = self.active.lock().expect("active run");
        let run = guard
            .as_ref()
            .filter(|r| r.run_id == run_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| LinkError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("run {run_id} is not on this agent")))?;
        run.cancel.cancel();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Ждёт конца прогона и отдаёт tar; после этого агент свободен.
    async fn files(&self, run_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LinkError> {
        let task = {
            let mut guard = self.active.lock().expect("active run");
            let run = guard
                .as_mut()
                .filter(|r| r.run_id == run_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| LinkError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("run {run_id} is not on this agent")))?;
            run.task.take().ok_or_else(|| LinkError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("files of run {run_id} were already taken")))?
        };
        let bytes = task.await.map_err(|e| LinkError::new("AGENT_UNREACHABLE", format!("local run task failed: {e}")))?;
        let mut guard = self.active.lock().expect("active run");
        if guard.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.run_id == run_id) {
            *guard = None;
        }
        Ok(bytes)
    }
}
```

```rust
        std::fs::write(tmp.path().join(".git/HEAD"), "ref: refs/heads/main\n").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(tmp.path().join(".git/refs/heads/main"), "abc123\n").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(project_commit(tmp.path()).as_deref(), Some("abc123"));
        std::fs::write(tmp.path().join(".git/HEAD"), "deadbeef\n").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(project_commit(tmp.path()).as_deref(), Some("deadbeef"));
        assert_eq!(project_commit(&tmp.path().join("nope")), None);
    }

    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
    async fn smoke_writes_run_and_smoke_yaml_without_metrics() {
        let http = stub().await;
        let tmp = project(&http, 0.05);
        let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
        let res = run_local(request(tmp.path(), "", Mode::Smoke, None), tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(res.status, RunStatus::Completed);
        let dir = PathBuf::from(&res.dir);
        assert!(dir.starts_with(tmp.path().join(RUNS_DIR)));
        assert!(dir.file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap().starts_with("smoke-"));
        assert!(dir.join("run.yaml").is_file() && dir.join("smoke.yaml").is_file());
        assert!(!dir.join("metrics.jsonl").exists(), "смок не пишет metrics.jsonl");
        let smoke: SmokeReport = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("smoke.yaml")).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert!(smoke.is_ok(), "{smoke:?}");
        assert_eq!(smoke.scenarios[0].steps.iter().map(|s| s.id.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), ["create", "get"]);
        let run: RunMeta = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("run.yaml")).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(run.status, Some(RunStatus::Completed));
        assert!(run.ended_at.is_some() && run.profile.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(run.services.get("orders").map(String::as_str), Some("1.2.0"));
        assert_eq!(run.agents[0].id, LOCAL_AGENT_ID);
        assert!(dir.join("agents/local/summary.yaml").is_file());
        let mut kinds = Vec::new();
        while let Ok(ev) = rx.try_recv() {
            kinds.push(match ev {
                ControllerEvent::Started { .. } => "started",
                ControllerEvent::Agent { .. } => "agent",
                ControllerEvent::Done(_) => "done",
                ControllerEvent::Tick(_) => "tick",
                ControllerEvent::Phase(_) | ControllerEvent::Error(_) => "other",
            });
        }
        assert_eq!(kinds.first().copied(), Some("started"));
        assert_eq!(kinds.last().copied(), Some("done"));
        assert!(!kinds.contains(&"tick"), "в смоке графиков нет: {kinds:?}");
    }

    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
    async fn run_profile_for_three_seconds_writes_metrics_and_summary() {
        let http = stub().await;
        let tmp = project(&http, 0.05);
        let out = tmp.path().join("out");
        let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(4096);
        let res = run_local(request(tmp.path(), "quick", Mode::Run, Some(out.clone())), tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(res.status, RunStatus::Completed);
        assert_eq!(PathBuf::from(&res.dir), out);
        let metrics = std::fs::read_to_string(out.join("metrics.jsonl")).unwrap();
        assert!(metrics.lines().count() >= 2, "{metrics}");
        assert!(metrics.contains("\"op\":\"http:orders:POST /v1/orders\"") && metrics.contains("\"scenario\":\"order-flow\""), "{metrics}");
        let summary: AgentSummary = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(out.join("summary.yaml")).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let post = summary.ops.iter().find(|o| o.id == "http:orders:POST /v1/orders").expect("summary of the driving operation");
        assert!(post.n > 0 && post.achieved_pct.is_some(), "{post:?}");
        assert_eq!(post.target, Some(20.0));
        assert_eq!(res.summary, summary);
        assert!(out.join("agents/local/hist.bin").is_file() && out.join("agents/local/metrics.jsonl").is_file());
        let run: RunMeta = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(out.join("run.yaml")).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((run.status, run.profile.as_str(), run.mode), (Some(RunStatus::Completed), "quick", Mode::Run));
        let mut ticks = 0;
        while let Ok(ev) = rx.try_recv() {
            if matches!(ev, ControllerEvent::Tick(_)) {
                ticks += 1;
            }
        }
        assert!(ticks >= 2, "ticks = {ticks}");
    }

    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
    async fn cancel_stops_the_run_with_status_stopped() {
        let http = stub().await;
        let tmp = project(&http, 10.0);
        let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(4096);
        let cancel = CancellationToken::new();
        let req = LocalRun { max_in_flight: Some(50), ..request(tmp.path(), "quick", Mode::Run, None) };
        let handle = tokio::spawn({
            let cancel = cancel.clone();
            async move { run_local(req, tx, cancel).await }
        });
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
        cancel.cancel();
        let res = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(15), handle).await.expect("stops within 15 s").unwrap().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(res.status, RunStatus::Stopped);
        let run: RunMeta = glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(PathBuf::from(&res.dir).join("run.yaml")).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(run.status, Some(RunStatus::Stopped));
        rx.close();
    }

    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
    async fn startup_errors_have_codes_and_names() {
        let http = stub().await;
        let tmp = project(&http, 0.05);

        let missing_env = run_local(LocalRun { env: "prod".into(), ..request(tmp.path(), "quick", Mode::Run, None) }, tx.clone(), CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(missing_env.code, "NOT_FOUND");
        let missing_profile = run_local(request(tmp.path(), "nope", Mode::Run, None), tx.clone(), CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(missing_profile.code, "NOT_FOUND");
        write(tmp.path(), "suites/secret/suite.yaml", &SUITE.replace("name: orders-http\n", "name: secret\nsecrets: [ORDERS_TOKEN]\n"));
        let missing_secret = run_local(LocalRun { suite: "secret".into(), ..request(tmp.path(), "quick", Mode::Run, None) }, tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!((missing_secret.code.as_str(), missing_secret.names), ("SECRET_MISSING", vec!["ORDERS_TOKEN".to_string()]));
        assert!(!tmp.path().join(RUNS_DIR).exists(), "папка прогона не создаётся при ошибке запуска");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Локальный прогон (спека L2 §4.6): проект → `RunRequest` → `LocalAgent` → `runs/<дата>/`.
//! Путь тот же, что у контроллера с HTTP-агентами: start, events, stop, files.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;

use futures::StreamExt;
use glafira_load_model::profile::{Computed, PROFILE_FILE, ProfileError, ProfileFile, compute};
use glafira_load_model::prod_load::{PROD_LOAD_FILE, ProdLoad};
use glafira_load_model::project::{Environment, MANIFEST_FILE, Manifest};
use glafira_load_model::registry::{REGISTRY_FILE, Registry, Status};
use glafira_load_model::schema::SchemaSummary;
use glafira_load_model::suite::check::{DataInfo, Level, check};
use glafira_load_model::suite::{self, Action, Encoding, SUITE_FILE, SUITES_DIR, Suite};
use time::OffsetDateTime;
use tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use crate::agent_api::{AgentSummary, EnvAddresses, ErrorSample, Event, Mode, RunRequest, RunStatus};
use crate::agent_link::{AgentLink, AgentState, ControllerEvent, EngineError, ExecutorFactory, LocalAgent, RunResult, VERSION, secrets_from_env};
use crate::context::{RunContext, is_inside_project, parse_data};
use crate::executor::{Executors, StepExecutor};
use crate::http::HttpExecutor;
use crate::kafka::{KafkaExecutor, topic_of};
use crate::run_files::{AGENTS_DIR, RUNS_DIR, RunAgent, RunMeta, RunWriter, now_rfc3339, run_dir_name};
use crate::summary::SmokeReport;

/// Id встроенного агента в `run.yaml` и `agents/<id>/`.
pub const LOCAL_AGENT_ID: &str = "local";

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct LocalRun {
    pub root: PathBuf,
    pub suite: String,
    /// Пусто в режиме `smoke`: цели не считаются.
    pub profile: String,
    pub env: String,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
    /// Папка результата; по умолчанию `runs/<дата>/` в проекте.
    pub out: Option<PathBuf>,
}

/// Файлы проекта, нужные прогону.
pub struct Project {
    pub manifest: Manifest,
    pub registry: Registry,
    pub prod: ProdLoad,
    pub profiles: ProfileFile,
}

fn read_yaml<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(root: &Path, rel: &str) -> Result<T, EngineError> {
    let path = root.join(rel);
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(|e| EngineError::new("IO", format!("{}: {e}", path.display())))?;
    glafira_load_model::from_yaml(&text).map_err(|e| {
        let at = e.line.map(|l| format!(":{l}")).unwrap_or_default();
        EngineError::new("INVALID_INPUT", format!("{rel}{at}: {}", e.message))
    })
}

fn read_yaml_or_default<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned + Default>(root: &Path, rel: &str) -> Result<T, EngineError> {
    if root.join(rel).is_file() { read_yaml(root, rel) } else { Ok(T::default()) }
}

pub fn load_project(root: &Path) -> Result<Project, EngineError> {
    if !root.join(MANIFEST_FILE).is_file() {
        return Err(EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("{} has no {MANIFEST_FILE}", root.display())));
    }
    Ok(Project {
        manifest: read_yaml(root, MANIFEST_FILE)?,
        registry: read_yaml_or_default(root, REGISTRY_FILE)?,
        prod: read_yaml_or_default(root, PROD_LOAD_FILE)?,
        profiles: read_yaml_or_default(root, PROFILE_FILE)?,
    })
}

/// Сьют после `check` и байты его наборов данных.
pub struct LoadedSuite {
    pub name: String,
    pub text: String,
    pub suite: Suite,
    pub data: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}

/// Читает `suites/<name>/suite.yaml`, данные с диска и выполняет `check`; ошибки — `SUITE_INVALID`
/// со списком `file:line: message` в `names`.
pub fn load_suite(root: &Path, name: &str, registry: &Registry, env: Option<&Environment>) -> Result<LoadedSuite, EngineError> {
    let rel = format!("{SUITES_DIR}/{name}/{SUITE_FILE}");
    let path = root.join(&rel);
    if !path.is_file() {
        return Err(EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("suite `{name}` not found: {}", path.display())));
    }
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(|e| EngineError::new("IO", format!("{}: {e}", path.display())))?;
    let mut data = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut infos: BTreeMap<String, Option<DataInfo>> = BTreeMap::new();
    // Ошибки разбора покажет `check`; здесь нужны только пути наборов.
    if let Ok(parsed) = suite::parse(&text) {
        for (set, spec) in &parsed.data {
            // Путь вне проекта — `PATH_OUTSIDE_PROJECT` сообщит `check`; файл не читаем.
            let bytes = if is_inside_project(&spec.path) { std::fs::read(root.join(&spec.path)).ok() } else { None };
            let info = bytes
                .as_deref()
                .and_then(|b| parse_data(&spec.path, b).ok())
                .map(|t| DataInfo { columns: t.columns.clone(), rows: t.rows.len() });
            infos.insert(set.clone(), info);
            if let Some(b) = bytes {
                data.insert(set.clone(), b);
            }
        }
    }
    let (parsed, findings) = check(&text, &rel, registry, &infos, env);
    let errors: Vec<String> = findings
        .iter()
        .filter(|f| f.level == Level::Error)
        .map(|f| match f.line {
            Some(l) => format!("{}:{l}: {}", f.file, f.message),
            None => format!("{}: {}", f.file, f.message),
        })
        .collect();
    let Some(suite) = parsed.filter(|_| errors.is_empty()) else {
        let count = errors.len().max(1);
        return Err(EngineError::new("SUITE_INVALID", format!("{count} error(s) in {rel}")).with_names(errors));
    };
    Ok(LoadedSuite { name: name.into(), text, suite, data })
}

/// Цели операций из расчёта профиля.
pub fn targets_of(computed: &Computed) -> BTreeMap<String, f64> {
    computed.targets.iter().map(|t| (t.id.clone(), t.target)).collect()
}

/// Тексты `.avsc` для `kafka_produce` с `encoding: avro`: путь из `kafka.topics` сервиса в манифесте,
/// иначе `source.path` операции; относительно клона сервиса.
pub fn avro_schema_texts(root: &Path, manifest: &Manifest, registry: &Registry, suite: &Suite) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, EngineError> {
    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
    for step in suite.scenarios.iter().flat_map(|s| s.steps.iter()) {
        let Action::KafkaProduce(p) = &step.action else {
            continue;
        };
        if p.encoding != Encoding::Avro || out.contains_key(&p.operation) {
            continue;
        }
        let op = registry
            .get(&p.operation)
            .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::new("SUITE_INVALID", format!("operation `{}` is not in the registry", p.operation)))?;
        let service = manifest.service(&op.draft.service).ok_or_else(|| {
            EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("service `{}` of `{}` is not in the manifest", op.draft.service, p.operation))
        })?;
        let topic = topic_of(&p.operation).unwrap_or_default();
        let rel = service.kafka.topics.get(topic).map(|t| t.schema().to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| op.draft.source.path.clone());
        let base = if Path::new(&service.path).is_absolute() { PathBuf::from(&service.path) } else { root.join(&service.path) };
        let path = base.join(&rel);
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
            .map_err(|e| EngineError::new("IO", format!("Avro schema of `{}` at {}: {e}", p.operation, path.display())))?;
        out.insert(p.operation.clone(), text);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Коммит проекта из `.git` без запуска git: `HEAD` → ссылка → файл ссылки или `packed-refs`.
pub fn project_commit(root: &Path) -> Option<String> {
    let git = root.join(".git");
    let head = std::fs::read_to_string(git.join("HEAD")).ok()?;
    let head = head.trim();
    let Some(reference) = head.strip_prefix("ref: ") else {
        return Some(head.to_string());
    };
    if let Ok(hash) = std::fs::read_to_string(git.join(reference)) {
        return Some(hash.trim().to_string());
    }
    let packed = std::fs::read_to_string(git.join("packed-refs")).ok()?;
    packed.lines().find_map(|line| {
        let (hash, name) = line.split_once(' ')?;
        (name == reference).then(|| hash.to_string())
    })
}

/// Сервис → версия из `last_seen` активных операций реестра.
pub fn service_versions(registry: &Registry) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
    for op in registry.operations.iter().filter(|o| o.status == Status::Active) {
        if !op.last_seen.version.is_empty() {
            out.insert(op.draft.service.clone(), op.last_seen.version.clone());
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Схемы ответов операций реестра (`id → SchemaSummary`) — поле `RunRequest.response_schemas`.
pub fn response_schemas_of(registry: &Registry) -> BTreeMap<String, SchemaSummary> {
    registry.operations.iter().filter_map(|o| o.draft.response.clone().map(|s| (o.draft.id.clone(), s))).collect()
}

/// Фабрика исполнителей для `LocalAgent` (локальный прогон и агент Task 10): HTTP со схемами ответов
/// из `RunRequest.response_schemas`; Kafka — если в сьюте есть шаги Kafka, со схемами `.avsc` из
/// `RunRequest.avro_schemas`. Реестр проекта фабрике не нужен — всё приходит в запросе.
pub fn executor_factory() -> ExecutorFactory {
    Arc::new(|req: RunRequest, suite: Suite, ctx: Arc<RunContext>| {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let steps = || suite.scenarios.iter().flat_map(|s| s.steps.iter());
            let topics: Vec<String> = steps()
                .filter_map(|st| match &st.action {
                    Action::KafkaConsume(c) => topic_of(&c.operation).map(str::to_string),
                    _ => None,
                })
                .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
                .into_iter()
                .collect();
            let needs_kafka = steps().any(|st| matches!(st.action, Action::KafkaProduce(_) | Action::KafkaConsume(_)));
            let secrets: Vec<String> = ctx.secrets.values().cloned().collect();
            let http = HttpExecutor::new(req.env.http.as_deref().unwrap_or(""), &suite.defaults.http, &secrets)
                .map_err(|m| EngineError::new("INVALID_INPUT", m))?
                .with_schemas(req.response_schemas.clone());
            let kafka: Option<Box<dyn StepExecutor>> = if needs_kafka {
                let bootstrap = req
                    .env
                    .kafka
                    .clone()
                    .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::new("INVALID_INPUT", "the environment has no kafka address"))?;
                let executor = KafkaExecutor::new(&bootstrap, &req.kafka, &topics, &req.run_id, &req.agent_id, req.env.schema_registry.clone(), &req.avro_schemas)
                    .await
                    .map_err(|m| EngineError::new("KAFKA_CONSUME", m))?;
                Some(Box::new(executor))
            } else {
                None
            };
            Ok(Executors { http, kafka })
        })
    })
}

/// Запуск агента, чтение событий, запись тиков и сбор файлов; остановка по `cancel`.
async fn drive(
    agent: &LocalAgent,
    request: &RunRequest,
    loaded: &LoadedSuite,
    writer: &mut RunWriter,
    events: &Sender<ControllerEvent>,
    cancel: &CancellationToken,
) -> Result<(AgentSummary, Vec<ErrorSample>), EngineError> {
    let smoke = request.mode == Mode::Smoke;
    agent.start(request, &loaded.text, &loaded.data).await.map_err(|e| EngineError::from(e).with_agent(LOCAL_AGENT_ID))?;
    let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id: LOCAL_AGENT_ID.into(), state: AgentState::Running }).await;
    let mut stream = agent.events(&request.run_id, None).await?;
    let mut errors = Vec::new();
    let mut stopped = false;
    let summary = loop {
        let next = tokio::select! {
            _ = cancel.cancelled(), if !stopped => {
                stopped = true;
                agent.stop(&request.run_id).await?;
                continue;
            }
            next = stream.next() => next,
        };
        let Some((_, event)) = next else {
            return Err(EngineError::new("AGENT_UNREACHABLE", "local agent ended without `done`").with_agent(LOCAL_AGENT_ID));
        };
        match event {
            Event::Tick(t) => {
                // Смок — без графиков и metrics.jsonl (решение плана 5).
                if !smoke {
                    writer.tick(&t)?;
                    let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Tick(t)).await;
                }
            }
            Event::Phase(p) => {
                writer.phase(&p)?;
                let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Phase(p)).await;
            }
            Event::Error(e) => {
                writer.error(&e)?;
                errors.push(e.clone());
                let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Error(e)).await;
            }
            Event::Done(s) => break s,
            Event::Gap => {}
        }
    };
    let tar = agent.files(&request.run_id).await?;
    let agent_dir = writer.dir().join(AGENTS_DIR).join(LOCAL_AGENT_ID);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&agent_dir)?;
    tar::Archive::new(&tar[..]).unpack(&agent_dir)?;
    let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id: LOCAL_AGENT_ID.into(), state: AgentState::Done }).await;
    Ok((summary, errors))
}

/// Локальный прогон или смок проекта. Ошибки до создания папки — коды `NOT_FOUND`, `IO`,
/// `INVALID_INPUT`, `SUITE_INVALID`, `SECRET_MISSING`; после — папка получает `status: failed`.
pub async fn run_local(req: LocalRun, events: Sender<ControllerEvent>, cancel: CancellationToken) -> Result<RunResult, EngineError> {
    let root = req.root.clone();
    let project = load_project(&root)?;
    let env = project
        .manifest
        .environments
        .iter()
        .find(|e| e.id == req.env)
        .cloned()
        .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("environment `{}` is not in the manifest", req.env)))?;
    let loaded = load_suite(&root, &req.suite, &project.registry, Some(&env))?;
    let smoke = req.mode == Mode::Smoke;
    let computed = if smoke && req.profile.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(compute(&project.profiles, &req.profile, &project.registry, &project.prod).map_err(|e| {
            let code = match e {
                ProfileError::UnknownProfile(_) => "NOT_FOUND",
                _ => "INVALID_INPUT",
            };
            EngineError::new(code, e.to_string())
        })?)
    };
    let secret_names = loaded.suite.secrets.clone();
    secrets_from_env(&secret_names)
        .map_err(|names| EngineError::new("SECRET_MISSING", "secrets are missing in the environment (GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_*)").with_names(names))?;
    let avro = avro_schema_texts(&root, &project.manifest, &project.registry, &loaded.suite)?;

    let run_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let request = RunRequest {
        run_id: run_id.clone(),
        agent_id: LOCAL_AGENT_ID.into(),
        suite_name: loaded.name.clone(),
        controller_version: VERSION.into(),
        suite_format: loaded.suite.format,
        env: EnvAddresses { http: env.http.clone(), kafka: env.kafka.clone(), schema_registry: env.schema_registry.clone() },
        secrets: secret_names,
        targets: computed.as_ref().map(targets_of).unwrap_or_default(),
        timeline: computed.as_ref().map(|c| c.timeline.clone()).unwrap_or_default(),
        total_minutes: computed.as_ref().map(|c| c.total_minutes).unwrap_or(0.0),
        max_in_flight: req.max_in_flight.unwrap_or(loaded.suite.defaults.max_in_flight),
        arrival: loaded.suite.defaults.arrival,
        mode: req.mode,
        kafka: loaded.suite.defaults.kafka.clone(),
        response_schemas: response_schemas_of(&project.registry),
        avro_schemas: avro,
    };
    let started = OffsetDateTime::now_utc();
    let dir = req.out.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| root.join(RUNS_DIR).join(run_dir_name(started, smoke)));
    let meta = RunMeta {
        run_id: run_id.clone(),
        suite: loaded.name.clone(),
        profile: req.profile.clone(),
        env: env.id.clone(),
        mode: req.mode,
        agents: vec![RunAgent { id: LOCAL_AGENT_ID.into(), url: None, weight: 1, version: Some(VERSION.into()) }],
        project_commit: project_commit(&root),
        services: service_versions(&project.registry),
        started_at: now_rfc3339(),
        ended_at: None,
        status: None,
    };
    let mut writer = RunWriter::create(&dir, &meta)?;
    let dir_text = dir.display().to_string();
    let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Started { run_id: run_id.clone(), dir: dir_text.clone() }).await;

    let agent = LocalAgent::new(LOCAL_AGENT_ID, executor_factory());
    match drive(&agent, &request, &loaded, &mut writer, &events, &cancel).await {
        Ok((summary, errors)) => {
            if smoke {
                writer.smoke(&SmokeReport::from_errors(&loaded.suite, &errors))?;
            }
            let status = summary.status;
            writer.finish(&summary, status)?;
            let result = RunResult { run_id, dir: dir_text, status, summary };
            let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Done(result.clone())).await;
            Ok(result)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            let failed = AgentSummary { status: RunStatus::Failed, ops: vec![], scenarios: vec![], seconds: 0 };
            writer.finish(&failed, RunStatus::Failed)?;
            let _ = events.send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id: LOCAL_AGENT_ID.into(), state: AgentState::Failed }).await;
            Err(e)
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 9: Крейт `glafira-load-cli` — бинарник `glafira-load`, команды `check`, `smoke`, `run`

Решение: крейт состоит из библиотеки `glafira_load_cli` (команды, консоль, агент — так интеграционные тесты агента поднимают сервер в процессе) и тонкого бинарника `glafira-load` (`main.rs`). Ошибки разбора аргументов clap завершают процесс кодом 3 (`STARTUP`), а не clap-овским 2, который занят значением «остановлено»; `--help`/`--version` — код 0. Флаг `--agents` в этой задаче в clap не добавляется — он появляется в Task 11d вместе с реализацией. `smoke` берёт первый по алфавиту профиль из `load/profile.yaml` (в режиме `Mode::Smoke` цели не нужны, но `LocalRun.profile` обязателен); `smoke.yaml` пишет сам `run_local` (Task 8, `RunWriter::smoke`), команда строит ту же таблицу для консоли из примеров ошибок через `summary::SmokeReport::from_errors`. `check` вызывается без стенда (`env: None`): у команды нет `--env` по шапке, поэтому проверка «`encoding: avro` без `schema_registry`» в CLI не выполняется — её делает контроллер перед запуском.

**Files:**
- Create: `crates/glafira-load-cli/Cargo.toml`, `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/{lib,main,exit,console,project}.rs`, `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/cmd/{mod,check,smoke,run}.rs`

- Test: `crates/glafira-load-cli/tests/common/mod.rs`, `crates/glafira-load-cli/tests/cli.rs`; unit-тесты в `exit.rs`, `console.rs`, `project.rs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `glafira_load_model::{from_yaml, to_yaml, project::{MANIFEST_FILE, Manifest, Environment}, registry::{REGISTRY_FILE, Registry}, profile::{PROFILE_FILE, ProfileFile, Point}, suite::{self, SUITES_DIR, SUITE_FILE, Suite, OnFail, check::{check, DataInfo, Finding, Level}}}`; `glafira_load_engine::{agent_api::{AgentSummary, ErrorSample, Mode, RunStatus, Tick}, context::data_info, local::{LocalRun, run_local}, agent_link::{ControllerEvent, EngineError, RunResult}, summary::{SmokeReport, SmokeScenario, SmokeStep}}` (всё — Task 8); `run_local` принимает `tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ControllerEvent>` и `tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken`; фикстуры `dev/fixtures/suites/{project, orders, orders-http, invalid}` (Task 1–3, 8; `orders-http` — сьют из одного сценария с двумя HTTP-шагами `create` (`POST /v1/orders`, `expect.status: 201`, `extract: { order_id: "$.id" }`) и `get` (`GET /v1/orders/{id}`, `expect.status: 200`)).

```rust
//! Коды возврата CLI (спека §5.4): 0 завершено, 2 остановлено, 3 ошибка запуска, 4 найдены ошибки.

use std::process::{ExitCode, Termination};

pub const OK: u8 = 0;
pub const STOPPED: u8 = 2;
pub const STARTUP: u8 = 3;
pub const FINDINGS: u8 = 4;

/// Возвращается из `main`: процесс завершается кодом внутри.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Exit(pub u8);

impl Termination for Exit {
    fn report(self) -> ExitCode {
        ExitCode::from(self.0)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn codes_are_distinct_and_match_the_spec() {
        assert_eq!([OK, STOPPED, STARTUP, FINDINGS], [0, 2, 3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(Exit(FINDINGS).0, 4);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Консольный вывод: без цветов, ширина колонок по содержимому (спека §5.4).

use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentSummary, RunStatus, Tick};
use glafira_load_engine::summary::SmokeReport;
use glafira_load_model::suite::check::{Finding, Level};

/// Таблица: заголовки и строки, колонки разделены двумя пробелами, ширина — по самой длинной ячейке.
pub fn table(headers: &[&str], rows: &[Vec<String>]) -> String {
    let cols = headers.len();
    let mut width: Vec<usize> = headers.iter().map(|h| h.chars().count()).collect();
    for row in rows {
        for (i, cell) in row.iter().enumerate().take(cols) {
            width[i] = width[i].max(cell.chars().count());
        }
    }
    let line = |cells: &[String]| -> String {
        let mut s = String::new();
        for (i, cell) in cells.iter().enumerate().take(cols) {
            if i > 0 {
                s.push_str("  ");
            }
            s.push_str(cell);
            if i + 1 < cols {
                s.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(' ', width[i] - cell.chars().count()));
            }
        }
        s.push('\n');
        s
    };
    let header: Vec<String> = headers.iter().map(|h| h.to_string()).collect();
    let mut out = line(&header);
    for row in rows {
        out.push_str(&line(row));
    }
    out
}

/// `error|warning  file:line  message`; без строки — только файл.
pub fn finding_line(f: &Finding) -> String {
    let level = match f.level {
        Level::Error => "error",
        Level::Warning => "warning",
    };
    let place = match f.line {
        Some(line) => format!("{}:{line}", f.file),
        None => f.file.clone(),
    };
    format!("{level:<7}  {place}  {}", f.message)
}

/// Отчёт `check`: строки находок и итог `N error(s), M warning(s)`.
pub fn check_report(findings: &[Finding]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for f in findings {
        out.push_str(&finding_line(f));
        out.push('\n');
    }
    let errors = findings.iter().filter(|f| matches!(f.level, Level::Error)).count();
    out.push_str(&format!("{errors} error(s), {} warning(s)\n", findings.len() - errors));
    out
}

/// Таблица смока: сценарий, шаг, операция, результат (`ok` либо код и причина; пропущенные — `SKIPPED`).
pub fn smoke_table(report: &SmokeReport) -> String {
    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = report
        .scenarios
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|s| {
            s.steps.iter().map(move |st| {
                let result = if st.ok {
                    "ok".to_string()
                } else {
                    match (&st.code, &st.message) {
                        (Some(code), Some(m)) => format!("{code} {m}"),
                        (Some(code), None) => code.clone(),
                        (None, Some(m)) => m.clone(),
                        (None, None) => "failed".to_string(),
                    }
                };
                vec![s.id.clone(), st.id.clone(), st.operation.clone(), result]
            })
        })
        .collect();
    let mut out = table(&["scenario", "step", "operation", "result"], &rows);
    out.push_str(&format!("{} step(s) failed\n", report.failed_steps()));
    out
}

/// Строка в секунду: `t=12s rps=480 p95=97ms err=3 dropped=0`; p95 — худший по операциям.
pub fn tick_line(t: &Tick) -> String {
    let rps: u64 = t.ops.iter().map(|o| o.n).sum();
    let p95 = t.ops.iter().map(|o| o.p95).fold(0.0_f64, f64::max);
    let err: u64 = t.ops.iter().map(|o| o.err.values().sum::<u64>()).sum();
    let dropped: u64 = t.ops.iter().map(|o| o.dropped).sum();
    format!("t={}s rps={rps} p95={}ms err={err} dropped={dropped}", t.t, p95.round() as u64)
}

/// Итог по операциям: id, n, rps avg, p95, p99, err %, target, achieved %.
pub fn summary_table(s: &AgentSummary) -> String {
    let ms = |v: f64| format!("{}", v.round() as u64);
    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = s
        .ops
        .iter()
        .map(|o| {
            vec![
                o.id.clone(),
                o.n.to_string(),
                format!("{:.1}", o.rps_avg),
                ms(o.p95),
                ms(o.p99),
                format!("{:.2}", o.err_pct),
                o.target.map(|t| format!("{t:.1}")).unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into()),
                o.achieved_pct.map(|p| format!("{p:.0}")).unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into()),
            ]
        })
        .collect();
    table(&["operation", "n", "rps avg", "p95 ms", "p99 ms", "err %", "target", "achieved %"], &rows)
}

pub fn status_label(s: &RunStatus) -> &'static str {
    match s {
        RunStatus::Completed => "completed",
        RunStatus::Stopped => "stopped",
        RunStatus::Incomplete => "incomplete",
        RunStatus::Failed => "failed",
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;

    use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{OpSummary, OpTick};
    use glafira_load_engine::summary::{SmokeScenario, SmokeStep};

    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn findings_and_summary_line() {
        let findings = vec![
            Finding { level: Level::Error, file: "suites/a/suite.yaml".into(), line: Some(3), message: "bad".into() },
            Finding { level: Level::Warning, file: "suites/a/suite.yaml".into(), line: None, message: "meh".into() },
        ];
        let text = check_report(&findings);
        assert_eq!(text, "error    suites/a/suite.yaml:3  bad\nwarning  suites/a/suite.yaml  meh\n1 error(s), 1 warning(s)\n");
    }

    #[test]
    fn tick_line_sums_ops_and_takes_worst_p95() {
        let op = |id: &str, n: u64, p95: f64, err: u64| OpTick {
            id: id.into(), n, err: BTreeMap::from([("HTTP_5xx".to_string(), err)]), dropped: 0,
            p50: 1.0, p90: 2.0, p95, p99: 4.0, max: 5.0, bytes_in: 0, bytes_out: 0, lag: None,
        };
        let t = Tick { t: 12, ops: vec![op("a", 300, 97.2, 3), op("b", 180, 40.0, 0)], scenarios: vec![] };
        assert_eq!(tick_line(&t), "t=12s rps=480 p95=97ms err=3 dropped=0");
    }

    #[test]
    fn tables_fit_the_content() {
        let s = AgentSummary {
            status: RunStatus::Completed,
            ops: vec![OpSummary {
                id: "http:orders:POST /v1/orders".into(), n: 1200, rps_avg: 20.0, rps_peak: 25.0, err: BTreeMap::new(),
                err_pct: 0.0, dropped: 0, p50: 10.0, p90: 20.0, p95: 30.4, p99: 50.0, max: 90.0, target: Some(20.0), achieved_pct: Some(100.0),
            }],
            scenarios: vec![],
            seconds: 60,
        };
        let text = summary_table(&s);
        assert!(text.starts_with("operation                    n     rps avg  p95 ms  p99 ms  err %  target  achieved %\n"));
        assert!(text.contains("http:orders:POST /v1/orders  1200  20.0     30      50      0.00   20.0    100\n"));
        let report = SmokeReport {
            scenarios: vec![SmokeScenario {
                id: "s".into(),
                steps: vec![
                    SmokeStep { id: "create".into(), operation: "http:o:POST /x".into(), ok: false, code: Some("HTTP_5xx".into()), message: Some("500".into()) },
                    SmokeStep { id: "get".into(), operation: "http:o:GET /x".into(), ok: true, code: None, message: None },
                ],
            }],
        };
        assert_eq!(
            smoke_table(&report),
            "scenario  step    operation       result\ns         create  http:o:POST /x  HTTP_5xx 500\ns         get     http:o:GET /x   ok\n1 step(s) failed\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(status_label(&RunStatus::Stopped), "stopped");
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: `project.rs` — чтение файлов проекта**

```rust
//! Чтение файлов проекта для CLI: манифест, реестр, профили, сьюты. Ошибки — текст для stderr.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use glafira_load_model::from_yaml;
use glafira_load_model::profile::{PROFILE_FILE, ProfileFile};
use glafira_load_model::project::{MANIFEST_FILE, Manifest};
use glafira_load_model::registry::{REGISTRY_FILE, Registry};
use glafira_load_model::suite::{SUITE_FILE, SUITES_DIR};

/// Абсолютный путь проекта без `..`; на Windows — без префикса `\\?\`.
pub fn project_root(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    dunce::canonicalize(path).map_err(|e| format!("project {}: {e}", path.display()))
}

fn read_text(root: &Path, rel: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(rel)).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read {}: {e}", root.join(rel).display()))
}

fn read_file<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(root: &Path, rel: &str) -> Result<T, String> {
    let text = read_text(root, rel)?;
    from_yaml(&text).map_err(|e| match e.line {
        Some(line) => format!("{rel}:{line}: {}", e.message),
        None => format!("{rel}: {}", e.message),
    })
}

pub fn read_manifest(root: &Path) -> Result<Manifest, String> {
    read_file(root, MANIFEST_FILE)
}

pub fn read_registry(root: &Path) -> Result<Registry, String> {
    read_file(root, REGISTRY_FILE)
}

pub fn read_profiles(root: &Path) -> Result<ProfileFile, String> {
    read_file(root, PROFILE_FILE)
}

/// `suites/<name>/suite.yaml` относительно проекта — так же пишутся `file` в находках `check`.
pub fn suite_file(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("{SUITES_DIR}/{name}/{SUITE_FILE}")
}

pub fn read_suite_text(root: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    read_text(root, &suite_file(name))
}

/// Имена папок `suites/*` с `suite.yaml`, по алфавиту.
pub fn list_suites(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    let dir = root.join(SUITES_DIR);
    if !dir.is_dir() {
        return Ok(vec![]);
    }
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read {}: {e}", dir.display()))? {
        let path = entry.map_err(|e| format!("cannot read {}: {e}", dir.display()))?.path();
        if path.join(SUITE_FILE).is_file() {
            if let Some(name) = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) {
                names.push(name.to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    names.sort();
    Ok(names)
}

/// Имя сьюта для `run`: `--suite`, иначе единственный сьют проекта; несколько — ошибка запуска.
pub fn resolve_suite(root: &Path, wanted: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, String> {
    if let Some(name) = wanted {
        return if root.join(suite_file(name)).is_file() {
            Ok(name.to_string())
        } else {
            Err(format!("suite `{name}` not found: {}", suite_file(name)))
        };
    }
    let names = list_suites(root)?;
    match names.as_slice() {
        [] => Err("the project has no suites".into()),
        [one] => Ok(one.clone()),
        many => Err(format!("the project has {} suites, pass --suite: {}", many.len(), many.join(", "))),
    }
}

/// Первый по алфавиту профиль — для `smoke`, которому цели не нужны.
pub fn first_profile(root: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    read_profiles(root)?.profiles.keys().next().cloned().ok_or_else(|| format!("{PROFILE_FILE} has no profiles"))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn lists_and_resolves_suites() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let root = dir.path();
        assert_eq!(resolve_suite(root, None).unwrap_err(), "the project has no suites");
        for name in ["b", "a"] {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("suites").join(name)).unwrap();
            std::fs::write(root.join("suites").join(name).join("suite.yaml"), "format: 1\n").unwrap();
        }
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("suites/empty")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(list_suites(root).unwrap(), vec!["a", "b"]);
        assert!(resolve_suite(root, None).unwrap_err().contains("pass --suite"));
        assert_eq!(resolve_suite(root, Some("b")).unwrap(), "b");
        assert!(resolve_suite(root, Some("zzz")).unwrap_err().contains("suites/zzz/suite.yaml"));
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(root.join("suites/b")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(resolve_suite(root, None).unwrap(), "a");
        assert!(read_registry(root).unwrap_err().contains("registry/operations.yaml"));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("load")).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(root.join("load/profile.yaml"), "format: 1\nprofiles:\n  peak: { basis: peak }\n  nominal: { basis: avg }\n").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first_profile(root).unwrap(), "nominal");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Общее для интеграционных тестов: временный проект из фикстур и заглушка стенда на axum.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use axum::extract::Path as AxPath;
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use axum::routing::{get, post};
use axum::{Json, Router};
use glafira_load_model::project::{Environment, MANIFEST_FILE, Manifest};
use glafira_load_model::{from_yaml, to_yaml};
use tempfile::TempDir;

pub const TOKEN: &str = "test-token";

pub fn fixtures() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../dev/fixtures/suites")
}

pub fn copy_dir(from: &Path, to: &Path) {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(to).unwrap();
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(from).unwrap() {
        let entry = entry.unwrap();
        let dest = to.join(entry.file_name());
        if entry.path().is_dir() {
            copy_dir(&entry.path(), &dest);
        } else {
            std::fs::copy(entry.path(), &dest).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

/// Проект: фикстура `project` + сьюты `orders` и `orders-http` с данными; стенд `test` смотрит на `stand_url`.
pub fn temp_project(stand_url: &str) -> TempDir {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = dir.path();
    copy_dir(&fixtures().join("project"), root);
    for name in ["orders", "orders-http"] {
        let src = fixtures().join(name);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("suites").join(name)).unwrap();
        std::fs::copy(src.join("suite.yaml"), root.join("suites").join(name).join("suite.yaml")).unwrap();
        if src.join("data").is_dir() {
            copy_dir(&src.join("data"), &root.join("data"));
        }
    }
    let mut manifest: Manifest = from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(MANIFEST_FILE)).unwrap()).unwrap();
    let env: Environment = from_yaml(&format!("id: test\nkind: test\nhttp: {stand_url}\n")).unwrap();
    manifest.environments.retain(|e| e.id != "test");
    manifest.environments.push(env);
    std::fs::write(root.join(MANIFEST_FILE), to_yaml(&manifest)).unwrap();
    dir
}

/// Профиль `name`: сразу 100 % и полка `minutes` минут.
pub fn write_profile(root: &Path, name: &str, minutes: f64) {
    let text = format!(
        "format: 1\nprofiles:\n  {name}:\n    basis: peak\n    phases:\n      - {{ kind: ramp, minutes: 0, to_pct: 100 }}\n      - {{ kind: steady, minutes: {minutes} }}\n"
    );
    std::fs::write(root.join("load/profile.yaml"), text).unwrap();
}

/// Цифры ПРОМ для HTTP-операций `orders`: по 20 RPS.
pub fn write_prod_load(root: &Path) {
    let text = "format: 1\noperations:\n  \"http:orders:POST /v1/orders\": { avg: 20, peak: 20 }\n  \"http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}\": { avg: 20, peak: 20 }\n";
    std::fs::write(root.join("load/prod-load.yaml"), text).unwrap();
}

/// Заглушка стенда: `POST /v1/orders` → `create_status` с `{"id":"o-1"}`, `GET /v1/orders/{id}` → 200, остальное → 200 `{}`.
pub async fn stand_stub(create_status: StatusCode) -> SocketAddr {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/v1/orders", post(move || async move { (create_status, Json(serde_json::json!({"id": "o-1", "status": "created"}))) }))
        .route("/v1/orders/{id}", get(|AxPath(id): AxPath<String>| async move { Json(serde_json::json!({"id": id, "status": "created"})) }))
        .fallback(|| async { (StatusCode::OK, Json(serde_json::json!({}))) });
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap() });
    addr
}
```
