```rust
//! `glafira-load check|smoke|run`: коды возврата и файлы прогона (спека §5.4, §9.1).

mod common;

use assert_cmd::Command;
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use common::{stand_stub, temp_project, write_prod_load, write_profile};
use predicates::prelude::*;

fn cli() -> Command {
    Command::from_std(std::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_glafira-load")))
}

#[test]
fn version_and_bad_usage() {
    cli().arg("--version").assert().code(0).stdout(predicate::str::contains(env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")));
    // без --env: ошибка разбора → 3, не clap-овский 2
    let project = temp_project("http://127.0.0.1:1");
    cli().args(["run", project.path().to_str().unwrap(), "--profile", "peak"]).assert().code(3).stderr(predicate::str::contains("--env"));
    cli().args(["check", "/no/such/project"]).assert().code(3).stderr(predicate::str::contains("error"));
}

#[test]
fn check_orders_suite_passes() {
    let project = temp_project("http://127.0.0.1:1");
    cli()
        .args(["check", project.path().to_str().unwrap(), "--suite", "orders"])
        .assert()
        .code(0)
        .stdout(predicate::str::contains("0 error(s)"));
}

#[test]
fn check_reports_missing_operation_with_code_4() {
    let project = temp_project("http://127.0.0.1:1");
    let bad = project.path().join("suites/bad");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&bad).unwrap();
    std::fs::copy(common::fixtures().join("invalid/missing-operation.yaml"), bad.join("suite.yaml")).unwrap();
    cli()
        .args(["check", project.path().to_str().unwrap()])
        .assert()
        .code(4)
        .stdout(predicate::str::contains("error").and(predicate::str::contains("suites/bad/suite.yaml")));
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn smoke_against_stub_writes_smoke_yaml() {
    let stand = stand_stub(StatusCode::CREATED).await;
    let project = temp_project(&format!("http://{stand}"));
    let out = project.path().join("out");
    cli()
        .args(["smoke", project.path().to_str().unwrap(), "--suite", "orders-http", "--env", "test", "--out", out.to_str().unwrap()])
        .env("GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_API_TOKEN", "t")
        .assert()
        .code(0)
        .stdout(predicate::str::contains("0 step(s) failed"));
    let report = std::fs::read_to_string(out.join("smoke.yaml")).unwrap();
    assert!(report.contains("ok: true") && !report.contains("ok: false"), "{report}");
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn smoke_with_failing_stand_returns_4() {
    let stand = stand_stub(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).await;
    let project = temp_project(&format!("http://{stand}"));
    let out = project.path().join("out");
    cli()
        .args(["smoke", project.path().to_str().unwrap(), "--suite", "orders-http", "--env", "test", "--out", out.to_str().unwrap()])
        .env("GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_API_TOKEN", "t")
        .assert()
        .code(4)
        .stdout(predicate::str::contains("step(s) failed").and(predicate::str::contains("0 step(s) failed").not()));
    let report = std::fs::read_to_string(out.join("smoke.yaml")).unwrap();
    assert!(report.contains("ok: false") && report.contains("code: SKIPPED"), "первый шаг упал, второй пропущен: {report}");
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn run_three_seconds_writes_summary() {
    let stand = stand_stub(StatusCode::CREATED).await;
    let project = temp_project(&format!("http://{stand}"));
    write_profile(project.path(), "short", 0.05);
    write_prod_load(project.path());
    let out = project.path().join("out");
    cli()
        .args(["run", project.path().to_str().unwrap(), "--profile", "short", "--env", "test", "--suite", "orders-http", "--out", out.to_str().unwrap()])
        .env("GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_API_TOKEN", "t")
        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60))
        .assert()
        .code(0)
        .stdout(predicate::str::contains("t=").and(predicate::str::contains("operation")).and(predicate::str::contains("status: completed")));
    assert!(out.join("summary.yaml").is_file());
    assert!(out.join("run.yaml").is_file());
}
```

```rust
//! Команды CLI. Каждая возвращает `Exit`; текст ошибок запуска — в stderr.

pub mod check;
pub mod run;
pub mod smoke;

use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use crate::exit::{Exit, STARTUP};

/// Ctrl+C → отмена: локальный `run` равен `stop`, текущие итерации дорабатывают (спека §5.4).
pub fn cancel_on_ctrl_c(cancel: CancellationToken) {
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        if tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await.is_ok() {
            eprintln!("stopping: waiting for in-flight iterations");
            cancel.cancel();
        }
    });
}

pub fn startup_error(message: &str) -> Exit {
    eprintln!("error: {message}");
    Exit(STARTUP)
}
```

```rust
//! `glafira-load check`: проверка сьютов без сети (спека §3.5).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use glafira_load_engine::context::data_info;
use glafira_load_model::suite;
use glafira_load_model::suite::check::{DataInfo, Level};

use super::startup_error;
use crate::console;
use crate::exit::{Exit, FINDINGS, OK, STARTUP};
use crate::project::{list_suites, project_root, read_registry, read_suite_text, suite_file};

pub async fn check(project: PathBuf, suite: Option<String>) -> Exit {
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || check_sync(&project, suite.as_deref())).await.unwrap_or(Exit(STARTUP))
}

/// Один сьют или все сьюты проекта; код 4, если есть находки уровня `error`.
pub fn check_sync(project: &Path, suite: Option<&str>) -> Exit {
    let root = match project_root(project) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let registry = match read_registry(&root) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let names = match suite {
        Some(name) => vec![name.to_string()],
        None => match list_suites(&root) {
            Ok(names) => names,
            Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
        },
    };
    if names.is_empty() {
        return startup_error("the project has no suites");
    }
    let mut findings = Vec::new();
    for name in names {
        let file = suite_file(&name);
        let text = match read_suite_text(&root, &name) {
            Ok(t) => t,
            Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
        };
        let data = data_infos(&root, &text);
        let (_, found) = suite::check::check(&text, &file, &registry, &data, None);
        findings.extend(found);
    }
    print!("{}", console::check_report(&findings));
    if findings.iter().any(|f| matches!(f.level, Level::Error)) { Exit(FINDINGS) } else { Exit(OK) }
}

/// Колонки и строки наборов данных сьюта; если YAML не разбирается, карта пуста — `check` сообщит об ошибке разбора.
fn data_infos(root: &Path, text: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, Option<DataInfo>> {
    match suite::parse(text) {
        Ok(s) => s.data.iter().map(|(name, set)| (name.clone(), data_info(root, &set.path))).collect(),
        Err(_) => BTreeMap::new(),
    }
}
```

```rust
//! `glafira-load smoke`: каждый сценарий один раз, отчёт `smoke.yaml` (спека §5.4, §6.2).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{Mode, RunStatus};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::ControllerEvent;
use glafira_load_engine::local::{LocalRun, run_local};
use glafira_load_engine::summary::SmokeReport;
use glafira_load_model::suite;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use super::{cancel_on_ctrl_c, startup_error};
use crate::console;
use crate::exit::{Exit, FINDINGS, OK, STARTUP, STOPPED};
use crate::project::{first_profile, project_root, read_suite_text, suite_file};

pub struct SmokeArgs {
    pub project: PathBuf,
    pub suite: String,
    pub env: String,
    pub out: Option<PathBuf>,
}

pub async fn smoke(args: SmokeArgs) -> Exit {
    let root = match project_root(&args.project) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let text = match read_suite_text(&root, &args.suite) {
        Ok(t) => t,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    // отчёт строится по сценариям сьюта: разбор нужен до прогона
    let parsed = match suite::parse(&text) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => {
            let line = e.line.map(|l| format!(":{l}")).unwrap_or_default();
            println!("error    {}{line}  {}", suite_file(&args.suite), e.message);
            return Exit(FINDINGS);
        }
    };
    let profile = match first_profile(&root) {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(1024);
    let cancel = CancellationToken::new();
    cancel_on_ctrl_c(cancel.clone());
    let req = LocalRun { root, suite: args.suite, profile, env: args.env, mode: Mode::Smoke, max_in_flight: None, out: args.out };
    let collect = async {
        let mut errors = Vec::new();
        while let Some(event) = rx.recv().await {
            match event {
                ControllerEvent::Started { run_id, dir } => println!("smoke {run_id} -> {dir}"),
                ControllerEvent::Error(e) => errors.push(e),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        errors
    };
    let (result, errors) = tokio::join!(run_local(req, tx, cancel), collect);
    let result = match result {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("error {}: {}", e.code, e.message);
            return if e.code == "SUITE_INVALID" { Exit(FINDINGS) } else { Exit(STARTUP) };
        }
    };
    // `smoke.yaml` в папке прогона уже записал `run_local`; для консоли отчёт строится из тех же примеров ошибок.
    let report = SmokeReport::from_errors(&parsed, &errors);
    print!("{}", console::smoke_table(&report));
    if matches!(result.status, RunStatus::Stopped) {
        Exit(STOPPED)
    } else if report.failed_steps() > 0 {
        Exit(FINDINGS)
    } else {
        Exit(OK)
    }
}
```

`crates/glafira-load-cli/src/cmd/run.rs`:

```rust
//! `glafira-load run`: локальный прогон по профилю, строка в секунду и итоговая таблица (спека §5.4).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{Mode, RunStatus};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::ControllerEvent;
use glafira_load_engine::local::{LocalRun, run_local};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use super::{cancel_on_ctrl_c, startup_error};
use crate::console;
use crate::exit::{Exit, OK, STARTUP, STOPPED};
use crate::project::{project_root, resolve_suite};

pub struct RunArgs {
    pub project: PathBuf,
    pub profile: String,
    pub env: String,
    pub suite: Option<String>,
    pub max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
    pub out: Option<PathBuf>,
}

/// 0 — завершён (в том числе `incomplete`), 2 — остановлен, 3 — упал.
pub fn exit_for(status: &RunStatus) -> Exit {
    match status {
        RunStatus::Completed | RunStatus::Incomplete => Exit(OK),
        RunStatus::Stopped => Exit(STOPPED),
        RunStatus::Failed => Exit(STARTUP),
    }
}

pub async fn run(args: RunArgs) -> Exit {
    let root = match project_root(&args.project) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let suite = match resolve_suite(&root, args.suite.as_deref()) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(1024);
    let cancel = CancellationToken::new();
    cancel_on_ctrl_c(cancel.clone());
    let req = LocalRun { root, suite, profile: args.profile, env: args.env, mode: Mode::Run, max_in_flight: args.max_in_flight, out: args.out };
    let print = async {
        while let Some(event) = rx.recv().await {
            match event {
                ControllerEvent::Started { run_id, dir } => println!("run {run_id} -> {dir}"),
                ControllerEvent::Tick(t) => println!("{}", console::tick_line(&t)),
                ControllerEvent::Phase(p) => println!("t={}s phase {} target {:.0}%", p.t, p.index + 1, p.pct),
                // примеры ошибок уходят в errors.jsonl; в консоли их считает строка секунды
                ControllerEvent::Error(_) | ControllerEvent::Agent { .. } | ControllerEvent::Done(_) => {}
            }
        }
    };
    let (result, ()) = tokio::join!(run_local(req, tx, cancel), print);
    match result {
        Ok(r) => {
            println!();
            print!("{}", console::summary_table(&r.summary));
            println!("status: {}  folder: {}", console::status_label(&r.status), r.dir);
            exit_for(&r.status)
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("error {}: {}", e.code, e.message);
            Exit(STARTUP)
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/glafira-load-cli/src/main.rs`:

```rust
//! Бинарник `glafira-load`: разбор аргументов и выбор команды (спека §5.4).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use clap::error::ErrorKind;
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use glafira_load_cli::cmd;
use glafira_load_cli::cmd::run::RunArgs;
use glafira_load_cli::cmd::smoke::SmokeArgs;
use glafira_load_cli::exit::{Exit, OK, STARTUP};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "glafira-load", version, about = "Glafira for Load Testing: check and smoke suites, run load profiles, serve as a load agent")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Command,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Command {
    /// Check one suite or all suites of the project without network (exit 4 on errors)
    Check {
        /// Project folder
        project: PathBuf,
        /// Suite name; all suites when omitted
        #[arg(long)]
        suite: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Run every scenario of a suite once against an environment (exit 4 on failed steps)
    Smoke {
        /// Project folder
        project: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long)]
        suite: String,
        /// Environment id from the project manifest
        #[arg(long)]
        env: String,
        /// Run folder; default `runs/smoke-<timestamp>` inside the project
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// Run a load profile locally (exit 2 when stopped with Ctrl+C)
    Run {
        /// Project folder
        project: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long)]
        profile: String,
        /// Environment id from the project manifest
        #[arg(long)]
        env: String,
        /// Suite name; the only suite of the project when omitted
        #[arg(long)]
        suite: Option<String>,
        /// Cap of concurrent iterations; overrides `defaults.max_in_flight`
        #[arg(long = "max-in-flight")]
        max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
        /// Run folder; default `runs/<timestamp>` inside the project
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Exit {
    // clap завершал бы процесс кодом 2, а он занят значением «остановлено»: ошибки разбора → 3, help/version → 0
    let cli = match Cli::try_parse() {
        Ok(cli) => cli,
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = e.print();
            return if matches!(e.kind(), ErrorKind::DisplayHelp | ErrorKind::DisplayVersion) { Exit(OK) } else { Exit(STARTUP) };
        }
    };
    match cli.command {
        Command::Check { project, suite } => cmd::check::check(project, suite).await,
        Command::Smoke { project, suite, env, out } => cmd::smoke::smoke(SmokeArgs { project, suite, env, out }).await,
        Command::Run { project, profile, env, suite, max_in_flight, out } => {
            cmd::run::run(RunArgs { project, profile, env, suite, max_in_flight, out }).await
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 10: Агент `glafira-load agent` — HTTP API на axum, SSE, файлы прогона

Решение: исполнение прогона — `LocalAgent` из Task 8 (тот же код, что у локального `run`): агент создаёт `work/<run_id>/`, строит `LocalAgent::new(&req.agent_id, local::executor_factory()).with_secrets(secrets)` (фабрика исполнителей читает схемы ответов и `.avsc` из `RunRequest.response_schemas` / `RunRequest.avro_schemas` — реестр проекта агенту не нужен; секреты — из карты `secrets_env` агента, не из окружения процесса), вызывает `start`, подписывается на `events` и перекладывает события в буфер SSE (`EventLog`: `VecDeque` за 120 с + `broadcast`). `LocalAgent` копит `metrics.jsonl`, `errors.jsonl`, `summary.yaml`, `hist.bin` в памяти и отдаёт их tar-архивом из `files()` после `done`: насос событий по `done` вызывает `files()` и распаковывает tar в `work/<run_id>/`; агент дополнительно пишет туда `run.json` (копия запроса), `agent.log` (слой `tracing` с писателем в stderr и в файл текущего прогона) и `summary.yaml` из события `done` (атомарно; содержимое совпадает с файлом из tar). `GET /v1/runs/{id}/files` отдаёт tar этой папки. `RunWriter` агенту не нужен — он собирает сводную папку контроллера. Секреты в тестах — поле `secrets_env: BTreeMap` в `AgentState` (в `cmd/agent.rs` заполняется из окружения по префиксу `GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_`), без `std::env::set_var`. Дренаж: `stop` вызывает `LocalAgent::stop` и запускает сторож на `--drain-ms`; если `done` за это время не пришёл, насос прерывается, в буфер идёт `done` со статусом `stopped` и пустой сводкой (она же пишется в `summary.yaml`). `GET /v1/runs` отдаёт историю завершённых прогонов (текущий виден в `/v1/info.busy`); при старте агент перечитывает папки `--work` (статус из `summary.yaml`, иначе `incomplete`) и удаляет лишние по `--keep-runs`. Ответ `202` — `{"runId": …}` (camelCase, как все типы `agent_api`). Папка `--work` по умолчанию — `<temp>/glafira-load-agent`. Сравнение версий — `agent_link::same_minor` из Task 8.

**Files:**
- Create: `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/cmd/agent.rs`, `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/agent/{mod,auth,runs,sse,files,server}.rs`
- Modify: `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/lib.rs` (`+ pub mod agent;`), `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/cmd/mod.rs` (`+ pub mod agent;`), `crates/glafira-load-cli/src/main.rs` (подкоманда `Agent`)
- Test: `crates/glafira-load-cli/tests/agent.rs`; unit-тесты в `sse.rs`, `files.rs`, `runs.rs`, `cmd/agent.rs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{API_VERSION, AgentInfo, AgentSummary, ApiError, Event, RunListItem, RunRequest, RunStatus}` (типы `Clone + Serialize + Deserialize`), `glafira_load_engine::agent_link::{AgentLink, LinkError, LocalAgent, SECRET_PREFIX, same_minor}` (Task 8: `LocalAgent::new(id: &str, factory: ExecutorFactory)`, `LocalAgent::with_secrets(BTreeMap<String, String>)`; `start` возвращается сразу после запуска фоновой задачи; `events(run_id, None)` — живой поток с первого события; после `stop` поток заканчивается `Done` со статусом `Stopped`; `files(run_id)` после `done` отдаёт tar с `metrics.jsonl`, `errors.jsonl`, `summary.yaml`, `hist.bin`), `glafira_load_engine::local::executor_factory` (Task 8), `glafira_load_model::suite::{self, FORMAT}`; `console::status_label` (Task 9); фикстуры не нужны — сьют в тестах inline.
- Produces: `glafira_load_cli::agent::{api_error, api_error_full, not_found}`; `agent::auth::require_bearer`; `agent::sse::{RETENTION, EventLog, Replay, event_name, stream, events}`; `agent::files::{tar_dir, files}`; `agent::runs::{AGENT_LOG, SUMMARY_FILE, REQUEST_FILE, AgentConfig, RunningRun, FinishedRun, AgentState, LogSink, SinkWriter, StartResponse, secrets_from_vars, now_rfc3339, info, list, start, stop}`; `agent::server::{BODY_LIMIT, router, serve}`; `cmd::agent::{TOKEN_ENV, AgentArgs, resolve_token, default_work_dir, agent}`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Интеграционные тесты агента (падающие)**

`crates/glafira-load-cli/tests/agent.rs`:

```rust
//! Агент: сервер на свободном порту внутри теста, клиент reqwest, стенд — заглушка axum (спека §4.3, §9.1).

mod common;

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use assert_cmd::Command;
use axum::http::StatusCode as AxStatus;
use common::{TOKEN, stand_stub};
use eventsource_stream::Eventsource;
use futures::StreamExt;
use glafira_load_cli::agent::runs::{AgentConfig, AgentState};
use glafira_load_cli::agent::server;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentInfo, ApiError, EnvAddresses, Mode, RunListItem, RunRequest, RunStatus};
use glafira_load_model::profile::Point;
use glafira_load_model::suite::{self, Arrival};
use predicates::prelude::*;
use reqwest::multipart::{Form, Part};
use reqwest::{Client, StatusCode};
use tempfile::TempDir;

const SUITE: &str = "format: 1\nname: orders-http\nscenarios:\n  - id: create-get\n    steps:\n      - id: create\n        http:\n          operation: \"http:orders:POST /v1/orders\"\n          body: { customerId: \"{{uuid}}\" }\n        expect: { status: 201 }\n        extract: { order_id: \"$.id\" }\n      - id: get\n        http:\n          operation: \"http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}\"\n          path: { id: \"{{steps.create.order_id}}\" }\n        expect: { status: 200 }\n";

struct Agent {
    base: String,
    _work: TempDir,
    state: Arc<AgentState>,
}

async fn start_agent(secrets: BTreeMap<String, String>, keep_runs: usize) -> Agent {
    let work = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let config = AgentConfig {
        work_dir: work.path().to_path_buf(),
        keep_runs,
        drain: Duration::from_millis(1500),
        token: TOKEN.into(),
        secrets_env: secrets,
        version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into(),
    };
    let state = AgentState::new(config).unwrap();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    tokio::spawn(server::serve(listener, state.clone(), std::future::pending()));
    Agent { base: format!("http://{addr}"), _work: work, state }
}

fn run_id() -> String {
    format!("run-{}", std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_nanos())
}

fn request(mode: Mode, minutes: f64, stand: &str, secrets: Vec<String>, controller_version: &str) -> RunRequest {
    RunRequest {
        run_id: run_id(),
        agent_id: "gen-1".into(),
        suite_name: "orders-http".into(),
        controller_version: controller_version.into(),
        suite_format: suite::FORMAT,
        env: EnvAddresses { http: Some(stand.into()), kafka: None, schema_registry: None },
        secrets,
        targets: BTreeMap::from([("http:orders:POST /v1/orders".to_string(), 20.0)]),
        timeline: vec![Point { minute: 0.0, pct: 100.0 }, Point { minute: minutes, pct: 100.0 }],
        total_minutes: minutes,
        max_in_flight: 100,
        arrival: Arrival::Constant,
        mode,
        kafka: BTreeMap::new(),
        response_schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
        avro_schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
    }
}

fn bundle(req: &RunRequest, suite_text: &str) -> Form {
    Form::new()
        .part("run.json", Part::bytes(serde_json::to_vec(req).unwrap()).file_name("run.json").mime_str("application/json").unwrap())
        .part("suite.yaml", Part::text(suite_text.to_string()).file_name("suite.yaml"))
}

async fn post_run(agent: &Agent, req: &RunRequest, suite_text: &str) -> reqwest::Response {
    Client::new().post(format!("{}/v1/runs", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).multipart(bundle(req, suite_text)).send().await.unwrap()
}

async fn get_json<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(agent: &Agent, path: &str) -> T {
    Client::new().get(format!("{}{path}", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap().json().await.unwrap()
}

struct Sse {
    id: Option<u64>,
    event: String,
    data: String,
}

/// Читает SSE до закрытия потока (агент закрывает его после `done`) или до `limit` событий.
async fn read_sse(agent: &Agent, run_id: &str, last_id: Option<u64>, limit: usize) -> Vec<Sse> {
    let mut rb = Client::new().get(format!("{}/v1/runs/{run_id}/events", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN);
    if let Some(id) = last_id {
        rb = rb.header("Last-Event-ID", id.to_string());
    }
    let resp = rb.send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(resp.status(), StatusCode::OK);
    let mut stream = resp.bytes_stream().eventsource();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    while let Some(ev) = stream.next().await {
        let ev = ev.unwrap();
        out.push(Sse { id: ev.id.parse().ok(), event: ev.event, data: ev.data });
        if out.len() >= limit {
            break;
        }
    }
    out
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn rejects_without_token_and_reports_info() {
    let agent = start_agent(BTreeMap::new(), 10).await;
    let c = Client::new();
    let r = c.get(format!("{}/v1/info", agent.base)).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<ApiError>().await.unwrap().code, "UNAUTHORIZED");
    let r = c.get(format!("{}/v1/info", agent.base)).bearer_auth("wrong").send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED);
    let info: AgentInfo = get_json(&agent, "/v1/info").await;
    assert_eq!(info.version, env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    assert!(info.cpus >= 1);
    assert_eq!(info.busy, None);
    let r = c.get(format!("{}/v1/runs/nope/events", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
    let r = c.get(format!("{}/v1/runs/nope/files", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn smoke_run_streams_done_and_files_contain_summary() {
    let stand = stand_stub(AxStatus::CREATED).await;
    let agent = start_agent(BTreeMap::new(), 10).await;
    let req = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &format!("http://{stand}"), vec![], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    let r = post_run(&agent, &req, SUITE).await;
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::ACCEPTED);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<serde_json::Value>().await.unwrap()["runId"], req.run_id);
    let events = read_sse(&agent, &req.run_id, None, usize::MAX).await;
    let last = events.last().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(last.event, "done");
    assert!(last.data.contains("completed"), "{}", last.data);
    assert!(events.iter().all(|e| e.id.is_some()));
    // история и файлы
    let list: Vec<RunListItem> = get_json(&agent, "/v1/runs").await;
    assert!(list.iter().any(|r| r.run_id == req.run_id && matches!(r.status, RunStatus::Completed)));
    let resp = Client::new().get(format!("{}/v1/runs/{}/files", agent.base, req.run_id)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(resp.headers()["content-type"], "application/x-tar");
    let bytes = resp.bytes().await.unwrap();
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    for entry in tar::Archive::new(&bytes[..]).entries().unwrap() {
        names.push(entry.unwrap().path().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned());
    }
    assert!(names.contains(&"summary.yaml".to_string()), "{names:?}");
    assert!(names.contains(&"agent.log".to_string()), "{names:?}");
    assert!(names.contains(&"run.json".to_string()), "{names:?}");
    assert!(names.contains(&"hist.bin".to_string()), "файлы LocalAgent распакованы из tar: {names:?}");
    assert_eq!(agent.state.busy(), None);
    // поток завершённого прогона отдаётся из буфера и снова заканчивается `done`
    let again = read_sse(&agent, &req.run_id, None, usize::MAX).await;
    assert_eq!(again.last().unwrap().event, "done");
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn busy_then_stop_with_last_event_id() {
    let stand = stand_stub(AxStatus::CREATED).await;
    let agent = start_agent(BTreeMap::new(), 10).await;
    let stand = format!("http://{stand}");
    let req = request(Mode::Run, 1.0, &stand, vec![], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    assert_eq!(post_run(&agent, &req, SUITE).await.status(), StatusCode::ACCEPTED);
    // второй старт во время прогона — занят
    let second = request(Mode::Run, 1.0, &stand, vec![], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    let r = post_run(&agent, &second, SUITE).await;
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::CONFLICT);
    let err: ApiError = r.json().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(err.code, "AGENT_BUSY");
    assert!(err.message.contains(&req.run_id));
    let info: AgentInfo = get_json(&agent, "/v1/info").await;
    assert_eq!(info.busy.as_deref(), Some(req.run_id.as_str()));
    // три события, обрыв, переподключение с Last-Event-ID
    let first = read_sse(&agent, &req.run_id, None, 3).await;
    assert_eq!(first.len(), 3);
    let last_id = first.last().unwrap().id.unwrap();
    let again = read_sse(&agent, &req.run_id, Some(last_id - 1), 1).await;
    assert_eq!(again[0].id, Some(last_id));
    // стоп → done со статусом stopped
    let r = Client::new().post(format!("{}/v1/runs/{}/stop", agent.base, req.run_id)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::OK);
    let rest = read_sse(&agent, &req.run_id, Some(last_id), usize::MAX).await;
    let done = rest.last().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(done.event, "done");
    assert!(done.data.contains("stopped"), "{}", done.data);
    let list: Vec<RunListItem> = get_json(&agent, "/v1/runs").await;
    assert!(matches!(list.iter().find(|r| r.run_id == req.run_id).unwrap().status, RunStatus::Stopped));
    assert_eq!(agent.state.busy(), None);
    // стоп завершённого прогона — 200, неизвестного — 404
    let r = Client::new().post(format!("{}/v1/runs/{}/stop", agent.base, req.run_id)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::OK);
    let r = Client::new().post(format!("{}/v1/runs/nope/stop", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn secret_missing_version_and_invalid_suite() {
    let stand = format!("http://{}", stand_stub(AxStatus::CREATED).await);
    let agent = start_agent(BTreeMap::new(), 10).await;
    let with_secret = SUITE.replacen("name: orders-http\n", "name: orders-http\nsecrets: [X]\n", 1);
    let req = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &stand, vec!["X".into()], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    let r = post_run(&agent, &req, &with_secret).await;
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED);
    let err: ApiError = r.json().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(err.code, "SECRET_MISSING");
    assert_eq!(err.names, vec!["X"]);
    // с секретом в окружении агента прогон принимается
    let agent2 = start_agent(BTreeMap::from([("X".to_string(), "v".to_string())]), 10).await;
    let req2 = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &stand, vec!["X".into()], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    assert_eq!(post_run(&agent2, &req2, &with_secret).await.status(), StatusCode::ACCEPTED);
    assert_eq!(read_sse(&agent2, &req2.run_id, None, usize::MAX).await.last().unwrap().event, "done");
    // версия контроллера другой minor
    let req3 = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &stand, vec![], "9.9.0");
    let r = post_run(&agent, &req3, SUITE).await;
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::UPGRADE_REQUIRED);
    let err: ApiError = r.json().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(err.code, "AGENT_VERSION");
    assert_eq!(err.controller.as_deref(), Some("9.9.0"));
    assert_eq!(err.agent.as_deref(), Some(env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")));
    // невалидный сьют
    let req4 = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &stand, vec![], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    let r = post_run(&agent, &req4, "format: 1\nname: x\nscenarios: []\nbogus: 1\n").await;
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY);
    assert_eq!(r.json::<ApiError>().await.unwrap().code, "SUITE_INVALID");
    // бандл без run.json
    let r = Client::new().post(format!("{}/v1/runs", agent.base)).bearer_auth(TOKEN).multipart(Form::new().part("suite.yaml", Part::text(SUITE))).send().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.status(), StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    assert_eq!(agent.state.busy(), None);
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn keep_runs_removes_old_folders() {
    let stand = format!("http://{}", stand_stub(AxStatus::CREATED).await);
    let agent = start_agent(BTreeMap::new(), 1).await;
    let a = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &stand, vec![], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    assert_eq!(post_run(&agent, &a, SUITE).await.status(), StatusCode::ACCEPTED);
    read_sse(&agent, &a.run_id, None, usize::MAX).await;
    let dir_a = agent.state.run_dir(&a.run_id).unwrap();
    assert!(dir_a.is_dir());
    let b = request(Mode::Smoke, 0.0, &stand, vec![], env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    assert_eq!(post_run(&agent, &b, SUITE).await.status(), StatusCode::ACCEPTED);
    read_sse(&agent, &b.run_id, None, usize::MAX).await;
    assert!(!dir_a.is_dir());
    assert!(agent.state.run_dir(&b.run_id).unwrap().is_dir());
    let list: Vec<RunListItem> = get_json(&agent, "/v1/runs").await;
    assert_eq!(list.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(list[0].run_id, b.run_id);
}
```

```rust
//! Агент `glafira-load agent`: HTTP API на axum, SSE, файлы прогона (спека §4).

pub mod auth;
pub mod files;
pub mod runs;
pub mod server;
pub mod sse;

use axum::Json;
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::ApiError;

/// JSON-ошибка протокола без имён и версий.
pub fn api_error(status: StatusCode, code: &str, message: impl Into<String>) -> Response {
    api_error_full(status, ApiError { code: code.into(), message: message.into(), names: vec![], agent: None, controller: None })
}

pub fn api_error_full(status: StatusCode, error: ApiError) -> Response {
    (status, Json(error)).into_response()
}

pub fn not_found(run_id: &str) -> Response {
    api_error(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "NOT_FOUND", format!("run {run_id} is unknown"))
}
```

`crates/glafira-load-cli/src/agent/auth.rs`:

```rust
//! Bearer-аутентификация: без токена или с чужим — 401 (спека §4.3).

use std::sync::Arc;

use axum::extract::{Request, State};
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use axum::http::header::AUTHORIZATION;
use axum::middleware::Next;
use axum::response::Response;

use super::api_error;
use super::runs::AgentState;

pub async fn require_bearer(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>, req: Request, next: Next) -> Response {
    let presented = req
        .headers()
        .get(AUTHORIZATION)
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .and_then(|v| v.strip_prefix("Bearer "))
        .map(str::trim);
    match presented {
        Some(token) if constant_eq(token, &state.token) => next.run(req).await,
        _ => api_error(StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, "UNAUTHORIZED", "missing or invalid bearer token"),
    }
}

/// Сравнение без раннего выхода: время не зависит от длины совпавшего префикса.
fn constant_eq(a: &str, b: &str) -> bool {
    let (a, b) = (a.as_bytes(), b.as_bytes());
    let mut diff = u8::from(a.len() != b.len());
    for i in 0..a.len().max(b.len()) {
        diff |= a.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0) ^ b.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0);
    }
    diff == 0
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::constant_eq;

    #[test]
    fn compares_whole_strings() {
        assert!(constant_eq("abc", "abc"));
        assert!(!constant_eq("abc", "abd"));
        assert!(!constant_eq("abc", "ab"));
        assert!(!constant_eq("", "a"));
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Буфер событий прогона за 120 с с монотонным `id`, живой поток через broadcast и SSE
//! с `Last-Event-ID` (спека §4.3, отступление 9).

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::convert::Infallible;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use axum::extract::{Path, State};
use axum::http::HeaderMap;
use axum::response::sse::{Event as SseEvent, KeepAlive, Sse};
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use futures::Stream;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{Event, RunStatus};
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError;

use super::not_found;
use super::runs::AgentState;

pub const RETENTION: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);
const CHANNEL: usize = 4096;

struct Stored {
    id: u64,
    at: Instant,
    event: Event,
}

struct Inner {
    buf: VecDeque<Stored>,
    next_id: u64,
    done: Option<RunStatus>,
}

/// События одного прогона: буфер для переподключений и broadcast для живых подписчиков.
pub struct EventLog {
    inner: Mutex<Inner>,
    tx: broadcast::Sender<(u64, Event)>,
    retention: Duration,
}

/// Снимок буфера: события с `id > after`, `gap` — часть пропущена (старее буфера), `done` — прогон завершён.
pub struct Replay {
    pub events: Vec<(u64, Event)>,
    pub gap: bool,
    pub done: bool,
}

impl Default for EventLog {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl EventLog {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::with_retention(RETENTION)
    }

    pub fn with_retention(retention: Duration) -> Self {
        let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(CHANNEL);
        Self { inner: Mutex::new(Inner { buf: VecDeque::new(), next_id: 1, done: None }), tx, retention }
    }

    pub fn push(&self, event: Event) -> u64 {
        self.push_at(event, Instant::now())
    }

    /// Кладёт событие с меткой `at` (для тестов вытеснения); после `done` события не принимаются.
    pub fn push_at(&self, event: Event, at: Instant) -> u64 {
        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
        if g.done.is_some() {
            return g.next_id - 1;
        }
        let id = g.next_id;
        g.next_id += 1;
        if let Event::Done(summary) = &event {
            g.done = Some(summary.status.clone());
        }
        let retention = self.retention;
        while g.buf.front().is_some_and(|s| at.saturating_duration_since(s.at) > retention) {
            g.buf.pop_front();
        }
        g.buf.push_back(Stored { id, at, event: event.clone() });
        let _ = self.tx.send((id, event));
        id
    }

    pub fn status(&self) -> Option<RunStatus> {
        self.inner.lock().unwrap().done.clone()
    }

    pub fn is_done(&self) -> bool {
        self.status().is_some()
    }

    pub fn last_id(&self) -> u64 {
        self.inner.lock().unwrap().next_id - 1
    }

    pub fn replay(&self, after: Option<u64>) -> Replay {
        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
        let after = after.unwrap_or(0);
        let gap = match g.buf.front() {
            Some(first) => after + 1 < first.id,
            None => after < g.next_id - 1,
        };
        let events = g.buf.iter().filter(|s| s.id > after).map(|s| (s.id, s.event.clone())).collect();
        Replay { events, gap, done: g.done.is_some() }
    }

    pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver<(u64, Event)> {
        self.tx.subscribe()
    }
}

/// Имя SSE-события — тег `type` из `agent_api::Event`.
pub fn event_name(event: &Event) -> &'static str {
    match event {
        Event::Tick(_) => "tick",
        Event::Phase(_) => "phase",
        Event::Error(_) => "error",
        Event::Done(_) => "done",
        Event::Gap => "gap",
    }
}

fn to_sse(id: Option<u64>, event: &Event) -> SseEvent {
    let mut sse = SseEvent::default().event(event_name(event));
    if let Some(id) = id {
        sse = sse.id(id.to_string());
    }
    match sse.json_data(event) {
        Ok(sse) => sse,
        Err(_) => SseEvent::default().event("gap").data("{\"type\":\"gap\"}"),
    }
}

struct Live {
    pending: VecDeque<(Option<u64>, Event)>,
    rx: broadcast::Receiver<(u64, Event)>,
    /// Последний отданный id: отсекает дубли между снимком и подпиской.
    floor: u64,
    finished: bool,
}

/// Поток SSE: сначала снимок буфера (с `gap`, если `last_id` старее буфера), затем живые события; `done` закрывает поток.
pub fn stream(log: Arc<EventLog>, last_id: Option<u64>) -> impl Stream<Item = Result<SseEvent, Infallible>> + Send + 'static {
    // подписка до снимка: событие между ними придёт по каналу и отсечётся по `floor`
    let rx = log.subscribe();
    let replay = log.replay(last_id);
    let mut pending = VecDeque::new();
    if replay.gap {
        pending.push_back((None, Event::Gap));
    }
    let mut floor = last_id.unwrap_or(0);
    for (id, event) in replay.events {
        floor = floor.max(id);
        pending.push_back((Some(id), event));
    }
    let live = Live { pending, rx, floor, finished: replay.done };
    futures::stream::unfold((live, log), |(mut st, log)| async move {
        loop {
            if let Some((id, event)) = st.pending.pop_front() {
                if matches!(event, Event::Done(_)) {
                    st.finished = true;
                    st.pending.clear();
                }
                return Some((Ok(to_sse(id, &event)), (st, log)));
            }
            if st.finished {
                return None;
            }
            match st.rx.recv().await {
                Ok((id, event)) if id > st.floor => {
                    st.floor = id;
                    st.pending.push_back((Some(id), event));
                }
                Ok(_) => {}
                Err(RecvError::Lagged(_)) => {
                    // отстали от канала — добираем из буфера
                    let r = log.replay(Some(st.floor));
                    if r.gap {
                        st.pending.push_back((None, Event::Gap));
                    }
                    for (id, event) in r.events {
                        st.floor = st.floor.max(id);
                        st.pending.push_back((Some(id), event));
                    }
                    if r.done && st.pending.is_empty() {
                        st.finished = true;
                    }
                }
                Err(RecvError::Closed) => st.finished = true,
            }
        }
    })
}

/// `GET /v1/runs/{id}/events`.
pub async fn events(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>, Path(run_id): Path<String>, headers: HeaderMap) -> Response {
    let Some(log) = state.find_log(&run_id) else {
        return not_found(&run_id);
    };
    let last_id = headers.get("last-event-id").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<u64>().ok());
    Sse::new(stream(log, last_id)).keep_alive(KeepAlive::default()).into_response()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use futures::StreamExt;
    use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentSummary, Tick};

    use super::*;

    fn tick(t: u64) -> Event {
        Event::Tick(Tick { t, ops: vec![], scenarios: vec![] })
    }

    fn done() -> Event {
        Event::Done(AgentSummary { status: RunStatus::Completed, ops: vec![], scenarios: vec![], seconds: 2 })
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn replay_and_stream_end_with_done() {
        let log = Arc::new(EventLog::new());
        assert_eq!((log.push(tick(1)), log.push(tick(2)), log.push(done())), (1, 2, 3));
        assert_eq!(log.push(tick(3)), 3, "после done ничего не принимается");
        assert!(matches!(log.status(), Some(RunStatus::Completed)));
        let r = log.replay(Some(1));
        assert_eq!(r.events.iter().map(|(id, _)| *id).collect::<Vec<_>>(), [2, 3]);
        assert!(!r.gap && r.done);
        assert_eq!(stream(log.clone(), None).collect::<Vec<_>>().await.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(stream(log.clone(), Some(2)).collect::<Vec<_>>().await.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(stream(log, Some(3)).collect::<Vec<_>>().await.len(), 0);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn evicted_events_produce_gap() {
        let log = Arc::new(EventLog::new());
        let now = Instant::now();
        log.push_at(tick(1), now - Duration::from_secs(200));
        log.push_at(tick(2), now - Duration::from_secs(200));
        log.push_at(tick(3), now);
        let r = log.replay(Some(1));
        assert!(r.gap);
        assert_eq!(r.events.iter().map(|(id, _)| *id).collect::<Vec<_>>(), [3]);
        assert!(!log.replay(Some(2)).gap);
        assert!(log.replay(None).gap, "свежее подключение тоже пропустило начало");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn live_subscriber_receives_events_pushed_later() {
        let log = Arc::new(EventLog::new());
        log.push(tick(1));
        let collected = tokio::spawn(stream(log.clone(), None).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
        log.push(tick(2));
        log.push(done());
        assert_eq!(collected.await.unwrap().len(), 3);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! `GET /v1/runs/{id}/files`: tar папки прогона без сжатия (спека §4.3).

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;

use axum::extract::{Path as AxPath, State};
use axum::http::{StatusCode, header};
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

use super::runs::AgentState;
use super::{api_error, not_found};

/// Обычные файлы папки (без вложенных) по алфавиту, имена без путей.
pub fn tar_dir(dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(dir)?.filter_map(Result::ok).map(|e| e.path()).filter(|p| p.is_file()).collect();
    files.sort();
    let mut builder = tar::Builder::new(Vec::new());
    for path in files {
        let Some(name) = path.file_name() else { continue };
        builder.append_path_with_name(&path, name)?;
    }
    builder.into_inner()
}

pub async fn files(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>, AxPath(run_id): AxPath<String>) -> Response {
    let Some(dir) = state.run_dir(&run_id).filter(|d| d.is_dir()) else {
        return not_found(&run_id);
    };
    match tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || tar_dir(&dir)).await {
        Ok(Ok(bytes)) => ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/x-tar")], bytes).into_response(),
        Ok(Err(e)) => api_error(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "IO", format!("cannot pack run files: {e}")),
        Err(e) => api_error(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "IO", e.to_string()),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::tar_dir;

    #[test]
    fn packs_plain_files_sorted() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.path().join("summary.yaml"), "status: completed\n").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.path().join("agent.log"), "hi\n").unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir(dir.path().join("sub")).unwrap();
        let bytes = tar_dir(dir.path()).unwrap();
        let names: Vec<String> = tar::Archive::new(&bytes[..]).entries().unwrap().map(|e| e.unwrap().path().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned()).collect();
        assert_eq!(names, ["agent.log", "summary.yaml"]);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Состояние агента: текущий прогон, история, запуск через `LocalAgent`, остановка с дренажом,
//! обработчики `/v1/info`, `/v1/runs`, `/v1/runs/{id}/stop` (спека §4.1, §4.3, §4.4).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::fs::File;
use std::io::{self, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;

use axum::Json;
use axum::extract::{Multipart, Path as AxPath, State};
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use futures::StreamExt;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentInfo, AgentSummary, ApiError, Event, RunListItem, RunRequest, RunStatus};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::{AgentLink, LinkError, LocalAgent, SECRET_PREFIX, same_minor};
use glafira_load_engine::local::executor_factory;
use glafira_load_model::suite;
use serde::Serialize;
use time::OffsetDateTime;
use time::format_description::well_known::Rfc3339;
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
use tracing_subscriber::fmt::MakeWriter;

use super::sse::EventLog;
use super::{api_error, api_error_full, not_found};
use crate::console::status_label;

pub const AGENT_LOG: &str = "agent.log";
pub const SUMMARY_FILE: &str = "summary.yaml";
pub const REQUEST_FILE: &str = "run.json";

pub struct AgentConfig {
    pub work_dir: PathBuf,
    pub keep_runs: usize,
    pub drain: Duration,
    pub token: String,
    /// Секреты стенда: имя без префикса `GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_` → значение.
    pub secrets_env: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub version: String,
}

pub struct RunningRun {
    pub run_id: String,
    pub started_at: String,
    pub dir: PathBuf,
    pub log: Arc<EventLog>,
    pub agent: Arc<LocalAgent>,
    pub pump: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
}

pub struct FinishedRun {
    pub run_id: String,
    pub started_at: String,
    pub status: RunStatus,
    pub dir: PathBuf,
    /// Буфер событий для переподключений после `done`; у прогонов до рестарта агента его нет.
    pub log: Option<Arc<EventLog>>,
}

pub struct AgentState {
    pub current: Mutex<Option<RunningRun>>,
    pub history: Mutex<Vec<FinishedRun>>,
    pub work_dir: PathBuf,
    pub keep_runs: usize,
    pub drain: Duration,
    pub token: String,
    pub secrets_env: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub version: String,
    pub log_sink: LogSink,
}

/// Писатель `tracing`: stderr всегда, плюс `agent.log` текущего прогона.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct LogSink(Arc<Mutex<Option<File>>>);

impl LogSink {
    pub fn set(&self, file: Option<File>) {
        *self.0.lock().unwrap() = file;
    }
}

pub struct SinkWriter(LogSink);

impl Write for SinkWriter {
    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {
        let _ = io::stderr().write_all(buf);
        if let Some(file) = self.0.0.lock().unwrap().as_mut() {
            let _ = file.write_all(buf);
        }
        Ok(buf.len())
    }

    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
        if let Some(file) = self.0.0.lock().unwrap().as_mut() {
            file.flush()?;
        }
        io::stderr().flush()
    }
}

impl<'a> MakeWriter<'a> for LogSink {
    type Writer = SinkWriter;

    fn make_writer(&'a self) -> SinkWriter {
        SinkWriter(self.clone())
    }
}

/// `GLAFIRA_LOAD_SECRET_<NAME>=value` → `NAME → value` (карта для `LocalAgent::with_secrets`).
pub fn secrets_from_vars(vars: impl Iterator<Item = (String, String)>) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
    vars.filter_map(|(k, v)| k.strip_prefix(SECRET_PREFIX).map(|name| (name.to_string(), v))).collect()
}

pub fn now_rfc3339() -> String {
    OffsetDateTime::now_utc().format(&Rfc3339).unwrap_or_default()
}

fn busy_response(run_id: &str) -> Response {
    api_error(StatusCode::CONFLICT, "AGENT_BUSY", format!("agent is running {run_id}"))
}

fn link_error_response(e: LinkError, agent_version: &str, controller_version: &str) -> Response {
    let status = match e.code.as_str() {
        "AGENT_BUSY" => StatusCode::CONFLICT,
        "SECRET_MISSING" => StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED,
        "SUITE_INVALID" => StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
        "AGENT_VERSION" => StatusCode::UPGRADE_REQUIRED,
        _ => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
    };
    let (agent, controller) = if e.code == "AGENT_VERSION" { (Some(agent_version.into()), Some(controller_version.into())) } else { (None, None) };
    api_error_full(status, ApiError { code: e.code, message: e.message, names: e.names, agent, controller })
}

fn write_summary(dir: &Path, summary: &AgentSummary) {
    let tmp = dir.join(format!("{SUMMARY_FILE}.tmp"));
    let result = std::fs::write(&tmp, glafira_load_model::to_yaml(summary)).and_then(|_| std::fs::rename(&tmp, dir.join(SUMMARY_FILE)));
    if let Err(e) = result {
        tracing::warn!("cannot write {SUMMARY_FILE}: {e}");
    }
}

/// Файлы `LocalAgent` (`metrics.jsonl`, `errors.jsonl`, `summary.yaml`, `hist.bin`) из tar в папку прогона.
fn unpack_agent_files(dir: &Path, tar: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
    tar::Archive::new(tar).unpack(dir)
}

/// Насос: события `LocalAgent` → буфер SSE; после `done` забирает файлы агента (`files()` → tar →
/// `work/<run_id>/`) и пишет `summary.yaml`; обрыв без `done` — `failed`.
async fn pump_events(state: Arc<AgentState>, agent: Arc<LocalAgent>, log: Arc<EventLog>, run_id: String, dir: PathBuf) {
    let mut finished: Option<AgentSummary> = None;
    match agent.events(&run_id, None).await {
        Ok(mut stream) => {
            while let Some((_, event)) = stream.next().await {
                if let Event::Done(summary) = &event {
                    finished = Some(summary.clone());
                }
                let done = matches!(event, Event::Done(_));
                log.push(event);
                if done {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        Err(e) => tracing::error!(run_id, "events: {}", e.message),
    }
    if let Some(summary) = finished {
        // Файлы собираются до переноса в историю: `GET /v1/runs/{id}/files` после `done` видит их все.
        match agent.files(&run_id).await {
            Ok(tar) => {
                let (d, t) = (dir.clone(), tar);
                if let Err(e) = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || unpack_agent_files(&d, &t)).await.unwrap_or_else(|e| Err(io::Error::other(e))) {
                    tracing::warn!(run_id, "cannot unpack agent files: {e}");
                }
            }
            Err(e) => tracing::warn!(run_id, "files: {}", e.message),
        }
        write_summary(&dir, &summary);
    }
    if !log.is_done() {
        tracing::error!(run_id, "event stream ended without done");
        let failed = AgentSummary { status: RunStatus::Failed, ops: vec![], scenarios: vec![], seconds: 0 };
        write_summary(&dir, &failed);
        log.push(Event::Done(failed));
    }
    state.finish(&run_id);
}

impl AgentState {
    /// Создаёт состояние, перечитывает папки прошлых прогонов в `work_dir` и удаляет лишние по `keep_runs`.
    pub fn new(config: AgentConfig) -> io::Result<Arc<Self>> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.work_dir)?;
        let mut history = Vec::new();
        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&config.work_dir)? {
            let entry = entry?;
            let dir = entry.path();
            if !dir.is_dir() {
                continue;
            }
            let started_at = entry
                .metadata()
                .and_then(|m| m.modified())
                .map(|t| OffsetDateTime::from(t).format(&Rfc3339).unwrap_or_default())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let status = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(SUMMARY_FILE))
                .ok()
                .and_then(|text| glafira_load_model::from_yaml::<AgentSummary>(&text).ok())
                .map(|s| s.status)
                .unwrap_or(RunStatus::Incomplete);
            history.push(FinishedRun { run_id: entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned(), started_at, status, dir, log: None });
        }
        history.sort_by(|a, b| a.started_at.cmp(&b.started_at));
        let state = Arc::new(Self {
            current: Mutex::new(None),
            history: Mutex::new(history),
            work_dir: config.work_dir,
            keep_runs: config.keep_runs.max(1),
            drain: config.drain,
            token: config.token,
            secrets_env: config.secrets_env,
            version: config.version,
            log_sink: LogSink::default(),
        });
        state.prune(0);
        Ok(state)
    }

    /// Удаляет старые прогоны так, чтобы вместе с `reserve` новыми их было не больше `keep_runs`.
    fn prune(&self, reserve: usize) {
        let mut history = self.history.lock().unwrap();
        while history.len() + reserve > self.keep_runs && !history.is_empty() {
            let old = history.remove(0);
            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&old.dir) {
                if e.kind() != io::ErrorKind::NotFound {
                    tracing::warn!("cannot remove {}: {e}", old.dir.display());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn busy(&self) -> Option<String> {
        self.current.lock().unwrap().as_ref().map(|r| r.run_id.clone())
    }

    pub fn find_log(&self, run_id: &str) -> Option<Arc<EventLog>> {
        if let Some(r) = self.current.lock().unwrap().as_ref() {
            if r.run_id == run_id {
                return Some(r.log.clone());
            }
        }
        self.history.lock().unwrap().iter().find(|r| r.run_id == run_id).and_then(|r| r.log.clone())
    }

    pub fn run_dir(&self, run_id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        if let Some(r) = self.current.lock().unwrap().as_ref() {
            if r.run_id == run_id {
                return Some(r.dir.clone());
            }
        }
        self.history.lock().unwrap().iter().find(|r| r.run_id == run_id).map(|r| r.dir.clone())
    }

    pub fn list(&self) -> Vec<RunListItem> {
        self.history
            .lock()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .map(|r| RunListItem { run_id: r.run_id.clone(), status: r.status.clone(), started_at: r.started_at.clone() })
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn info(&self) -> AgentInfo {
        AgentInfo {
            version: self.version.clone(),
            os: std::env::consts::OS.into(),
            arch: std::env::consts::ARCH.into(),
            cpus: std::thread::available_parallelism().map(|n| n.get()).unwrap_or(1),
            busy: self.busy(),
        }
    }

    fn prepare_dir(&self, dir: &Path, req: &RunRequest) -> io::Result<()> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
        std::fs::write(dir.join(REQUEST_FILE), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(req)?)?;
        self.log_sink.set(Some(File::create(dir.join(AGENT_LOG))?));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn clear_current(&self, run_id: &str) -> Option<RunningRun> {
        let mut current = self.current.lock().unwrap();
        if current.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.run_id == run_id) { current.take() } else { None }
    }

    /// Запуск: папка `work/<run_id>/`, `LocalAgent::start`, насос событий. Слот занимается до первого `await`.
    pub async fn launch(self: &Arc<Self>, req: RunRequest, suite_text: String, data: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, secrets: BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Result<(), Response> {
        let run_id = req.run_id.clone();
        if run_id.is_empty() || run_id.starts_with('.') || run_id.contains(['/', '\\']) {
            return Err(api_error(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "BAD_REQUEST", "run_id must be a plain folder name"));
        }
        self.prune(1);
        let dir = self.work_dir.join(&run_id);
        let log = Arc::new(EventLog::new());
        let agent = Arc::new(LocalAgent::new(&req.agent_id, executor_factory()).with_secrets(secrets));
        {
            let mut current = self.current.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some(r) = current.as_ref() {
                return Err(busy_response(&r.run_id));
            }
            *current = Some(RunningRun { run_id: run_id.clone(), started_at: now_rfc3339(), dir: dir.clone(), log: log.clone(), agent: agent.clone(), pump: None });
        }
        if let Err(e) = self.prepare_dir(&dir, &req) {
            self.clear_current(&run_id);
            return Err(api_error(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "IO", format!("cannot prepare {}: {e}", dir.display())));
        }
        tracing::info!(run_id, suite = %req.suite_name, "run accepted");
        if let Err(e) = agent.start(&req, &suite_text, &data).await {
            tracing::error!(run_id, code = %e.code, "run rejected: {}", e.message);
            self.clear_current(&run_id);
            self.log_sink.set(None);
            return Err(link_error_response(e, &self.version, &req.controller_version));
        }
        let pump = tokio::spawn(pump_events(self.clone(), agent, log, run_id.clone(), dir));
        if let Some(r) = self.current.lock().unwrap().as_mut() {
            if r.run_id == run_id {
                r.pump = Some(pump);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Переносит прогон в историю; статус — из `done` буфера.
    pub fn finish(&self, run_id: &str) {
        let Some(run) = self.clear_current(run_id) else { return };
        let status = run.log.status().unwrap_or(RunStatus::Failed);
        tracing::info!(run_id, status = status_label(&status), "run finished");
        self.log_sink.set(None);
        self.history.lock().unwrap().push(FinishedRun { run_id: run.run_id, started_at: run.started_at, status, dir: run.dir, log: Some(run.log) });
    }

    /// Мягкая остановка: отмена в `LocalAgent`, затем сторож на `drain` — если `done` не пришёл, прогон закрываем сами.
    pub async fn stop(self: &Arc<Self>, run_id: &str) -> Result<(), Response> {
        let agent = {
            let current = self.current.lock().unwrap();
            match current.as_ref() {
                Some(r) if r.run_id == run_id => r.agent.clone(),
                _ => return if self.run_dir(run_id).is_some() { Ok(()) } else { Err(not_found(run_id)) },
            }
        };
        tracing::info!(run_id, "stop requested");
        if let Err(e) = agent.stop(run_id).await {
            tracing::warn!(run_id, "stop: {}", e.message);
        }
        let state = self.clone();
        let id = run_id.to_string();
        let drain = self.drain;
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            tokio::time::sleep(drain).await;
            state.force_done(&id, RunStatus::Stopped);
        });
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Принудительное завершение: насос прерывается, в буфер идёт `done` с пустой сводкой.
    pub fn force_done(&self, run_id: &str, status: RunStatus) {
        let (log, pump) = {
            let mut current = self.current.lock().unwrap();
            match current.as_mut() {
                Some(r) if r.run_id == run_id && !r.log.is_done() => (r.log.clone(), r.pump.take()),
                _ => return,
            }
        };
        if let Some(pump) = pump {
            pump.abort();
        }
        tracing::warn!(run_id, "drain timeout: closing the run as {}", status_label(&status));
        let summary = AgentSummary { status, ops: vec![], scenarios: vec![], seconds: 0 };
        write_summary(&self.work_dir.join(run_id), &summary);
        log.push(Event::Done(summary));
        self.finish(run_id);
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct StartResponse {
    pub run_id: String,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Bundle {
    run: Option<RunRequest>,
    suite: Option<String>,
    data: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}

/// Части бандла: `run.json`, `suite.yaml`, `data/<набор>`; прочие части игнорируются.
async fn read_bundle(mut multipart: Multipart) -> Result<Bundle, Response> {
    let bad = |m: String| api_error(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "BAD_REQUEST", m);
    let mut bundle = Bundle::default();
    while let Some(field) = multipart.next_field().await.map_err(|e| bad(format!("multipart: {e}")))? {
        let name = field.name().unwrap_or("").to_string();
        let bytes = field.bytes().await.map_err(|e| bad(format!("multipart part {name}: {e}")))?;
        if name == "run.json" {
            bundle.run = Some(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|e| bad(format!("run.json: {e}")))?);
        } else if name == "suite.yaml" {
            bundle.suite = Some(String::from_utf8(bytes.to_vec()).map_err(|_| bad("suite.yaml is not UTF-8".into()))?);
        } else if let Some(set) = name.strip_prefix("data/") {
            bundle.data.insert(set.to_string(), bytes.to_vec());
        }
    }
    Ok(bundle)
}

/// `GET /v1/info`.
pub async fn info(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>) -> Json<AgentInfo> {
    Json(state.info())
}

/// `GET /v1/runs` — история завершённых прогонов.
pub async fn list(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>) -> Json<Vec<RunListItem>> {
    Json(state.list())
}

/// `POST /v1/runs`: 409 занят, 426 версия или формат сьюта, 422 сьют, 412 секреты, 202 принят.
pub async fn start(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>, multipart: Multipart) -> Response {
    let bundle = match read_bundle(multipart).await {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(r) => return r,
    };
    let Some(req) = bundle.run else {
        return api_error(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "BAD_REQUEST", "run.json is missing");
    };
    let Some(suite_text) = bundle.suite else {
        return api_error(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "BAD_REQUEST", "suite.yaml is missing");
    };
    if let Some(id) = state.busy() {
        return busy_response(&id);
    }
    if !same_minor(&req.controller_version, &state.version) || req.suite_format != suite::FORMAT {
        return api_error_full(
            StatusCode::UPGRADE_REQUIRED,
            ApiError {
                code: "AGENT_VERSION".into(),
                message: format!(
                    "agent {} (suite format {}) does not match controller {} (suite format {})",
                    state.version,
                    suite::FORMAT,
                    req.controller_version,
                    req.suite_format
                ),
                names: vec![],
                agent: Some(state.version.clone()),
                controller: Some(req.controller_version.clone()),
            },
        );
    }
    let parsed = match suite::parse(&suite_text) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => {
            let message = match e.line {
                Some(line) => format!("suite.yaml:{line}: {}", e.message),
                None => e.message,
            };
            return api_error(StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "SUITE_INVALID", message);
        }
    };
    // секреты из запроса и из сьюта — на агенте должны быть все
    let mut wanted = req.secrets.clone();
    for name in &parsed.secrets {
        if !wanted.contains(name) {
            wanted.push(name.clone());
        }
    }
    let missing: Vec<String> = wanted.iter().filter(|n| !state.secrets_env.contains_key(n.as_str())).cloned().collect();
    if !missing.is_empty() {
        return api_error_full(
            StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED,
            ApiError { code: "SECRET_MISSING".into(), message: format!("missing secrets on the agent: {}", missing.join(", ")), names: missing, agent: None, controller: None },
        );
    }
    let secrets: BTreeMap<String, String> = wanted.iter().filter_map(|n| state.secrets_env.get(n).map(|v| (n.clone(), v.clone()))).collect();
    let run_id = req.run_id.clone();
    match state.launch(req, suite_text, bundle.data, secrets).await {
        Ok(()) => (StatusCode::ACCEPTED, Json(StartResponse { run_id })).into_response(),
        Err(r) => r,
    }
}

/// `POST /v1/runs/{id}/stop`: 200 и для уже завершённого прогона, 404 для неизвестного.
pub async fn stop(State(state): State<Arc<AgentState>>, AxPath(run_id): AxPath<String>) -> Response {
    match state.stop(&run_id).await {
        Ok(()) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(StartResponse { run_id })).into_response(),
        Err(r) => r,
    }
}

        assert!(same_minor("0.2.0", "0.2.7") && !same_minor("0.2.0", "0.3.0") && !same_minor("0.2.0", "garbage"));

    #[test]

        let state = AgentState::new(config).unwrap();
        let list = state.list();
        assert_eq!(list.iter().map(|r| r.run_id.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), ["b", "c"], "самый старый удалён");
        assert!(matches!(list[0].status, RunStatus::Incomplete));
        assert!(matches!(list[1].status, RunStatus::Stopped));
        assert!(!work.path().join("a").exists());
        assert_eq!(state.busy(), None);
        assert!(state.find_log("b").is_none(), "у прогонов до рестарта буфера нет");
        assert_eq!(state.run_dir("c"), Some(work.path().join("c")));
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Маршруты агента и запуск сервера (спека §4.3).

use std::future::Future;
use std::sync::Arc;

use axum::Router;
use axum::extract::DefaultBodyLimit;
use axum::middleware;
use axum::routing::{get, post};
use tokio::net::TcpListener;

use super::runs::{self, AgentState};
use super::{auth, files, sse};

/// Бандл несёт сьют и файлы данных: потолок тела — 1 ГиБ.
pub const BODY_LIMIT: usize = 1 << 30;

pub fn router(state: Arc<AgentState>) -> Router {
    Router::new()
        .route("/v1/info", get(runs::info))
        .route("/v1/runs", get(runs::list).post(runs::start))
        .route("/v1/runs/{id}/events", get(sse::events))
        .route("/v1/runs/{id}/stop", post(runs::stop))
        .route("/v1/runs/{id}/files", get(files::files))
        .layer(DefaultBodyLimit::max(BODY_LIMIT))
        .layer(middleware::from_fn_with_state(state.clone(), auth::require_bearer))
        .with_state(state)
}

pub async fn serve(listener: TcpListener, state: Arc<AgentState>, shutdown: impl Future<Output = ()> + Send + 'static) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    axum::serve(listener, router(state)).with_graceful_shutdown(shutdown).await
}
```

```rust
//! `glafira-load agent`: адрес, токен, папка работы, запуск сервера до Ctrl+C (спека §4.1).

use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

use tokio::net::TcpListener;
use tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter;

use super::startup_error;
use crate::agent::runs::{AgentConfig, AgentState, secrets_from_vars};
use crate::agent::server;
use crate::exit::{Exit, OK};

pub const TOKEN_ENV: &str = "GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN";

pub struct AgentArgs {
    pub listen: String,
    pub token: Option<String>,
    pub token_file: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub work: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub keep_runs: usize,
    pub drain_ms: u64,
}

/// Токен: `--token`, затем `--token-file`, затем переменная окружения; пустые значения — как отсутствующие.
pub fn resolve_token(token: Option<String>, token_file: Option<&Path>, env: Option<String>) -> Result<String, String> {
    if let Some(t) = token.filter(|t| !t.trim().is_empty()) {
        return Ok(t.trim().to_string());
    }
    if let Some(file) = token_file {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(file).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read token file {}: {e}", file.display()))?;
        let t = text.trim();
        if t.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!("token file {} is empty", file.display()));
        }
        return Ok(t.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(t) = env.filter(|t| !t.trim().is_empty()) {
        return Ok(t.trim().to_string());
    }
    Err(format!("agent token is required: pass --token, --token-file or set {TOKEN_ENV}"))
}

pub fn default_work_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::temp_dir().join("glafira-load-agent")
}

pub async fn agent(args: AgentArgs) -> Exit {
    let token = match resolve_token(args.token, args.token_file.as_deref(), std::env::var(TOKEN_ENV).ok()) {
        Ok(t) => t,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&e),
    };
    let addr: SocketAddr = match args.listen.parse() {
        Ok(a) => a,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&format!("--listen {}: {e}", args.listen)),
    };
    let vars = std::env::vars_os().filter_map(|(k, v)| Some((k.into_string().ok()?, v.into_string().ok()?)));
    let config = AgentConfig {
        work_dir: args.work.unwrap_or_else(default_work_dir),
        keep_runs: args.keep_runs,
        drain: Duration::from_millis(args.drain_ms),
        token,
        secrets_env: secrets_from_vars(vars),
        version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into(),
    };
    let state = match AgentState::new(config) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&format!("work dir: {e}")),
    };
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(EnvFilter::try_from_default_env().unwrap_or_else(|_| EnvFilter::new("info")))
        .with_ansi(false)
        .with_writer(state.log_sink.clone())
        .init();
    let listener = match TcpListener::bind(addr).await {
        Ok(l) => l,
        Err(e) => return startup_error(&format!("cannot listen on {addr}: {e}")),
    };
    tracing::info!("glafira-load agent {} listening on {addr}, work dir {}, {} secret(s)", state.version, state.work_dir.display(), state.secrets_env.len());
    let shutdown = async {
        let _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await;
        tracing::info!("shutting down");
    };
    if let Err(e) = server::serve(listener, state, shutdown).await {
        return startup_error(&format!("server: {e}"));
    }
    Exit(OK)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn token_sources_in_order() {
        assert!(resolve_token(None, None, None).unwrap_err().contains(TOKEN_ENV));
        assert!(resolve_token(Some("  ".into()), None, None).is_err());
        assert_eq!(resolve_token(Some(" a ".into()), None, Some("c".into())).unwrap(), "a");
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let file = dir.path().join("token");
        std::fs::write(&file, "b\n").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(resolve_token(None, Some(&file), Some("c".into())).unwrap(), "b");
        std::fs::write(&file, "\n").unwrap();
        assert!(resolve_token(None, Some(&file), None).unwrap_err().contains("empty"));
        assert!(resolve_token(None, Some(&dir.path().join("none")), None).unwrap_err().contains("cannot read"));
        assert_eq!(resolve_token(None, None, Some("c".into())).unwrap(), "c");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Бинарник `glafira-load`: разбор аргументов и выбор команды (спека §5.4, §4.1).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use clap::error::ErrorKind;
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use glafira_load_cli::cmd;
use glafira_load_cli::cmd::agent::AgentArgs;
use glafira_load_cli::cmd::run::RunArgs;
use glafira_load_cli::cmd::smoke::SmokeArgs;
use glafira_load_cli::exit::{Exit, OK, STARTUP};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "glafira-load", version, about = "Glafira for Load Testing: check and smoke suites, run load profiles, serve as a load agent")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Command,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Command {
    /// Check one suite or all suites of the project without network (exit 4 on errors)
    Check {
        /// Project folder
        project: PathBuf,
        /// Suite name; all suites when omitted
        #[arg(long)]
        suite: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Run every scenario of a suite once against an environment (exit 4 on failed steps)
    Smoke {
        /// Project folder
        project: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long)]
        suite: String,
        /// Environment id from the project manifest
        #[arg(long)]
        env: String,
        /// Run folder; default `runs/smoke-<timestamp>` inside the project
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// Run a load profile locally (exit 2 when stopped with Ctrl+C)
    Run {
        /// Project folder
        project: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long)]
        profile: String,
        /// Environment id from the project manifest
        #[arg(long)]
        env: String,
        /// Suite name; the only suite of the project when omitted
        #[arg(long)]
        suite: Option<String>,
        /// Cap of concurrent iterations; overrides `defaults.max_in_flight`
        #[arg(long = "max-in-flight")]
        max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
        /// Run folder; default `runs/<timestamp>` inside the project
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// Serve as a load agent for a controller
    Agent {
        /// Address to listen on, e.g. 0.0.0.0:7420
        #[arg(long)]
        listen: String,
        /// Bearer token; alternatively --token-file or GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN
        #[arg(long)]
        token: Option<String>,
        /// File with the bearer token
        #[arg(long = "token-file")]
        token_file: Option<PathBuf>,
        /// Folder for run bundles and files; default <temp>/glafira-load-agent
        #[arg(long)]
        work: Option<PathBuf>,
        /// How many finished runs to keep on disk
        #[arg(long = "keep-runs", default_value_t = 10)]
        keep_runs: usize,
        /// How long in-flight iterations may finish after stop
        #[arg(long = "drain-ms", default_value_t = 5000)]
        drain_ms: u64,
    },
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Exit {
    // clap завершал бы процесс кодом 2, а он занят значением «остановлено»: ошибки разбора → 3, help/version → 0
    let cli = match Cli::try_parse() {
        Ok(cli) => cli,
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = e.print();
            return if matches!(e.kind(), ErrorKind::DisplayHelp | ErrorKind::DisplayVersion) { Exit(OK) } else { Exit(STARTUP) };
        }
    };
    match cli.command {
        Command::Check { project, suite } => cmd::check::check(project, suite).await,
        Command::Smoke { project, suite, env, out } => cmd::smoke::smoke(SmokeArgs { project, suite, env, out }).await,
        Command::Run { project, profile, env, suite, max_in_flight, out } => {
            cmd::run::run(RunArgs { project, profile, env, suite, max_in_flight, out }).await
        }
        Command::Agent { listen, token, token_file, work, keep_runs, drain_ms } => {
            cmd::agent::agent(AgentArgs { listen, token, token_file, work, keep_runs, drain_ms }).await
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 11a: Бандлы агентов, слияние тиков и чтение `hist.bin`

Решение: `hist.bin` пишется и читается кодом Task 8 (`run_files::{hist_log, totals_from_hist_log}`: interval log `hdrhistogram`, тег — id операции либо `scenario:<id>`, пробел и запятая кодируются `%20`/`%2C`); контроллер только читает файлы агентов этой функцией. Счётчики итога (`n`, `err`, `dropped`, байты, `per_second_max`) контроллер берёт из собственной суммы тиков, гистограммы — из `hist.bin` агентов; при разрыве SSE (`gap`) счётчики занижены, и прогон в любом случае `incomplete`.

Решение: `controller::merge::merge_ticks` сводит тики одной секунды сам (перцентили — взвешенное по `n` среднее, точные — только в `summary.yaml` из гистограмм); `metrics::merge_ticks` Task 4 контроллер не вызывает.
