```rust
//! Бандлы прогона: доли целей и строк данных по весам агентов, `RunRequest` каждого агента (спека §4.4–§4.5).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use glafira_load_model::project::Environment;
use glafira_load_model::suite::DataMode;

use crate::agent_api::{EnvAddresses, RunRequest};
use crate::controller::{CONTROLLER_VERSION, EngineError, RunPlan};

/// Цели операций, умноженные на долю каждого агента (`weight / Σweight`).
pub fn split_targets(targets: &BTreeMap<String, f64>, agents: &[(String, u32)]) -> Vec<BTreeMap<String, f64>> {
    let total: u32 = agents.iter().map(|(_, w)| *w).sum();
    agents
        .iter()
        .map(|(_, w)| {
            let share = if total == 0 { 0.0 } else { *w as f64 / total as f64 };
            targets.iter().map(|(id, v)| (id.clone(), v * share)).collect()
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Строки `slice`-набора по агентам: строка `i` уходит агенту, которому принадлежит позиция
/// `i mod Σweight` круга, где агент с весом `w` занимает `w` позиций подряд (отступление плана 4).
pub fn slice_rows(rows: &[String], agents: &[(String, u32)]) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
    let mut out: Vec<Vec<String>> = vec![Vec::new(); agents.len()];
    let mut owner = Vec::new();
    for (i, (_, w)) in agents.iter().enumerate() {
        owner.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(i, *w as usize));
    }
    if owner.is_empty() {
        return out;
    }
    for (i, row) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
        out[owner[i % owner.len()]].push(row.clone());
    }
    out
}

/// Цели операций плана: `id → RPS`.
pub fn targets_of(plan: &RunPlan) -> BTreeMap<String, f64> {
    plan.computed.targets.iter().map(|t| (t.id.clone(), t.target)).collect()
}

pub fn env_addresses(env: &Environment) -> EnvAddresses {
    EnvAddresses { http: env.http.clone(), kafka: env.kafka.clone(), schema_registry: env.schema_registry.clone() }
}

/// Потолок одновременности агента: ключ запуска, иначе `defaults.max_in_flight` сьюта.
pub fn max_in_flight(plan: &RunPlan) -> u32 {
    plan.max_in_flight.unwrap_or(plan.suite.defaults.max_in_flight)
}

/// Бандл одного агента: запрос и файлы данных (ключ — имя набора из `suite.data`;
/// агент кладёт содержимое по `suite.data[name].path` в рабочей папке прогона).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Bundle {
    pub request: RunRequest,
    pub data: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}

/// Бандлы всех агентов: цели по весам, `slice`-наборы нарезаны построчно (CSV — с заголовком у каждого),
/// `shared` — целиком. Нарезка построчная: многострочные поля CSV в кавычках в режиме `slice` не поддерживаются.
pub fn bundles(plan: &RunPlan, run_id: &str, agents: &[(String, u32)]) -> Result<Vec<Bundle>, EngineError> {
    let shares = split_targets(&targets_of(plan), agents);
    let mut data: Vec<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>> = vec![BTreeMap::new(); agents.len()];
    for (name, set) in &plan.suite.data {
        let path = plan.root.join(&set.path);
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
            .map_err(|e| EngineError::io(format!("cannot read data file {}: {e}", set.path)))?;
        match set.mode {
            DataMode::Shared => {
                for d in &mut data {
                    d.insert(name.clone(), text.clone().into_bytes());
                }
            }
            DataMode::Slice => {
                let is_csv = set.path.to_ascii_lowercase().ends_with(".csv");
                let mut lines = text.lines();
                let header = if is_csv { lines.next().map(str::to_string) } else { None };
                let rows: Vec<String> = lines.filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).map(str::to_string).collect();
                for (i, part) in slice_rows(&rows, agents).into_iter().enumerate() {
                    let mut out = String::new();
                    if let Some(h) = &header {
                        out.push_str(h);
                        out.push('\n');
                    }
                    for row in part {
                        out.push_str(&row);
                        out.push('\n');
                    }
                    data[i].insert(name.clone(), out.into_bytes());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(agents
        .iter()
        .zip(shares)
        .zip(data)
        .map(|(((id, _), targets), data)| Bundle {
            request: RunRequest {
                run_id: run_id.to_string(),
                agent_id: id.clone(),
                suite_name: plan.suite_name.clone(),
                controller_version: CONTROLLER_VERSION.to_string(),
                suite_format: plan.suite.format,
                env: env_addresses(&plan.env),
                secrets: plan.suite.secrets.clone(),
                targets,
                timeline: plan.computed.timeline.clone(),
                total_minutes: plan.computed.total_minutes,
                max_in_flight: max_in_flight(plan),
                arrival: plan.suite.defaults.arrival,
                mode: plan.mode,
                kafka: plan.suite.defaults.kafka.clone(),
                response_schemas: plan.response_schemas.clone(),
                avro_schemas: plan.avro_schemas.clone(),
            },
            data,
        })
        .collect())
}
```

```rust
//! Сведение тиков разных агентов в общий посекундный ряд (спека §4.5 п. 5).

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::agent_api::{OpTick, ScenarioTick, Tick};

    fn op(id: &str, n: u64, p50: f64, max: f64, lag: Option<i64>) -> OpTick {
        let mut err = BTreeMap::new();
        if n > 0 {
            err.insert("HTTP_5xx".to_string(), 1);
        }
        OpTick { id: id.into(), n, err, dropped: 1, p50, p90: p50, p95: p50, p99: p50, max, bytes_in: 10, bytes_out: 20, lag }
    }

    fn tick(t: u64, n: u64, p50: f64, max: f64) -> Tick {
        Tick {
            t,
            ops: vec![op("x", n, p50, max, Some(5))],
            scenarios: vec![ScenarioTick { id: "s".into(), n, err: BTreeMap::new(), dropped: 0, p50, p95: p50, p99: p50, max }],
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn merge_ticks_sums_counts_maxes_max_and_weights_percentiles() {
        let m = merge_ticks(&[tick(3, 10, 100.0, 300.0), tick(3, 30, 200.0, 250.0)]);
        assert_eq!(m.t, 3);
        let x = &m.ops[0];
        assert_eq!((x.n, x.dropped, x.bytes_in, x.bytes_out, x.max), (40, 2, 20, 40, 300.0));
        assert_eq!(x.err["HTTP_5xx"], 2);
        assert!((x.p50 - 175.0).abs() < 1e-9, "взвешено по n: (10·100 + 30·200)/40");
        assert_eq!(x.lag, Some(10));
        assert_eq!((m.scenarios[0].n, m.scenarios[0].max), (40, 300.0));
        let zero = merge_ticks(&[tick(1, 0, 0.0, 0.0), tick(1, 0, 0.0, 7.0)]);
        assert_eq!((zero.ops[0].n, zero.ops[0].p50, zero.ops[0].max), (0, 0.0, 7.0));
        assert_eq!(merge_ticks(&[]).ops.len(), 0);
    }

    #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
    async fn merger_closes_a_second_when_all_live_agents_reported_or_after_hold() {
        let now = tokio::time::Instant::now;
        let mut m = TickMerger::new(["a".to_string(), "b".to_string()], Duration::from_secs(2));
        assert!(m.push("a", tick(0, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now()).is_empty());
        let closed = m.push("b", tick(0, 2, 1.0, 1.0), now());
        assert_eq!(closed.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!((closed[0].t, closed[0].ops[0].n), (0, 3));
        assert!(m.push("a", tick(1, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now()).is_empty());
        tokio::time::advance(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
        assert!(m.expire(now()).is_empty());
        tokio::time::advance(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
        let closed = m.expire(now());
        assert_eq!((closed.len(), closed[0].t, closed[0].ops[0].n), (1, 1, 1));
        assert!(m.push("a", tick(2, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now()).is_empty());
        let closed = m.push("b", tick(3, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now());
        assert!(closed.is_empty(), "секунда 3 ждёт a");
        let closed = m.push("a", tick(3, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now());
        assert_eq!(closed.iter().map(|t| t.t).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![2, 3], "ранняя секунда закрывается первой");
        assert!(m.push("a", tick(4, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now()).is_empty());
        let closed = m.drop_agent("b");
        assert_eq!((closed.len(), closed[0].t), (1, 4), "после потери b тик a закрывает секунду");
        let closed = m.push("a", tick(5, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now());
        assert_eq!(closed.len(), 1);
        m.push("a", tick(6, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now());
        m.drop_agent("a");
        assert!(m.flush().is_empty(), "drop последнего агента закрыл всё");
        let mut lonely = TickMerger::new(["z".to_string()], Duration::from_secs(2));
        lonely.push("z", tick(9, 1, 1.0, 1.0), now());
        assert_eq!(lonely.flush().len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn accumulator_fills_counters_into_totals() {
        let mut acc = Accumulator::default();
        acc.add(&tick(0, 10, 1.0, 1.0));
        acc.add(&tick(1, 30, 1.0, 1.0));
        let mut totals = crate::metrics::Totals { ops: BTreeMap::new(), scenarios: BTreeMap::new(), seconds: 0 };
        acc.fill_counters(&mut totals);
        let x = &totals.ops["x"];
        assert_eq!((x.n, x.dropped, x.bytes_in, x.bytes_out, x.per_second_max, x.err["HTTP_5xx"]), (40, 2, 20, 40, 30, 2));
        assert_eq!((totals.scenarios["s"].n, totals.seconds), (40, 2));
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Сведение тиков разных агентов в общий посекундный ряд (спека §4.5 п. 5).

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::time::Duration;

use tokio::time::Instant;

use crate::agent_api::{OpTick, ScenarioTick, Tick};
use crate::metrics::{OpTotals, ScTotals, Totals};

fn sum_err(into: &mut BTreeMap<String, u64>, from: &BTreeMap<String, u64>) {
    for (code, n) in from {
        *into.entry(code.clone()).or_insert(0) += n;
    }
}

/// Взвешенное по `n` среднее перцентиля; при нулевом `n` — максимум значений.
fn weighted(parts: &[(u64, f64)]) -> f64 {
    let n: u64 = parts.iter().map(|(n, _)| *n).sum();
    if n == 0 {
        parts.iter().map(|(_, v)| *v).fold(0.0, f64::max)
    } else {
        parts.iter().map(|(k, v)| v * *k as f64).sum::<f64>() / n as f64
    }
}

/// Тик одной секунды из тиков разных агентов: `n`, `err`, `dropped`, байты и `lag` — суммы, `max` —
/// максимум, `p50…p99` — приближение, взвешенное по `n` (гистограмм в тиках нет; точные перцентили —
/// в `summary.yaml` из `hist.bin`). Порядок операций и сценариев — по `id`.
pub fn merge_ticks(parts: &[Tick]) -> Tick {
    let t = parts.first().map(|p| p.t).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut ops: BTreeMap<&str, Vec<&OpTick>> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut scenarios: BTreeMap<&str, Vec<&ScenarioTick>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for p in parts {
        for o in &p.ops {
            ops.entry(&o.id).or_default().push(o);
        }
        for s in &p.scenarios {
            scenarios.entry(&s.id).or_default().push(s);
        }
    }
    let ops = ops
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(id, v)| {
            let mut err = BTreeMap::new();
            v.iter().for_each(|o| sum_err(&mut err, &o.err));
            let w = |f: fn(&OpTick) -> f64| weighted(&v.iter().map(|o| (o.n, f(o))).collect::<Vec<_>>());
            OpTick {
                id: id.to_string(),
                n: v.iter().map(|o| o.n).sum(),
                err,
                dropped: v.iter().map(|o| o.dropped).sum(),
                p50: w(|o| o.p50),
                p90: w(|o| o.p90),
                p95: w(|o| o.p95),
                p99: w(|o| o.p99),
                max: v.iter().map(|o| o.max).fold(0.0, f64::max),
                bytes_in: v.iter().map(|o| o.bytes_in).sum(),
                bytes_out: v.iter().map(|o| o.bytes_out).sum(),
                lag: v.iter().filter_map(|o| o.lag).reduce(|a, b| a + b),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    let scenarios = scenarios
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(id, v)| {
            let mut err = BTreeMap::new();
            v.iter().for_each(|s| sum_err(&mut err, &s.err));
            let w = |f: fn(&ScenarioTick) -> f64| weighted(&v.iter().map(|s| (s.n, f(s))).collect::<Vec<_>>());
            ScenarioTick {
                id: id.to_string(),
                n: v.iter().map(|s| s.n).sum(),
                err,
                dropped: v.iter().map(|s| s.dropped).sum(),
                p50: w(|s| s.p50),
                p95: w(|s| s.p95),
                p99: w(|s| s.p99),
                max: v.iter().map(|s| s.max).fold(0.0, f64::max),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    Tick { t, ops, scenarios }
}

struct Pending {
    parts: BTreeMap<String, Tick>,
    first_seen: Instant,
}

/// Буфер секунд: секунда закрывается, когда получены тики всех живых агентов или прошло `hold`
/// с первого тика; закрытие секунды закрывает и все более ранние. Закрытые тики отдаются по порядку `t`.
pub struct TickMerger {
    live: BTreeSet<String>,
    pending: BTreeMap<u64, Pending>,
    hold: Duration,
}

impl TickMerger {
    pub fn new(agents: impl IntoIterator<Item = String>, hold: Duration) -> Self {
        Self { live: agents.into_iter().collect(), pending: BTreeMap::new(), hold }
    }

    /// Закрывает все секунды до `upto` включительно.
    fn close_upto(&mut self, upto: u64) -> Vec<Tick> {
        let keys: Vec<u64> = self.pending.range(..=upto).map(|(t, _)| *t).collect();
        keys.into_iter()
            .filter_map(|t| self.pending.remove(&t))
            .map(|p| merge_ticks(&p.parts.into_values().collect::<Vec<_>>()))
            .collect()
    }

    /// Секунды, у которых есть тики всех живых агентов, — от младшей.
    fn complete_upto(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.pending.iter().rev().find(|(_, p)| self.live.iter().all(|a| p.parts.contains_key(a))).map(|(t, _)| *t)
    }

    /// Тик агента; возвращает закрытые секунды.
    pub fn push(&mut self, agent: &str, tick: Tick, now: Instant) -> Vec<Tick> {
        if !self.live.contains(agent) {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let t = tick.t;
        self.pending.entry(t).or_insert_with(|| Pending { parts: BTreeMap::new(), first_seen: now }).parts.insert(agent.to_string(), tick);
        match self.complete_upto() {
            Some(upto) => self.close_upto(upto),
            None => Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Закрывает секунды, которые ждут дольше `hold`.
    pub fn expire(&mut self, now: Instant) -> Vec<Tick> {
        let upto = self
            .pending
            .iter()
            .rev()
            .find(|(_, p)| now.duration_since(p.first_seen) >= self.hold)
            .map(|(t, _)| *t);
        match upto {
            Some(upto) => self.close_upto(upto),
            None => Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Агент потерян или завершился: его тики больше не ждут; секунды, ставшие полными, закрываются.
    pub fn drop_agent(&mut self, agent: &str) -> Vec<Tick> {
        self.live.remove(agent);
        if self.live.is_empty() {
            return self.flush();
        }
        match self.complete_upto() {
            Some(upto) => self.close_upto(upto),
            None => Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Закрывает всё, что осталось.
    pub fn flush(&mut self) -> Vec<Tick> {
        self.close_upto(u64::MAX)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
struct OpCounters {
    n: u64,
    err: BTreeMap<String, u64>,
    dropped: u64,
    bytes_in: u64,
    bytes_out: u64,
    per_second_max: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
struct ScCounters {
    n: u64,
    err: BTreeMap<String, u64>,
    dropped: u64,
}

/// Сумма сведённых тиков за прогон: счётчики итога, которых нет в `hist.bin`.
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct Accumulator {
    ops: BTreeMap<String, OpCounters>,
    scenarios: BTreeMap<String, ScCounters>,
    seconds: u64,
}

impl Accumulator {
    pub fn add(&mut self, tick: &Tick) {
        self.seconds = self.seconds.max(tick.t + 1);
        for o in &tick.ops {
            let c = self.ops.entry(o.id.clone()).or_default();
            c.n += o.n;
            sum_err(&mut c.err, &o.err);
            c.dropped += o.dropped;
            c.bytes_in += o.bytes_in;
            c.bytes_out += o.bytes_out;
            c.per_second_max = c.per_second_max.max(o.n);
        }
        for s in &tick.scenarios {
            let c = self.scenarios.entry(s.id.clone()).or_default();
            c.n += s.n;
            sum_err(&mut c.err, &s.err);
            c.dropped += s.dropped;
        }
    }

    /// Переносит счётчики в `totals`; операции и сценарии без гистограммы получают пустую.
    pub fn fill_counters(&self, totals: &mut Totals) {
        totals.seconds = totals.seconds.max(self.seconds);
        for (id, c) in &self.ops {
            let e = totals.ops.entry(id.clone()).or_default();
            e.n = c.n;
            e.err = c.err.clone();
            e.dropped = c.dropped;
            e.bytes_in = c.bytes_in;
            e.bytes_out = c.bytes_out;
            e.per_second_max = c.per_second_max;
        }
        for (id, c) in &self.scenarios {
            let e = totals.scenarios.entry(id.clone()).or_default();
            e.n = c.n;
            e.err = c.err.clone();
            e.dropped = c.dropped;
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 11b: `HttpAgent` — связь с агентом по HTTP и SSE

Решение: сравнение `major.minor` версий делает `HttpAgent::info` (у него есть `controller_version`) функцией `agent_link::same_minor` Task 8, возвращая `LinkError` с кодом `AGENT_VERSION` и `names = [версия агента, версия контроллера]`; `LocalAgent` сравнивает версию контроллера сам в `start`. Код статуса без разборчивого тела `ApiError` маппится по номеру: `409 → AGENT_BUSY`, `412 → SECRET_MISSING`, `422 → SUITE_INVALID`, `426 → AGENT_VERSION`, `401 → UNAUTHORIZED`, остальное — `AGENT_UNREACHABLE`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/glafira-load-engine/src/agent_link.rs` (добавить `HttpAgent`)
- Test: `crates/glafira-load-engine/tests/http_agent.rs` (axum-заглушка агента)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `agent_link::{AgentLink, LinkError, same_minor}` (Task 8; `LinkError` — `Clone`), `agent_api::{AgentInfo, ApiError, Event, RunRequest}` (`AgentInfo`, `ApiError` — `Clone + Serialize + Deserialize`), `glafira_load_model::suite::Arrival`.
- Produces: `agent_link::HttpAgent::new(id, url, token, controller_version)`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Падающий тест `tests/http_agent.rs`**

```rust
//! `HttpAgent` против axum-заглушки агента: коды ошибок, multipart, SSE с `Last-Event-ID`.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

use axum::body::Body;
use axum::extract::{Multipart, Path, State};
use axum::http::{HeaderMap, StatusCode};
use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Json, Response};
use axum::routing::{get, post};
use axum::Router;
use futures::StreamExt;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentInfo, ApiError, EnvAddresses, Event, Mode, RunRequest};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::{AgentLink, HttpAgent, same_minor};
use glafira_load_model::suite::Arrival;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Stub {
    info_status: StatusCode,
    start_status: StatusCode,
    busy: Option<String>,
    version: String,
    seen_parts: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Vec<(String, usize)>>>,
    last_event_id: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Option<String>>>,
    stops: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}

fn authorized(h: &HeaderMap) -> bool {
    h.get("authorization").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()) == Some("Bearer t0k")
}

async fn info(State(s): State<Stub>, h: HeaderMap) -> Response {
    if !authorized(&h) {
        return StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED.into_response();
    }
    if s.info_status != StatusCode::OK {
        return s.info_status.into_response();
    }
    Json(AgentInfo { version: s.version.clone(), os: "linux".into(), arch: "x86_64".into(), cpus: 4, busy: s.busy.clone() }).into_response()
}

async fn start(State(s): State<Stub>, h: HeaderMap, mut mp: Multipart) -> Response {
    if !authorized(&h) {
        return StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED.into_response();
    }
    while let Ok(Some(field)) = mp.next_field().await {
        let name = field.name().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
        let bytes = field.bytes().await.unwrap();
        s.seen_parts.lock().unwrap().push((name, bytes.len()));
    }
    match s.start_status.as_u16() {
        202 => (StatusCode::ACCEPTED, Json(serde_json::json!({ "run_id": "r1" }))).into_response(),
        412 => (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, Json(ApiError { code: "SECRET_MISSING".into(), message: "missing secrets".into(), names: vec!["API_TOKEN".into()], agent: None, controller: None })).into_response(),
        426 => (StatusCode::UPGRADE_REQUIRED, Json(ApiError { code: "AGENT_VERSION".into(), message: "version mismatch".into(), names: vec![], agent: Some("0.9.0".into()), controller: Some("0.2.0".into()) })).into_response(),
        409 => (StatusCode::CONFLICT, Body::from("not json")).into_response(),
        code => StatusCode::from_u16(code).unwrap().into_response(),
    }
}

async fn events(State(s): State<Stub>, h: HeaderMap, Path(_id): Path<String>) -> Response {
    if !authorized(&h) {
        return StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED.into_response();
    }
    let last = h.get("last-event-id").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).map(str::to_string);
    *s.last_event_id.lock().unwrap() = last.clone();
    let from: u64 = last.and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).map(|v: u64| v + 1).unwrap_or(1);
    let mut body = String::new();
    for id in from..=3 {
        let data = if id == 3 { "{\"type\":\"gap\"}".to_string() } else { format!("{{\"type\":\"phase\",\"t\":{id},\"index\":0,\"pct\":50.0}}") };
        body += &format!("id: {id}\nevent: x\ndata: {data}\n\n");
    }
    Response::builder().header("content-type", "text/event-stream").body(Body::from(body)).unwrap()
}

async fn stop(State(s): State<Stub>, h: HeaderMap) -> StatusCode {
    if !authorized(&h) {
        return StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED;
    }
    s.stops.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
    StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
}

async fn files(h: HeaderMap) -> Response {
    if !authorized(&h) {
        return StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED.into_response();
    }
    Body::from(vec![1u8, 2, 3]).into_response()
}

async fn serve(stub: Stub) -> String {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/v1/info", get(info))
        .route("/v1/runs", post(start))
        .route("/v1/runs/{id}/events", get(events))
        .route("/v1/runs/{id}/stop", post(stop))
        .route("/v1/runs/{id}/files", get(files))
        .with_state(stub);
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap() });
    format!("http://{addr}")
}

fn stub() -> Stub {
    Stub {
        info_status: StatusCode::OK,
        start_status: StatusCode::ACCEPTED,
        busy: None,
        version: "0.2.0".into(),
        seen_parts: Default::default(),
        last_event_id: Default::default(),
        stops: Default::default(),
    }
}

fn request() -> RunRequest {
    RunRequest {
        run_id: "r1".into(),
        agent_id: "a".into(),
        suite_name: "orders".into(),
        controller_version: "0.2.0".into(),
        suite_format: 1,
        env: EnvAddresses { http: Some("http://x".into()), kafka: None, schema_registry: None },
        secrets: vec![],
        targets: BTreeMap::new(),
        timeline: vec![],
        total_minutes: 0.0,
        max_in_flight: 10,
        arrival: Arrival::Poisson,
        mode: Mode::Run,
        kafka: BTreeMap::new(),
        response_schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
        avro_schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn version_compare_uses_major_minor() {
    assert!(same_minor("0.2.0", "0.2.7"));
    assert!(!same_minor("0.3.0", "0.2.7"));
    assert!(!same_minor("1.2.0", "0.2.0"));
    assert!(!same_minor("junk", "0.2.0"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn info_maps_network_auth_busy_and_version() {
    let url = serve(stub()).await;
    let a = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.9");
    let info = a.info().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!((info.version.as_str(), info.cpus, info.busy), ("0.2.0", 4, None));

    let bad = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "wrong", "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(bad.info().await.unwrap_err().code, "UNAUTHORIZED");

    let down = HttpAgent::new("a", "http://127.0.0.1:1", "t0k", "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(down.info().await.unwrap_err().code, "AGENT_UNREACHABLE");

    let old = serve(Stub { version: "0.1.0".into(), ..stub() }).await;
    let e = HttpAgent::new("a", &old, "t0k", "0.2.0").info().await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!((e.code.as_str(), e.names.as_slice()), ("AGENT_VERSION", &["0.1.0".to_string(), "0.2.0".to_string()][..]));

    let busy = serve(Stub { busy: Some("r9".into()), ..stub() }).await;
    assert_eq!(HttpAgent::new("a", &busy, "t0k", "0.2.0").info().await.unwrap().busy.as_deref(), Some("r9"));

    let broken = serve(Stub { info_status: StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, ..stub() }).await;
    assert_eq!(HttpAgent::new("a", &broken, "t0k", "0.2.0").info().await.unwrap_err().code, "AGENT_UNREACHABLE");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn start_sends_multipart_and_maps_statuses() {
    let s = stub();
    let url = serve(s.clone()).await;
    let a = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.0");
    let mut data = BTreeMap::new();
    data.insert("users".to_string(), b"id\n1\n".to_vec());
    a.start(&request(), "format: 1\n", &data).await.unwrap();
    let parts = s.seen_parts.lock().unwrap().clone();
    let names: Vec<&str> = parts.iter().map(|(n, _)| n.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(names, vec!["run.json", "suite.yaml", "data/users"]);
    assert_eq!(parts[2].1, 5);

    let url = serve(Stub { start_status: StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, ..stub() }).await;
    let e = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.0").start(&request(), "", &BTreeMap::new()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!((e.code.as_str(), e.names.as_slice()), ("SECRET_MISSING", &["API_TOKEN".to_string()][..]));

    let url = serve(Stub { start_status: StatusCode::UPGRADE_REQUIRED, ..stub() }).await;
    let e = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.0").start(&request(), "", &BTreeMap::new()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!((e.code.as_str(), e.names.as_slice()), ("AGENT_VERSION", &["0.9.0".to_string(), "0.2.0".to_string()][..]));

    let url = serve(Stub { start_status: StatusCode::CONFLICT, ..stub() }).await;
    let e = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.0").start(&request(), "", &BTreeMap::new()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(e.code, "AGENT_BUSY", "409 без JSON-тела маппится по статусу");

    let url = serve(Stub { start_status: StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, ..stub() }).await;
    let e = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.0").start(&request(), "", &BTreeMap::new()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(e.code, "SUITE_INVALID");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn events_parse_ids_and_resume_with_last_event_id_then_stop_and_files() {
    let s = stub();
    let url = serve(s.clone()).await;
    let a = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "t0k", "0.2.0");
    let got: Vec<(u64, Event)> = a.events("r1", None).await.unwrap().collect().await;
    assert_eq!(got.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(got[0].0, 1);
    assert!(matches!(&got[0].1, Event::Phase(p) if p.t == 1));
    assert!(matches!(got[2].1, Event::Gap));
    assert_eq!(*s.last_event_id.lock().unwrap(), None);

    let got: Vec<(u64, Event)> = a.events("r1", Some(2)).await.unwrap().collect().await;
    assert_eq!(got.iter().map(|(id, _)| *id).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![3]);
    assert_eq!(s.last_event_id.lock().unwrap().as_deref(), Some("2"));

    a.stop("r1").await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(s.stops.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
    assert_eq!(a.files("r1").await.unwrap(), vec![1, 2, 3]);
    assert_eq!(a.id(), "a");

    let bad = HttpAgent::new("a", &url, "nope", "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(bad.events("r1", None).await.unwrap_err().code, "UNAUTHORIZED");
    assert_eq!(bad.files("r1").await.unwrap_err().code, "UNAUTHORIZED");
}
```

Добавь в конец `crates/glafira-load-engine/src/agent_link.rs` перед `#[cfg(test)]` (импорты — в шапку файла, если их там нет: `std::collections::BTreeMap`, `std::time::Duration`, `async_trait::async_trait`, `eventsource_stream::Eventsource`, `futures::stream::{BoxStream, StreamExt}`, `reqwest::multipart::{Form, Part}`, `crate::agent_api::{AgentInfo, ApiError, Event, RunRequest}`; `same_minor` уже есть в этом файле с Task 8):

```rust
/// Агент за HTTP-протоколом §4.3: `reqwest` с `rustls`, bearer-токен, SSE через `eventsource-stream`.
pub struct HttpAgent {
    id: String,
    base: String,
    token: String,
    controller_version: String,
    client: reqwest::Client,
}

const INFO_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
const START_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
const FILES_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(600);

impl HttpAgent {
    pub fn new(id: &str, url: &str, token: &str, controller_version: &str) -> Self {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .connect_timeout(INFO_TIMEOUT)
            .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
            .build()
            .expect("reqwest client with rustls builds");
        Self {
            id: id.into(),
            base: url.trim_end_matches('/').into(),
            token: token.into(),
            controller_version: controller_version.into(),
            client,
        }
    }

    fn url(&self, path: &str) -> String {
        format!("{}/v1{path}", self.base)
    }

    fn auth(&self, rb: reqwest::RequestBuilder) -> reqwest::RequestBuilder {
        rb.bearer_auth(&self.token)
    }

    fn unreachable(&self, e: impl std::fmt::Display) -> LinkError {
        LinkError { code: "AGENT_UNREACHABLE".into(), message: format!("agent {} at {}: {e}", self.id, self.base), names: vec![] }
    }

    /// Ошибка по ответу агента: `401` → `UNAUTHORIZED`, иначе код из тела `ApiError`, иначе по статусу.
    async fn api_error(&self, resp: reqwest::Response) -> LinkError {
        let status = resp.status().as_u16();
        if status == 401 {
            return LinkError { code: "UNAUTHORIZED".into(), message: format!("agent {} rejected the token", self.id), names: vec![] };
        }
        let by_status = match status {
            409 => "AGENT_BUSY",
            412 => "SECRET_MISSING",
            422 => "SUITE_INVALID",
            426 => "AGENT_VERSION",
            _ => "AGENT_UNREACHABLE",
        };
        match resp.json::<ApiError>().await {
            Ok(e) => {
                let names = if e.code == "AGENT_VERSION" {
                    vec![e.agent.unwrap_or_default(), e.controller.unwrap_or_default()]
                } else {
                    e.names
                };
                let code = if e.code.is_empty() { by_status.to_string() } else { e.code };
                LinkError { code, message: e.message, names }
            }
            Err(_) => LinkError { code: by_status.into(), message: format!("agent {} answered {status}", self.id), names: vec![] },
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl AgentLink for HttpAgent {
    fn id(&self) -> &str {
        &self.id
    }

    async fn info(&self) -> Result<AgentInfo, LinkError> {
        let resp = self
            .auth(self.client.get(self.url("/info")))
            .timeout(INFO_TIMEOUT)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(self.api_error(resp).await);
        }
        let info: AgentInfo = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        if !same_minor(&info.version, &self.controller_version) {
            return Err(LinkError {
                code: "AGENT_VERSION".into(),
                message: format!("agent {} runs version {}, controller is {}", self.id, info.version, self.controller_version),
                names: vec![info.version.clone(), self.controller_version.clone()],
            });
        }
        Ok(info)
    }

    async fn start(&self, req: &RunRequest, suite_text: &str, data: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        let run_json = serde_json::to_vec(req).map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        let mut form = Form::new()
            .part("run.json", Part::bytes(run_json).file_name("run.json").mime_str("application/json").map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?)
            .part("suite.yaml", Part::bytes(suite_text.as_bytes().to_vec()).file_name("suite.yaml").mime_str("application/yaml").map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?);
        for (name, bytes) in data {
            form = form.part(format!("data/{name}"), Part::bytes(bytes.clone()).file_name(name.clone()).mime_str("application/octet-stream").map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?);
        }
        let resp = self
            .auth(self.client.post(self.url("/runs")))
            .multipart(form)
            .timeout(START_TIMEOUT)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        if resp.status().is_success() { Ok(()) } else { Err(self.api_error(resp).await) }
    }

    async fn events(&self, run_id: &str, last_id: Option<u64>) -> Result<BoxStream<'static, (u64, Event)>, LinkError> {
        let mut rb = self
            .auth(self.client.get(self.url(&format!("/runs/{run_id}/events"))))
            .header(reqwest::header::ACCEPT, "text/event-stream");
        if let Some(id) = last_id {
            rb = rb.header("Last-Event-ID", id.to_string());
        }
        let resp = rb.send().await.map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(self.api_error(resp).await);
        }
        let agent = self.id.clone();
        let stream = resp
            .bytes_stream()
            .eventsource()
            .take_while(move |r| {
                if let Err(e) = r {
                    tracing::warn!(agent = %agent, "event stream broke: {e}");
                }
                futures::future::ready(r.is_ok())
            })
            .filter_map(|r| async move {
                let ev = r.ok()?;
                let id = ev.id.parse::<u64>().ok()?;
                let parsed: Event = serde_json::from_str(&ev.data).ok()?;
                Some((id, parsed))
            });
        Ok(stream.boxed())
    }

    async fn stop(&self, run_id: &str) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        let resp = self
            .auth(self.client.post(self.url(&format!("/runs/{run_id}/stop"))))
            .timeout(INFO_TIMEOUT)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        // 404: прогон уже завершён и убран — остановка не нужна.
        if resp.status().is_success() || resp.status().as_u16() == 404 { Ok(()) } else { Err(self.api_error(resp).await) }
    }

    async fn files(&self, run_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LinkError> {
        let resp = self
            .auth(self.client.get(self.url(&format!("/runs/{run_id}/files"))))
            .timeout(FILES_TIMEOUT)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(self.api_error(resp).await);
        }
        Ok(resp.bytes().await.map_err(|e| self.unreachable(e))?.to_vec())
    }
}
```

Событие SSE разбирается только по `data` (JSON с тегом `type`); имя `event:` не используется — агент ставит его для читаемости.

### Task 11c: `Controller::run`, загрузка плана и тесты с `MockAgent`

Решение: типы `ControllerEvent`, `AgentState`, `RunResult`, `EngineError` определены в `agent_link.rs` (Task 8) и здесь только реэкспортируются (`pub use crate::agent_link::{AgentState, ControllerEvent, EngineError, RunResult};`), поэтому `run_local` и контроллер шлют события одного типа; `RunPlan` — здесь, со схемами `response_schemas`/`avro_schemas` для `RunRequest` агентов (их заполняет `plan::load_plan` из реестра и `.avsc` сервисов через `local::{response_schemas_of, avro_schema_texts}` Task 8). Статус итога: был `Lost`, `gap` или не удалось забрать файлы агента → `incomplete`; иначе отмена → `stopped`; иначе хоть один агент прислал `failed` → `failed`; иначе `completed`. Фазы пишутся от первого агента списка; если он потерян — от первого живого. `run.yaml`: `project_commit` — `local::project_commit` (из `.git/HEAD` проекта), `services` — `local::service_versions` по реестру `registry/operations.yaml`. Сведения о файлах данных для `check` — `context::data_info` (Task 8).

```rust
//! Контроллер с фиктивными агентами: сбор, отказы до старта, потеря агента, отмена (спека §4.5).

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque};
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use async_trait::async_trait;
use futures::stream::{self, BoxStream, StreamExt};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentInfo, ErrorSample, Event, Mode, OpTick, PhaseEvent, RunStatus, Tick};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::{AgentLink, LinkError};
use glafira_load_engine::controller::{AgentState, Controller, ControllerEvent, RunPlan};
use glafira_load_engine::metrics::{OpTotals, Totals, new_histogram, summary};
use glafira_load_engine::run_files::hist_log;
use glafira_load_model::profile::{Basis, Computed, Point, Target};
use glafira_load_model::project::{Agent, EnvKind, Environment};
use glafira_load_model::registry::OpKind;
use glafira_load_model::suite::parse;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

const OP: &str = "http:orders:GET /ping";

const SUITE: &str = "format: 1
name: orders
scenarios:
  - id: ping
    steps:
      - http: { operation: \"http:orders:GET /ping\" }
        expect: { status: 200 }
";

fn plan(root: &Path) -> RunPlan {
    RunPlan {
        root: root.to_path_buf(),
        suite_name: "orders".into(),
        suite: parse(SUITE).unwrap(),
        suite_text: SUITE.into(),
        profile: "short".into(),
        computed: Computed {
            profile: "short".into(),
            basis: Basis::Avg,
            targets: vec![Target { id: OP.into(), service: "orders".into(), kind: OpKind::Http, basis_value: 100.0, k_env: 1.0, k_growth: 1.0, target: 100.0, share: 1.0 }],
            total: 100.0,
            uncovered: vec![],
            timeline: vec![Point { minute: 0.0, pct: 0.0 }, Point { minute: 0.05, pct: 100.0 }],
            total_minutes: 0.05,
        },
        env: Environment {
            id: "test".into(),
            kind: EnvKind::Test,
            http: Some("http://127.0.0.1:1".into()),
            kafka: None,
            grpc: None,
            sql: None,
            schema_registry: None,
            agents: vec![Agent { id: "a".into(), url: "http://a".into(), weight: 1 }, Agent { id: "b".into(), url: "http://b".into(), weight: 1 }],
            extra: Default::default(),
        },
        mode: Mode::Run,
        max_in_flight: None,
        out_dir: None,
        response_schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
        avro_schemas: BTreeMap::new(),
    }
}

fn tick(t: u64, n: u64) -> Event {
    Event::Tick(Tick {
        t,
        ops: vec![OpTick { id: OP.into(), n, err: BTreeMap::new(), dropped: 0, p50: 10.0, p90: 20.0, p95: 30.0, p99: 40.0, max: 50.0, bytes_in: n, bytes_out: n, lag: None }],
        scenarios: vec![],
    })
}

/// Итог агента на `n` замеров по 10 мс за 2 секунды.
fn totals(n: u64) -> Totals {
    let mut totals = Totals { ops: BTreeMap::new(), scenarios: BTreeMap::new(), seconds: 2 };
    let mut hist = new_histogram();
    for _ in 0..n {
        hist.record(10_000).unwrap();
    }
    totals.ops.insert(OP.into(), OpTotals { hist, n, err: BTreeMap::new(), dropped: 0, bytes_in: n, bytes_out: n, per_second_max: n });
    totals
}

fn done(n: u64) -> Event {
    let mut targets = BTreeMap::new();
    targets.insert(OP.to_string(), 50.0);
    Event::Done(summary(&totals(n), &targets, RunStatus::Completed))
}

/// tar с `summary.yaml` и `hist.bin` (писатель Task 8) на `n` замеров по 10 мс.
fn files_tar(n: u64) -> Vec<u8> {
    let hist = hist_log(&totals(n)).unwrap();
    let summary = match done(n) {
        Event::Done(s) => glafira_load_model::to_yaml(&s),
        _ => unreachable!(),
    };
    let mut tar = tar::Builder::new(Vec::new());
    for (name, body) in [("summary.yaml", summary.into_bytes()), ("hist.bin", hist)] {
        let mut h = tar::Header::new_gnu();
        h.set_size(body.len() as u64);
        h.set_mode(0o644);
        h.set_cksum();
        tar.append_data(&mut h, name, &body[..]).unwrap();
    }
    tar.into_inner().unwrap()
}

/// Фиктивный агент: настраиваемые ответы, потоки событий из векторов по порядку вызовов `events`.
struct MockAgent {
    id: String,
    info: Result<AgentInfo, LinkError>,
    start: Result<(), LinkError>,
    streams: Mutex<VecDeque<Result<Vec<(u64, Event)>, LinkError>>>,
    files: Vec<u8>,
    starts: AtomicUsize,
    stops: AtomicUsize,
    events_calls: Mutex<Vec<Option<u64>>>,
}

impl MockAgent {
    fn new(id: &str, events: Vec<(u64, Event)>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: id.into(),
            info: Ok(AgentInfo { version: "0.2.0".into(), os: "linux".into(), arch: "x86_64".into(), cpus: 2, busy: None }),
            start: Ok(()),
            streams: Mutex::new(VecDeque::from([Ok(events)])),
            files: files_tar(20),
            starts: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            stops: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            events_calls: Mutex::new(vec![]),
        }
    }

    fn healthy(id: &str) -> Self {
        Self::new(id, vec![(1, Event::Phase(PhaseEvent { t: 0, index: 0, pct: 0.0 })), (2, tick(0, 10)), (3, tick(1, 10)), (4, done(20))])
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl AgentLink for MockAgent {
    fn id(&self) -> &str {
        &self.id
    }
    async fn info(&self) -> Result<AgentInfo, LinkError> {
        self.info.clone()
    }
    async fn start(&self, _req: &glafira_load_engine::agent_api::RunRequest, _suite: &str, _data: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        self.starts.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        self.start.clone()
    }
    async fn events(&self, _run_id: &str, last_id: Option<u64>) -> Result<BoxStream<'static, (u64, Event)>, LinkError> {
        self.events_calls.lock().unwrap().push(last_id);
        let next = self.streams.lock().unwrap().pop_front();
        match next {
            Some(Ok(items)) => Ok(stream::iter(items).boxed()),
            Some(Err(e)) => Err(e),
            None => Err(LinkError { code: "AGENT_UNREACHABLE".into(), message: "no more streams".into(), names: vec![] }),
        }
    }
    async fn stop(&self, _run_id: &str) -> Result<(), LinkError> {
        self.stops.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn files(&self, _run_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, LinkError> {
        Ok(self.files.clone())
    }
}

fn link(a: MockAgent) -> (Arc<MockAgent>, Arc<dyn AgentLink>) {
    let a = Arc::new(a);
    (a.clone(), a)
}

async fn drain(mut rx: mpsc::Receiver<ControllerEvent>) -> Vec<ControllerEvent> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    while let Some(e) = rx.recv().await {
        out.push(e);
    }
    out
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn two_agents_complete_and_summary_sums_n() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (a, la) = link(MockAgent::healthy("a"));
    let (b, lb) = link(MockAgent::healthy("b"));
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
    let events = tokio::spawn(drain(rx));
    let result = Controller::run(plan(tmp.path()), vec![la, lb], tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap();
    let events = events.await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.status, RunStatus::Completed);
    let op = result.summary.ops.iter().find(|o| o.id == OP).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(op.n, 40, "сумма n тиков обоих агентов");
    assert_eq!(op.target, Some(100.0));
    assert!((op.p50 - 10.0).abs() < 1.0, "перцентиль из слитых hist.bin: {}", op.p50);
    assert_eq!((a.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst), b.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)), (1, 1));
    let dir = Path::new(&result.dir);
    assert!(dir.starts_with(tmp.path().join("runs")));
    for id in ["a", "b"] {
        assert!(dir.join("agents").join(id).join("summary.yaml").is_file());
        assert!(dir.join("agents").join(id).join("hist.bin").is_file());
    }
    assert!(dir.join("summary.yaml").is_file() && dir.join("run.yaml").is_file());
    assert!(matches!(events.first(), Some(ControllerEvent::Agent { state: AgentState::Ready, .. })));
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, ControllerEvent::Started { .. })));
    let ticks: Vec<u64> = events.iter().filter_map(|e| match e { ControllerEvent::Tick(t) => Some(t.t), _ => None }).collect();
    assert_eq!(ticks, vec![0, 1], "одна сводная секунда на t");
    let merged_n: u64 = events.iter().filter_map(|e| match e { ControllerEvent::Tick(t) => Some(t.ops[0].n), _ => None }).sum();
    assert_eq!(merged_n, 40);
    assert_eq!(events.iter().filter(|e| matches!(e, ControllerEvent::Phase(_))).count(), 1, "фаза только от первого агента");
    assert!(matches!(events.last(), Some(ControllerEvent::Done(r)) if r.run_id == result.run_id));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn busy_agent_prevents_any_start() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut busy = MockAgent::healthy("b");
    busy.info = Ok(AgentInfo { version: "0.2.0".into(), os: "linux".into(), arch: "x86_64".into(), cpus: 2, busy: Some("other-run".into()) });
    let (a, la) = link(MockAgent::healthy("a"));
    let (b, lb) = link(busy);
    let (tx, _rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
    let e = Controller::run(plan(tmp.path()), vec![la, lb], tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!((e.code.as_str(), e.agent.as_deref(), e.names.as_slice()), ("AGENT_BUSY", Some("b"), &["other-run".to_string()][..]));
    assert_eq!((a.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst), b.starts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)), (0, 0));
    assert!(!tmp.path().join("runs").exists(), "папка прогона не создана");

    let mut down = MockAgent::healthy("c");
    down.info = Err(LinkError { code: "AGENT_UNREACHABLE".into(), message: "connection refused".into(), names: vec![] });
    let (_, lc) = link(down);
    let (_, la2) = link(MockAgent::healthy("a"));
    let (tx, _rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
    let e = Controller::run(plan(tmp.path()), vec![la2, lc], tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!((e.code.as_str(), e.agent.as_deref()), ("AGENT_UNREACHABLE", Some("c")));
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn lost_agent_makes_the_run_incomplete_and_keeps_other_files() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut flaky = MockAgent::new("a", vec![(1, tick(0, 10))]);
    flaky.streams.lock().unwrap().push_back(Err(LinkError { code: "AGENT_UNREACHABLE".into(), message: "down".into(), names: vec![] }));
    let (a, la) = link(flaky);
    let (b, lb) = link(MockAgent::healthy("b"));
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
    let events = tokio::spawn(drain(rx));
    let result = Controller::run(plan(tmp.path()), vec![la, lb], tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap();
    let events = events.await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.status, RunStatus::Incomplete);
    let calls = a.events_calls.lock().unwrap().clone();
    assert_eq!(calls[0], None);
    assert!(calls.len() >= 2 && calls[1..].iter().all(|c| *c == Some(1)), "повторы с Last-Event-ID: {calls:?}");
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, ControllerEvent::Agent { id, state: AgentState::Lost } if id == "a")));
    assert!(a.stops.load(Ordering::SeqCst) >= 1, "потерянному агенту повторён stop при сборе файлов");
    let dir = Path::new(&result.dir);
    assert!(dir.join("agents/b/summary.yaml").is_file());
    assert_eq!(result.summary.ops[0].n, 30, "тики: 10 от a + 20 от b");
}

async fn cancel_stops_both_agents_and_reports_stopped() {

#[tokio::test]
async fn gap_and_errors_are_recorded() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let err = ErrorSample { t: 0, code: "HTTP_5xx".into(), operation: OP.into(), scenario: "ping".into(), step: "step1".into(), agent: "a".into(), message: "boom".into(), request: None, response: None };
    let (_, la) = link(MockAgent::new("a", vec![(1, tick(0, 5)), (2, Event::Error(err)), (3, Event::Gap), (4, done(5))]));
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
    let events = tokio::spawn(drain(rx));
    let result = Controller::run(plan(tmp.path()), vec![la], tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap();
    let events = events.await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.status, RunStatus::Incomplete, "gap → incomplete");
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, ControllerEvent::Error(e) if e.code == "HTTP_5xx")));
    let errors = std::fs::read_to_string(Path::new(&result.dir).join("errors.jsonl")).unwrap();
    assert!(errors.contains("HTTP_5xx"), "{errors}");
    let out = tmp.path().join("custom-out");
    let mut p = plan(tmp.path());
    p.out_dir = Some(out.clone());
    let (_, la) = link(MockAgent::healthy("a"));
    let (tx, _rx) = mpsc::channel(256);
    let r = Controller::run(p, vec![la], tx, CancellationToken::new()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(Path::new(&r.dir), out.as_path());
}
```

В `[dev-dependencies]` движка должны быть `tar = "0.4"`, `tempfile = "3"`, `async-trait = "0.1"`, `tokio-util = "0.7"`.

```rust
//! Контроллер прогона: опрашивает агентов, раздаёт бандлы, сводит события и собирает `runs/<дата>/`
//! (спека §4.5, §6). Один код для приложения и `glafira-load run --agents` (отступление плана 8).

pub mod bundle;
pub mod merge;
pub mod plan;

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use glafira_load_model::profile::Computed;
use glafira_load_model::project::Environment;
use glafira_load_model::registry::{REGISTRY_FILE, Registry};
use glafira_load_model::schema::SchemaSummary;
use glafira_load_model::suite::Suite;
use tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender;
use tokio::time::Instant;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use crate::agent_api::{AgentSummary, Event, Mode, RunStatus};
use crate::agent_link::AgentLink;
use crate::metrics::{merge_totals, summary};
use crate::run_files::{RunAgent, RunMeta, RunWriter, run_dir_name, totals_from_hist_log};

pub use crate::agent_link::{AgentState, ControllerEvent, EngineError, RunResult};
pub use crate::local::project_commit;
pub use bundle::{slice_rows, split_targets};
use merge::{Accumulator, TickMerger};

/// Версия контроллера — версия крейта; сравнивается с версией агента по `major.minor`.
pub const CONTROLLER_VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");
/// Сколько ждать восстановления потока событий агента, прежде чем считать его потерянным.
pub const LOST_AFTER: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
/// Пауза между повторными подключениями к потоку событий.
pub const RECONNECT_PAUSE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
/// Сколько держать секунду в буфере слияния, если тик кого-то из живых агентов не пришёл.
pub const MERGE_HOLD: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);

/// Всё, что нужно для прогона: проект уже прочитан и проверен (`plan::load_plan`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RunPlan {
    pub root: PathBuf,
    pub suite_name: String,
    pub suite: Suite,
    pub suite_text: String,
    pub profile: String,
    pub computed: Computed,
    pub env: Environment,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
    pub out_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Схемы ответов операций реестра (`expect.schema: response`) — уходят агентам в `RunRequest`.
    pub response_schemas: BTreeMap<String, SchemaSummary>,
    /// Тексты `.avsc` операций `kafka_produce` с `encoding: avro` — уходят агентам в `RunRequest`.
    pub avro_schemas: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

/// Вес агента по манифесту стенда; агент вне манифеста (например, `LocalAgent`) — 1.
pub fn weight_of(env: &Environment, id: &str) -> u32 {
    env.agents.iter().find(|a| a.id == id).map(|a| a.weight.max(1)).unwrap_or(1)
}

/// Версии сервисов из `registry/operations.yaml` проекта (`local::service_versions` по прочитанному реестру);
/// нет файла или он не разбирается — пусто.
pub fn service_versions(root: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
    let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(REGISTRY_FILE)) else {
        return BTreeMap::new();
    };
    let Ok(registry) = glafira_load_model::from_yaml::<Registry>(&text) else {
        return BTreeMap::new();
    };
    crate::local::service_versions(&registry)
}

enum AgentMsg {
    Event(Event),
    Lost,
}

/// Читает поток событий агента до `done`; при обрыве — повтор с `Last-Event-ID` раз в секунду до
/// `LOST_AFTER`, затем `Lost`.
async fn agent_task(link: Arc<dyn AgentLink>, run_id: String, tx: Sender<(String, AgentMsg)>) {
    let id = link.id().to_string();
    let mut last_id: Option<u64> = None;
    let mut lost_since: Option<Instant> = None;
    loop {
        match link.events(&run_id, last_id).await {
            Ok(mut stream) => {
                while let Some((eid, ev)) = futures::StreamExt::next(&mut stream).await {
                    lost_since = None;
                    last_id = Some(eid);
                    let done = matches!(ev, Event::Done(_));
                    if tx.send((id.clone(), AgentMsg::Event(ev))).await.is_err() {
                        return;
                    }
                    if done {
                        return;
                    }
                }
                tracing::warn!(agent = %id, "event stream ended before done, reconnecting");
            }
            Err(e) => tracing::warn!(agent = %id, code = %e.code, "events failed: {}", e.message),
        }
        let since = *lost_since.get_or_insert_with(Instant::now);
        if since.elapsed() >= LOST_AFTER {
            let _ = tx.send((id, AgentMsg::Lost)).await;
            return;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(RECONNECT_PAUSE).await;
    }
}

async fn stop_all(agents: &[Arc<dyn AgentLink>], run_id: &str) {
    let results = futures::future::join_all(agents.iter().map(|a| a.stop(run_id))).await;
    for (a, r) in agents.iter().zip(results) {
        if let Err(e) = r {
            tracing::warn!(agent = a.id(), code = %e.code, "stop failed: {}", e.message);
        }
    }
}

async fn unpack_tar(bytes: Vec<u8>, dir: PathBuf) -> Result<(), EngineError> {
    let shown = dir.display().to_string();
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
        tar::Archive::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes)).unpack(&dir)
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|e| EngineError::io(e.to_string()))?
    .map_err(|e| EngineError::io(format!("cannot unpack agent files into {shown}: {e}")))
}

fn io_err(what: &str) -> impl Fn(std::io::Error) -> EngineError + '_ {
    move |e| EngineError::io(format!("{what}: {e}"))
}

pub struct Controller;

impl Controller {
    pub async fn run(
        plan: RunPlan,
        agents: Vec<Arc<dyn AgentLink>>,
        events: Sender<ControllerEvent>,
        cancel: CancellationToken,
    ) -> Result<RunResult, EngineError> {
        if agents.is_empty() {
            return Err(EngineError::new("AGENT_UNREACHABLE", "no agents to run on"));
        }
        let send = |ev: ControllerEvent| {
            let events = events.clone();
            async move {
                let _ = events.send(ev).await;
            }
        };

        // 1. info всех агентов параллельно: ошибка связи, версия или занятость — отказ до старта.
        let infos = futures::future::join_all(agents.iter().map(|a| async move { (a.id().to_string(), a.info().await) })).await;
        let mut versions = BTreeMap::new();
        for (id, r) in infos {
            let info = r.map_err(|e| EngineError::from_link(e, &id))?;
            if let Some(run) = info.busy {
                return Err(EngineError {
                    code: "AGENT_BUSY".into(),
                    message: format!("agent {id} is busy with run {run}"),
                    names: vec![run],
                    agent: Some(id),
                });
            }
            versions.insert(id, info.version);
        }
        for a in &agents {
            send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id: a.id().into(), state: AgentState::Ready }).await;
        }

        // 2. Бандлы и старт всем параллельно; любой отказ — stop уже запущенным.
        let run_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let weights: Vec<(String, u32)> = agents.iter().map(|a| (a.id().to_string(), weight_of(&plan.env, a.id()))).collect();
        let bundles = bundle::bundles(&plan, &run_id, &weights)?;
        let starts = futures::future::join_all(agents.iter().zip(&bundles).map(|(a, b)| {
            let suite_text = plan.suite_text.as_str();
            async move { (a.id().to_string(), a.start(&b.request, suite_text, &b.data).await) }
        }))
        .await;
        if let Some((failed_id, Err(e))) = starts.iter().find(|(_, r)| r.is_err()) {
            let started: Vec<Arc<dyn AgentLink>> = agents
                .iter()
                .filter(|a| starts.iter().any(|(id, r)| id == a.id() && r.is_ok()))
                .cloned()
                .collect();
            stop_all(&started, &run_id).await;
            send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id: failed_id.clone(), state: AgentState::Failed }).await;
            return Err(EngineError::from_link(e.clone(), failed_id));
        }

        // 3. Папка прогона и run.yaml.
        let started_at = time::OffsetDateTime::now_utc();
        let dir = plan
            .out_dir
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| plan.root.join("runs").join(run_dir_name(started_at, plan.mode == Mode::Smoke)));
        let meta = RunMeta {
            run_id: run_id.clone(),
            suite: plan.suite_name.clone(),
            profile: plan.profile.clone(),
            env: plan.env.id.clone(),
            mode: plan.mode,
            agents: agents
                .iter()
                .map(|a| RunAgent {
                    id: a.id().into(),
                    url: plan.env.agents.iter().find(|x| x.id == a.id()).map(|x| x.url.clone()),
                    weight: weight_of(&plan.env, a.id()),
                    version: versions.get(a.id()).cloned(),
                })
                .collect(),
            project_commit: project_commit(&plan.root),
            services: service_versions(&plan.root),
            started_at: started_at
                .format(&time::format_description::well_known::Rfc3339)
                .unwrap_or_default(),
            ended_at: None,
            status: None,
        };
        let mut writer = RunWriter::create(&dir, &meta).map_err(io_err("cannot create run directory"))?;
        send(ControllerEvent::Started { run_id: run_id.clone(), dir: dir.display().to_string() }).await;
        for a in &agents {
            send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id: a.id().into(), state: AgentState::Running }).await;
        }

        // 4. Задача на агента и сводный цикл.
        let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<(String, AgentMsg)>(4096);
        for a in &agents {
            tokio::spawn(agent_task(a.clone(), run_id.clone(), tx.clone()));
        }
        drop(tx);
        let ids: Vec<String> = agents.iter().map(|a| a.id().to_string()).collect();
        let mut merger = TickMerger::new(ids.clone(), MERGE_HOLD);
        let mut acc = Accumulator::default();
        let mut states: BTreeMap<String, AgentState> = ids.iter().map(|id| (id.clone(), AgentState::Running)).collect();
        let mut summaries: BTreeMap<String, AgentSummary> = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut incomplete = false;
        let mut stop_sent = false;
        let mut phase_source = ids[0].clone();
        let mut expire = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(500));
        let mut write_err: Option<EngineError> = None;

        macro_rules! emit_ticks {
            ($ticks:expr) => {
                for t in $ticks {
                    acc.add(&t);
                    if let Err(e) = writer.tick(&t) {
                        if write_err.is_none() {
                            write_err = Some(EngineError::io(format!("metrics.jsonl: {e}")));
                        }
                    }
                    send(ControllerEvent::Tick(t)).await;
                }
            };
        }

        loop {
            // `biased`: отмена проверяется первой, затем события агентов, затем таймер буфера.
            tokio::select! {
                biased;
                _ = cancel.cancelled(), if !stop_sent => {
                    stop_sent = true;
                    stop_all(&agents, &run_id).await;
                }
                msg = rx.recv() => {
                    let Some((id, msg)) = msg else { break };
                    match msg {
                        AgentMsg::Lost => {
                            states.insert(id.clone(), AgentState::Lost);
                            incomplete = true;
                            emit_ticks!(merger.drop_agent(&id));
                            if phase_source == id {
                                if let Some(next) = ids.iter().find(|x| states.get(*x) == Some(&AgentState::Running)) {
                                    phase_source = next.clone();
                                }
                            }
                            send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id, state: AgentState::Lost }).await;
                        }
                        AgentMsg::Event(Event::Tick(t)) => {
                            emit_ticks!(merger.push(&id, t, Instant::now()));
                        }
                        AgentMsg::Event(Event::Phase(p)) => {
                            if id == phase_source {
                                if let Err(e) = writer.phase(&p) {
                                    if write_err.is_none() {
                                        write_err = Some(EngineError::io(format!("phases.yaml: {e}")));
                                    }
                                }
                                send(ControllerEvent::Phase(p)).await;
                            }
                        }
                        AgentMsg::Event(Event::Error(e)) => {
                            if let Err(err) = writer.error(&e) {
                                if write_err.is_none() {
                                    write_err = Some(EngineError::io(format!("errors.jsonl: {err}")));
                                }
                            }
                            send(ControllerEvent::Error(e)).await;
                        }
                        AgentMsg::Event(Event::Gap) => {
                            tracing::warn!(agent = %id, "event gap: run will be incomplete");
                            incomplete = true;
                        }
                        AgentMsg::Event(Event::Done(s)) => {
                            states.insert(id.clone(), AgentState::Done);
                            summaries.insert(id.clone(), s);
                            emit_ticks!(merger.drop_agent(&id));
                            send(ControllerEvent::Agent { id, state: AgentState::Done }).await;
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ = expire.tick() => {
                    emit_ticks!(merger.expire(Instant::now()));
                }
            }
        }
        emit_ticks!(merger.flush());
        if let Some(e) = write_err {
            return Err(e);
        }

        // 6. Файлы агентов, слияние гистограмм, сводка.
        let agents_dir = dir.join("agents");
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        for a in &agents {
            if states.get(a.id()) == Some(&AgentState::Lost) {
                // Остановка потерянного агента повторяется при сборе файлов (спека §4.5).
                if let Err(e) = a.stop(&run_id).await {
                    tracing::warn!(agent = a.id(), code = %e.code, "stop retry failed: {}", e.message);
                }
            }
            let tar = match a.files(&run_id).await {
                Ok(bytes) => bytes,
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::warn!(agent = a.id(), code = %e.code, "files failed: {}", e.message);
                    incomplete = true;
                    continue;
                }
            };
            let out = agents_dir.join(a.id());
            unpack_tar(tar, out.clone()).await?;
            match std::fs::read(out.join("hist.bin")) {
                Ok(bytes) => match totals_from_hist_log(&bytes) {
                    Ok(t) => parts.push(t),
                    Err(e) => {
                        tracing::warn!(agent = a.id(), "hist.bin unreadable: {e}");
                        incomplete = true;
                    }
                },
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::warn!(agent = a.id(), "hist.bin missing: {e}");
                    incomplete = true;
                }
            }
        }
        let mut totals = merge_totals(&parts);
        acc.fill_counters(&mut totals);
        let failed = summaries.values().any(|s| s.status == RunStatus::Failed);
        let status = if incomplete {
            RunStatus::Incomplete
        } else if cancel.is_cancelled() {
            RunStatus::Stopped
        } else if failed {
            RunStatus::Failed
        } else {
            RunStatus::Completed
        };
        let summary = summary(&totals, &bundle::targets_of(&plan), status);
        writer.finish(&summary, status).map_err(io_err("cannot finish run files"))?;
        let result = RunResult { run_id, dir: dir.display().to_string(), status, summary };
        send(ControllerEvent::Done(result.clone())).await;
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

`time` нужен с feature `formatting`; `futures::StreamExt::next` вызывается полным путём, чтобы не тащить трейт в область видимости модуля. `ControllerEvent` сериализуется с тегом `type` (snake_case) и полями без переименования (`run_id`, `dir`) — так его читает фронтенд Task 14.

- [ ] **Step 4: `controller/plan.rs` — загрузка и проверка плана**

```rust
//! Чтение проекта для прогона: манифест, сьют, реестр, профиль; `check` и расчёт целей (спека §4.5 п. 1).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use glafira_load_model::from_yaml;
use glafira_load_model::prod_load::{PROD_LOAD_FILE, ProdLoad};
use glafira_load_model::profile::{PROFILE_FILE, ProfileFile, compute};
use glafira_load_model::project::{MANIFEST_FILE, Manifest};
use glafira_load_model::registry::{REGISTRY_FILE, Registry};
use glafira_load_model::suite::{self, DataInfo, Level, SUITE_FILE, SUITES_DIR};

use super::{EngineError, RunPlan};
use crate::agent_api::Mode;
use crate::context::data_info;
use crate::local::{avro_schema_texts, response_schemas_of};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PlanArgs {
    pub root: PathBuf,
    /// `None` — единственный сьют проекта.
    pub suite: Option<String>,
    pub profile: String,
    pub env: String,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
    pub out_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
}

fn read(root: &Path, rel: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, EngineError> {
    match std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(rel)) {
        Ok(t) => Ok(Some(t)),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
        Err(e) => Err(EngineError::io(format!("{rel}: {e}"))),
    }
}

fn yaml<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned + Default>(root: &Path, rel: &str) -> Result<T, EngineError> {
    match read(root, rel)? {
        None => Ok(T::default()),
        Some(text) => from_yaml(&text).map_err(|e| EngineError::new("PROJECT_INVALID", format!("{rel}: {}", e.message))),
    }
}

/// Имя сьюта: заданное (с проверкой файла) или единственное в `suites/`.
pub fn resolve_suite(root: &Path, name: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, EngineError> {
    if let Some(n) = name {
        if root.join(SUITES_DIR).join(n).join(SUITE_FILE).is_file() {
            return Ok(n.to_string());
        }
        return Err(EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("suite {n} not found in {SUITES_DIR}/")).with_names(vec![n.into()]));
    }
    let mut names: Vec<String> = match std::fs::read_dir(root.join(SUITES_DIR)) {
        Ok(rd) => rd
            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
            .filter(|e| e.path().join(SUITE_FILE).is_file())
            .map(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            .collect(),
        Err(_) => vec![],
    };
    names.sort();
    match names.len() {
        1 => Ok(names.remove(0)),
        0 => Err(EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("project has no suites in {SUITES_DIR}/"))),
        _ => Err(EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", "project has several suites, pass --suite").with_names(names)),
    }
}

/// Читает проект, выполняет `check` сьюта и считает цели профиля; схемы для агентов — из реестра и `.avsc`.
pub fn load_plan(a: PlanArgs) -> Result<RunPlan, EngineError> {
    let root = a.root.clone();
    let manifest_text = read(&root, MANIFEST_FILE)?
        .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("{} not found in {}", MANIFEST_FILE, root.display())))?;
    let manifest: Manifest =
        from_yaml(&manifest_text).map_err(|e| EngineError::new("PROJECT_INVALID", format!("{MANIFEST_FILE}: {}", e.message)))?;
    let env = manifest
        .environments
        .iter()
        .find(|e| e.id == a.env)
        .cloned()
        .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("environment {} not found", a.env)).with_names(vec![a.env.clone()]))?;
    let suite_name = resolve_suite(&root, a.suite.as_deref())?;
    let suite_file = format!("{SUITES_DIR}/{suite_name}/{SUITE_FILE}");
    let suite_text = read(&root, &suite_file)?.ok_or_else(|| EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", format!("{suite_file} not found")))?;
    let parsed = suite::parse(&suite_text).map_err(|e| {
        EngineError::new("SUITE_INVALID", format!("{suite_file}: {}", e.message))
            .with_names(vec![format!("{suite_file}:{}: {}", e.line.unwrap_or(0), e.message)])
    })?;
    let registry: Registry = yaml(&root, REGISTRY_FILE)?;
    let mut infos: BTreeMap<String, Option<DataInfo>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (name, set) in &parsed.data {
        // Путь вне проекта — `PATH_OUTSIDE_PROJECT` сообщит `check`; файл не читается.
        let info = if crate::context::is_inside_project(&set.path) { data_info(&root, &set.path) } else { None };
        infos.insert(name.clone(), info);
    }
    let (suite, findings) = suite::check(&suite_text, &suite_file, &registry, &infos, Some(&env));
    let errors: Vec<String> = findings
        .iter()
        .filter(|f| f.level == Level::Error)
        .map(|f| match f.line {
            Some(l) => format!("{}:{l}: {}", f.file, f.message),
            None => format!("{}: {}", f.file, f.message),
        })
        .collect();
    let Some(suite) = suite.filter(|_| errors.is_empty()) else {
        return Err(EngineError::new("SUITE_INVALID", format!("suite {suite_name} has {} error(s)", errors.len().max(1))).with_names(errors));
    };
    let profile_file: ProfileFile = match read(&root, PROFILE_FILE)? {
        None => ProfileFile::default(),
        Some(t) => from_yaml(&t).map_err(|e| EngineError::new("PROJECT_INVALID", format!("{PROFILE_FILE}: {}", e.message)))?,
    };
    let prod: ProdLoad = yaml(&root, PROD_LOAD_FILE)?;
    let computed = compute(&profile_file, &a.profile, &registry, &prod)
        .map_err(|e| EngineError::new("NOT_FOUND", e.to_string()).with_names(vec![a.profile.clone()]))?;
    let response_schemas = response_schemas_of(&registry);
    let avro_schemas = avro_schema_texts(&root, &manifest, &registry, &suite)?;
    Ok(RunPlan {
        root,
        suite_name,
        suite,
        suite_text,
        profile: a.profile,
        computed,
        env,
        mode: a.mode,
        max_in_flight: a.max_in_flight,
        out_dir: a.out_dir,
        response_schemas,
        avro_schemas,
    })
}
```

```rust
//! Два реальных агента + axum-заглушка стенда + `glafira-load run --agents` на временном проекте (спека §9.1).

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Child, Command, Stdio};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use axum::Router;
use axum::response::Json;
use axum::routing::any;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::AgentSummary;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::{AgentLink, HttpAgent};
use glafira_load_model::prod_load::{Figures, PROD_LOAD_FILE, ProdLoad};
use glafira_load_model::profile::{Basis, PROFILE_FILE, Phase, Profile, ProfileFile};
use glafira_load_model::project::MANIFEST_FILE;
use glafira_load_model::registry::{Address, Manual, OpKind, Operation, OperationDraft, REGISTRY_FILE, Registry, Seen, Source, Status};
use glafira_load_model::{from_yaml, to_yaml};

const BIN: &str = env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_glafira-load");
const TOKEN: &str = "test-token";

fn free_port() -> u16 {
    std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port()
}

/// Проект: стенд `test` с двумя агентами, реестр из одной операции, профиль `short` (≈3 с), сьют с `slice`-данными.
fn write_project(root: &Path, stand: &str, agents: &[(&str, u16, u32)]) {
    let agents_yaml: String = agents
        .iter()
        .map(|(id, port, w)| format!("      - {{ id: {id}, url: http://127.0.0.1:{port}, weight: {w} }}\n"))
        .collect();
    std::fs::write(
        root.join(MANIFEST_FILE),
        format!("format: 1\nname: p\nservices: [{{ id: orders, path: . }}]\nenvironments:\n  - id: test\n    kind: test\n    http: {stand}\n    agents:\n{agents_yaml}"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let draft = OperationDraft::new("orders", OpKind::Http, Address::Http { method: "GET".into(), path: "/ping".into() }, Source::manual());
    let mut registry = Registry::default();
    registry.operations.push(Operation { fingerprint: draft.fingerprint(), draft, status: Status::Active, first_seen: Seen::default(), last_seen: Seen::default(), manual: Manual::default() });
    std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("registry")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(root.join(REGISTRY_FILE), to_yaml(&registry)).unwrap();
    let mut prod = ProdLoad::default();
    prod.operations.insert("http:orders:GET /ping".into(), Figures { avg: 20.0, peak: 40.0, ..Default::default() });
    std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("load")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(root.join(PROD_LOAD_FILE), to_yaml(&prod)).unwrap();
    let mut profile = ProfileFile::default();
    profile.profiles.insert(
        "short".into(),
        Profile { basis: Basis::Avg, phases: vec![Phase::Ramp { minutes: 0.02, to_pct: 100.0 }, Phase::Steady { minutes: 0.03 }] },
    );
    std::fs::write(root.join(PROFILE_FILE), to_yaml(&profile)).unwrap();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("suites/orders")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(
        root.join("suites/orders/suite.yaml"),
        "format: 1
name: orders
data:
  users: { path: data/users.csv, mode: slice }
defaults:
  max_in_flight: 100
scenarios:
  - id: ping
    steps:
      - http: { operation: \"http:orders:GET /ping\", query: { user: \"{{users.id}}\" } }
        expect: { status: 200 }
",
    )
    .unwrap();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(root.join("data")).unwrap();
    let csv: String = std::iter::once("id,name".to_string()).chain((0..30).map(|i| format!("{i},u{i}"))).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n");
    std::fs::write(root.join("data/users.csv"), csv).unwrap();
}

struct AgentProc(Child);

impl Drop for AgentProc {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.0.kill();
        let _ = self.0.wait();
    }
}

async fn start_agent(port: u16, work: PathBuf) -> AgentProc {
    let child = Command::new(BIN)
        .args(["agent", "--listen", &format!("127.0.0.1:{port}"), "--token", TOKEN, "--work"])
        .arg(&work)
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::inherit())
        .spawn()
        .expect("agent starts");
    let probe = HttpAgent::new("probe", &format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}"), TOKEN, env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(15);
    loop {
        if probe.info().await.is_ok() {
            return AgentProc(child);
        }
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "agent on port {port} did not come up");
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
    }
}

async fn start_stand() -> String {
    let app = Router::new().fallback(any(|| async { Json(serde_json::json!({ "id": "1" })) }));
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    tokio::spawn(async move { axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap() });
    format!("http://{addr}")
}

fn op_n(summary: &AgentSummary) -> u64 {
    summary.ops.iter().find(|o| o.id == "http:orders:GET /ping").map(|o| o.n).unwrap_or(0)
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
async fn run_with_two_agents_collects_files_and_sums_n() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let project = tmp.path().join("project");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&project).unwrap();
    let stand = start_stand().await;
    let (pa, pb) = (free_port(), free_port());
    write_project(&project, &stand, &[("a", pa, 1), ("b", pb, 2)]);
    let _a = start_agent(pa, tmp.path().join("work-a")).await;
    let _b = start_agent(pb, tmp.path().join("work-b")).await;

    let project_arg = project.clone();
    let output = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
        Command::new(BIN)
            .arg("run")
            .arg(&project_arg)
            .args(["--profile", "short", "--env", "test", "--agents", "--suite", "orders"])
            .env("GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN_A", TOKEN)
            .env("GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN_B", TOKEN)
            .output()
            .unwrap()
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
    assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(0), "stdout:\n{stdout}\nstderr:\n{stderr}");

    let runs: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(project.join("runs")).unwrap().map(|e| e.unwrap().path()).collect();
    assert_eq!(runs.len(), 1, "{runs:?}");
    let dir = &runs[0];
    let total: AgentSummary = from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("summary.yaml")).unwrap()).unwrap();
    let mut per_agent = BTreeMap::new();
    for id in ["a", "b"] {
        let path = dir.join("agents").join(id).join("summary.yaml");
        assert!(path.is_file(), "{}", path.display());
        assert!(dir.join("agents").join(id).join("hist.bin").is_file());
        let s: AgentSummary = from_yaml(&std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
        per_agent.insert(id, op_n(&s));
    }
    assert!(per_agent["a"] > 0 && per_agent["b"] > 0, "{per_agent:?}");
    assert_eq!(op_n(&total), per_agent["a"] + per_agent["b"], "общий n = сумма агентов: {per_agent:?}");
    assert!(dir.join("metrics.jsonl").is_file() && dir.join("run.yaml").is_file());
    let run_yaml = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("run.yaml")).unwrap();
    assert!(run_yaml.contains("completed"), "{run_yaml}");

    // Без токена одного агента — код 3 и имя агента в сообщении.
    let project_arg = project.clone();
    let output = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
        Command::new(BIN)
            .arg("run")
            .arg(&project_arg)
            .args(["--profile", "short", "--env", "test", "--agents"])
            .env("GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN_A", TOKEN)
            .env_remove("GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN_B")
            .output()
            .unwrap()
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(3));
    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
    assert!(stderr.contains("TOKEN_MISSING") && stderr.contains("GLAFIRA_LOAD_AGENT_TOKEN_B"), "{stderr}");
}
```
