Вставь перед `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
//! Достраивание незавершённого прогона (спека §6.3): агенты из `run.yaml` опрашиваются
//! (`GET /v1/runs` → статус, `GET /v1/runs/{id}/files` → tar), файлы ложатся в `agents/<id>/`,
//! `summary.yaml` и `run.yaml` дописываются; кого-то не дозвались, нет токена, прогон удалён по
//! `--keep-runs` или агент локальный — статус `incomplete`. Агент, который ещё исполняет этот прогон
//! (`/v1/info.busy`), откладывает достраивание: запись остаётся незавершённой.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::io::Read;
use std::path::{Component, Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

use futures::future::join_all;
use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::{AgentSummary, OpSummary, RunListItem, RunStatus, ScenarioSummary};
use glafira_load_engine::agent_link::{AgentLink, HttpAgent};
use glafira_load_engine::run_files::{RunAgent, RunMeta};
use glafira_load_model::project::is_id;
use glafira_load_model::{from_yaml, to_yaml};

use crate::agents::probe::APP_VERSION;
use crate::agents::token_key;
use crate::commands::blocking;
use crate::error::AppResult;
use crate::runs::{AGENTS_DIR, RUN_FILE, SUMMARY_FILE};
use crate::scan::run::now_rfc3339;
use crate::state::AppState;
use crate::storage::fs::atomic_write_shared;

/// Таймаут `GET /v1/runs`; на скачивание tar — шестикратный.
pub const AGENT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);

/// Что удалось забрать у агента.
pub struct Fetched {
    pub status: RunStatus,
    pub summary: Option<AgentSummary>,
}

/// Ответ агента о прогоне.
pub enum Fetch {
    /// Прогон у агента завершён: статус из `GET /v1/runs`, файлы распакованы в `agents/<id>/`.
    Got(Fetched),
    /// Агент ещё исполняет этот прогон (`/v1/info.busy == run_id`): достраивать рано.
    Running,
    /// Не дозвались, нет токена, прогона у агента нет (удалён по `--keep-runs`) или агент локальный.
    Missing,
}

/// `GET /v1/runs` агента с bearer-токеном; ошибка — текст для журнала.
async fn agent_runs(url: &str, token: &str) -> Result<Vec<RunListItem>, String> {
    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .timeout(AGENT_TIMEOUT)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let resp = client
        .get(format!("{}/v1/runs", url.trim_end_matches('/')))
        .bearer_auth(token)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if !resp.status().is_success() {
        return Err(format!("HTTP {}", resp.status()));
    }
    resp.json::<Vec<RunListItem>>()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// Раскладывает tar агента в `into`: только обычные файлы верхнего уровня (имя без каталогов);
/// возвращает имена в порядке архива.
pub fn unpack(tar: &[u8], into: &Path) -> AppResult<Vec<String>> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(into)?;
    let mut names = Vec::new();
    let mut archive = tar::Archive::new(tar);
    for entry in archive.entries()? {
        let mut entry = entry?;
        let path = entry.path()?.into_owned();
        let normal = path
            .components()
            .filter(|c| matches!(c, Component::Normal(_)))
            .count();
        let plain = normal == 1
            && path
                .components()
                .all(|c| matches!(c, Component::Normal(_) | Component::CurDir));
        let Some(name) = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).map(str::to_string) else {
            continue;
        };
        if !plain || !entry.header().entry_type().is_file() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        entry.read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
        atomic_write_shared(&into.join(&name), &bytes)?;
        names.push(name);
    }
    Ok(names)
}

/// Один агент: `Missing` — не дозвались, нет токена, прогона у агента нет или агент локальный;
/// `Running` — агент ещё исполняет этот прогон.
async fn fetch(run_dir: PathBuf, run_id: String, agent: RunAgent, token: Option<String>) -> Fetch {
    let Some(url) = agent.url.clone() else {
        return Fetch::Missing;
    };
    if !is_id(&agent.id) {
        tracing::warn!(agent = agent.id, "bad agent id in run.yaml");
        return Fetch::Missing;
    }
    let Some(token) = token else {
        tracing::warn!(agent = agent.id, "no token: run cannot be rebuilt from this agent");
        return Fetch::Missing;
    };
    let runs = match agent_runs(&url, &token).await {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => {
            tracing::warn!(agent = agent.id, "GET /v1/runs failed: {e}");
            return Fetch::Missing;
        }
    };
    let link = HttpAgent::new(&agent.id, &url, &token, APP_VERSION);
    let Some(item) = runs.into_iter().find(|r| r.run_id == run_id) else {
        // В списке только завершённые прогоны (спека §4.3): текущий виден в `/v1/info.busy`.
        return match tokio::time::timeout(AGENT_TIMEOUT, link.info()).await {
            Ok(Ok(info)) if info.busy.as_deref() == Some(run_id.as_str()) => {
                tracing::info!(agent = agent.id, "run is still in progress on the agent");
                Fetch::Running
            }
            _ => Fetch::Missing,
        };
    };
    let tar = match tokio::time::timeout(AGENT_TIMEOUT * 6, link.files(&run_id)).await {
        Ok(Ok(t)) => t,
        Ok(Err(e)) => {
            tracing::warn!(agent = agent.id, "files failed: {}: {}", e.code, e.message);
            return Fetch::Missing;
        }
        Err(_) => {
            tracing::warn!(agent = agent.id, "files timed out");
            return Fetch::Missing;
        }
    };
    let dir = run_dir.join(AGENTS_DIR).join(&agent.id);
    let summary = match blocking(move || {
        unpack(&tar, &dir)?;
        Ok(std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(SUMMARY_FILE))
            .ok()
            .and_then(|t| from_yaml::<AgentSummary>(&t).ok()))
    })
    .await
    {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => {
            tracing::warn!(agent = agent.id, "unpack failed: {}", e.message);
            return Fetch::Missing;
        }
    };
    Fetch::Got(Fetched {
        status: item.status,
        summary,
    })
}

fn add_err(acc: &mut BTreeMap<String, u64>, more: &BTreeMap<String, u64>) {
    for (k, v) in more {
        *acc.entry(k.clone()).or_default() += v;
    }
}

fn add_op(acc: &mut OpSummary, o: &OpSummary) {
    acc.n += o.n;
    add_err(&mut acc.err, &o.err);
    acc.dropped += o.dropped;
    acc.rps_avg += o.rps_avg;
    acc.rps_peak += o.rps_peak;
    acc.p50 = acc.p50.max(o.p50);
    acc.p90 = acc.p90.max(o.p90);
    acc.p95 = acc.p95.max(o.p95);
    acc.p99 = acc.p99.max(o.p99);
    acc.max = acc.max.max(o.max);
    acc.target = match (acc.target, o.target) {
        (Some(a), Some(b)) => Some(a + b),
        (a, b) => a.or(b),
    };
}

fn add_scenario(acc: &mut ScenarioSummary, s: &ScenarioSummary) {
    acc.n += s.n;
    add_err(&mut acc.err, &s.err);
    acc.p50 = acc.p50.max(s.p50);
    acc.p95 = acc.p95.max(s.p95);
    acc.p99 = acc.p99.max(s.p99);
    acc.max = acc.max.max(s.max);
}

/// Сводка достроенного прогона из агентских: счётчики, RPS и цели суммируются, перцентили —
/// наибольшие по агентам (верхняя оценка), доля ошибок и достигнутый процент пересчитываются.
pub fn merge_summaries(parts: &[AgentSummary], status: RunStatus) -> AgentSummary {
    let mut ops: BTreeMap<String, OpSummary> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut scenarios: BTreeMap<String, ScenarioSummary> = BTreeMap::new();
    for p in parts {
        for o in &p.ops {
            match ops.get_mut(&o.id) {
                Some(acc) => add_op(acc, o),
                None => {
                    ops.insert(o.id.clone(), o.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        for s in &p.scenarios {
            match scenarios.get_mut(&s.id) {
                Some(acc) => add_scenario(acc, s),
                None => {
                    scenarios.insert(s.id.clone(), s.clone());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for o in ops.values_mut() {
        let errors: u64 = o.err.values().sum();
        o.err_pct = if o.n > 0 {
            errors as f64 / o.n as f64 * 100.0
        } else {
            0.0
        };
        o.achieved_pct = o
            .target
            .filter(|t| *t > 0.0)
            .map(|t| o.rps_avg / t * 100.0);
    }
    AgentSummary {
        status,
        ops: ops.into_values().collect(),
        scenarios: scenarios.into_values().collect(),
        seconds: parts.iter().map(|p| p.seconds).max().unwrap_or(0),
    }
}

/// Статус достроенного прогона: кого-то нет → `incomplete`; иначе `failed` > `stopped` > `completed`.
pub fn combined_status(lost: bool, parts: &[RunStatus]) -> RunStatus {
    if lost || parts.is_empty() || parts.iter().any(|s| matches!(s, RunStatus::Incomplete)) {
        RunStatus::Incomplete
    } else if parts.iter().any(|s| matches!(s, RunStatus::Failed)) {
        RunStatus::Failed
    } else if parts.iter().any(|s| matches!(s, RunStatus::Stopped)) {
        RunStatus::Stopped
    } else {
        RunStatus::Completed
    }
}

/// Достраивает прогон `dir` (`runs/<папка>`): файлы агентов, `summary.yaml`, `run.yaml`; если какой-то агент
/// ещё исполняет прогон — возвращает `meta` без изменений.
pub async fn rebuild(st: &AppState, root: &Path, dir: &str, mut meta: RunMeta) -> AppResult<RunMeta> {
    let run_dir = root.join(dir);
    let tokens = {
        let (st, root, env, agents) = (st.clone(), root.to_path_buf(), meta.env.clone(), meta.agents.clone());
        blocking(move || {
            agents
                .iter()
                .map(|a| match &a.url {
                    Some(_) => st.secrets.get(&token_key(&root, &env, &a.id)),
                    None => Ok(None),
                })
                .collect::<AppResult<Vec<_>>>()
        })
        .await?
    };
    let fetched = join_all(
        meta.agents
            .iter()
            .cloned()
            .zip(tokens)
            .map(|(a, t)| fetch(run_dir.clone(), meta.run_id.clone(), a, t)),
    )
    .await;
    if fetched.iter().any(|f| matches!(f, Fetch::Running)) {
        tracing::info!(run = meta.run_id, "an agent is still running this run: rebuild postponed");
        return Ok(meta);
    }
    let lost = fetched.iter().any(|f| matches!(f, Fetch::Missing));
    let got: Vec<Fetched> = fetched
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|f| match f {
            Fetch::Got(x) => Some(x),
            Fetch::Running | Fetch::Missing => None,
        })
        .collect();
    let statuses: Vec<RunStatus> = got.iter().map(|f| f.status.clone()).collect();
    let status = combined_status(lost, &statuses);
    let summaries: Vec<AgentSummary> = got.into_iter().filter_map(|f| f.summary).collect();
    meta.ended_at = Some(now_rfc3339());
    meta.status = Some(status.clone());
    let out = meta.clone();
    blocking(move || {
        if !summaries.is_empty() {
            atomic_write_shared(
                &run_dir.join(SUMMARY_FILE),
                to_yaml(&merge_summaries(&summaries, status)).as_bytes(),
            )?;
        }
        atomic_write_shared(&run_dir.join(RUN_FILE), to_yaml(&meta).as_bytes())
    })
    .await?;
    tracing::info!(run = out.run_id, status = ?out.status, "run rebuilt");
    Ok(out)
}
```

```rust
//! Команды прогона: запуск с каналом событий, остановка, список, карточка, подтверждение
//! закрытия окна при идущем прогоне (спека §7.1–§7.2).

use glafira_load_engine::agent_api::Mode;
use glafira_load_engine::controller::{ControllerEvent, RunResult};
use tauri::ipc::Channel;
use tauri::{AppHandle, State};

use super::blocking;
use crate::error::AppResult;
use crate::project::manifest::ProjectDir;
use crate::runs::{self, RunDetails, RunListEntry, StartRequest};
use crate::state::AppState;

/// Прогон по профилю на агентах стенда или локально; события — в канал по мере поступления,
/// ответ — итог прогона. Второй прогон в проекте — `RUN_BUSY`.
#[tauri::command]
pub async fn run_start(
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
    path: String,
    suite: String,
    profile: String,
    env: String,
    mode: Mode,
    max_in_flight: Option<u32>,
    on_event: Channel<ControllerEvent>,
) -> AppResult<RunResult> {
    let st = state.inner().clone();
    let req = StartRequest {
        suite,
        profile,
        env,
        mode,
        max_in_flight,
    };
    runs::start(&st, path, req, move |ev| {
        if let Err(e) = on_event.send(ev) {
            tracing::warn!("run event was not delivered: {e}");
        }
    })
    .await
}

/// Мягкая остановка прогона проекта (прогон в проекте один).
#[tauri::command]
pub async fn run_stop(state: State<'_, AppState>, path: String) -> AppResult<()> {
    runs::stop(state.inner(), path).await
}

/// Папки `runs/` по дате убыв.; незавершённые достраиваются.
#[tauri::command]
pub async fn run_list(state: State<'_, AppState>, path: String) -> AppResult<Vec<RunListEntry>> {
    runs::list(state.inner(), path).await
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn run_get(path: String, dir: String) -> AppResult<RunDetails> {
    blocking(move || runs::details(&ProjectDir::open(&path)?, &dir)).await
}

/// Пользователь подтвердил закрытие при идущем прогоне: агенты стенда доработают сами
/// (спека §6.3), локальный прогон останавливается вместе с процессом.
#[tauri::command]
pub fn confirm_close(app: AppHandle, state: State<'_, AppState>) {
    let stopped = state.runs.stop_all();
    tracing::info!(stopped, "closing on user confirmation");
    app.exit(0);
}
```

```ts
  runList: (path: string) => call<RunListEntry[]>("run_list", { path }),
  runGet: (path: string, dir: string) => call<RunDetails>("run_get", { path, dir }),
  /** Ответ на событие `run-close-requested`: окно можно закрывать. */
  confirmClose: () => call<void>("confirm_close"),
```

```tsx
/** Узел проекта: имя, разделы, сервисы и сьюты (берутся при раскрытии из манифеста и `suite_list`). */
function ProjectNode({ project, collapsed, onToggle }: { project: RecentProject; collapsed: boolean; onToggle: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const open = useWorkspace((s) => s.open);
  const closeForProject = useWorkspace((s) => s.closeForProject);
  const expanded = !collapsed && !project.missing;
  const manifest = useQuery({ queryKey: ["project", project.path], queryFn: () => api.projectView(project.path), enabled: expanded });
  const suites = useQuery({ queryKey: ["suites", project.path], queryFn: () => api.suiteList(project.path), enabled: expanded });
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.projectClose(project.path),
    onSuccess: () => {
      closeForProject(project.path);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["projects"] });
    },
  });
  const label = project.name ?? baseName(project.path);
  const section = (spec: TabSpec, text: string) => (
    <li role="treeitem" key={text}>
      <button type="button" className="link tree-name" onClick={() => open(spec)}>
        {text}
      </button>
    </li>
  );
  return (
    // Пропавший проект не раскрывается: aria-expanded только у раскрываемого узла, сам узел серый, а не красный.
    <li role="treeitem" aria-expanded={project.missing ? undefined : !collapsed} aria-label={label} className={project.missing ? "tree-folder muted" : "tree-folder"}>
      <div className="tree-conn">
        <button type="button" className="tree-caret" aria-label={t("sidebar.folderToggle", { name: label })} onClick={onToggle} disabled={project.missing}>
          {collapsed ? "▸" : "▾"}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="link tree-name" title={project.path} disabled={project.missing} onClick={() => open({ kind: "project", path: project.path })}>
          {label}
        </button>
        {project.missing && <span className="muted">{t("sidebar.missing")}</span>}
        <button type="button" className="icon" aria-label={t("sidebar.remove")} onClick={() => remove.mutate()}>
          ×
        </button>
      </div>
      {expanded && (
        <ul role="group" className="tree">
          {section({ kind: "project", path: project.path }, t("sidebar.project"))}
          <li role="treeitem" aria-label={t("sidebar.services")}>
            <span className="muted">{t("sidebar.services")}</span>
            <ul role="group" className="tree">
              {(manifest.data?.manifest.services ?? []).map((s) => (
                <li role="treeitem" key={s.id}>
                  <button type="button" className="link tree-name" onClick={() => open({ kind: "service", path: project.path, serviceId: s.id })}>
                    {s.name || s.id}
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </li>
          {section({ kind: "registry", path: project.path }, t("sidebar.registry"))}
          {section({ kind: "prod-load", path: project.path }, t("sidebar.prodLoad"))}
          {section({ kind: "profile", path: project.path }, t("sidebar.profile"))}
          <li role="treeitem" aria-label={t("sidebar.suites")}>
            <div className="tree-conn">
              <span className="muted">{t("sidebar.suites")}</span>
            </div>
            <ul role="group" className="tree">
              {(suites.data ?? []).map((s) => (
                <li role="treeitem" key={s.name}>
                  <button type="button" className="link tree-name" title={s.file} onClick={() => open({ kind: "suite", path: project.path, name: s.name })}>
                    {s.name}
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
              {suites.data?.length === 0 && <li className="tree-notice">{t("sidebar.noSuites")}</li>}
            </ul>
          </li>
          {section({ kind: "run", path: project.path }, t("sidebar.run"))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {manifest.error && <ErrorBanner error={manifest.error} />}
      {suites.error && <ErrorBanner error={suites.error} />}
      {remove.error && <ErrorBanner error={remove.error} />}
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { useState } from "react";
import { vi } from "vitest";
import type { Agent } from "../../api/types";
import { renderWithClient } from "../../test/render";
import { EnvironmentAgents } from "./EnvironmentAgents";

// vi.mock поднимается над импортами — объект мока создаётся там же через vi.hoisted.
const api = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  agentSetToken: vi.fn(async () => undefined),
  agentProbe: vi.fn(async () => [
    { id: "gen-1", url: "http://10.0.1.11:7420", state: "ready", info: { version: "0.2.0", os: "linux", arch: "x86_64", cpus: 8, busy: null }, message: null },
    { id: "gen-2", url: "http://10.0.1.12:7420", state: "no_token", info: null, message: null },
  ]),
}));
vi.mock("../../api/client", () => ({ api, toAppError: (e: unknown) => e }));

const initial: Agent[] = [
  { id: "gen-1", url: "http://10.0.1.11:7420", weight: 1 },
  { id: "gen-2", url: "http://10.0.1.12:7420", weight: 2 },
];

function Harness({ onChange }: { onChange?: (a: Agent[]) => void }) {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>(initial);
  return (
    <EnvironmentAgents
      path="/p"
      envId="test"
      agents={agents}
      onChange={(a) => {
        setAgents(a);
        onChange?.(a);
      }}
    />
  );
}

describe("EnvironmentAgents", () => {
  beforeEach(() => vi.clearAllMocks());

  it("saves the token into the OS keychain without writing it anywhere else", async () => {
    renderWithClient(<Harness />);
    const field = screen.getByLabelText("Токен агента gen-1");
    expect(field).toHaveAttribute("type", "password");
    await userEvent.type(field, "s3cret");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Сохранить токен" })[0]);
    expect(api.agentSetToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/p", "test", "gen-1", "s3cret");
    await waitFor(() => expect(field).toHaveValue(""));
    expect(screen.getByText("Токен сохранён в хранилище ОС")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Удалить токен" })[1]);
    expect(api.agentSetToken).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("/p", "test", "gen-2", null);
  });

  it("probes the agents and shows badges, including the missing token", async () => {
    renderWithClient(<Harness />);
    expect(api.agentProbe).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Проверить" }));
    expect(api.agentProbe).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/p", "test");
    const badges = await screen.findAllByTestId("agent-state");
    expect(badges.map((b) => b.textContent)).toEqual(["готов", "нет токена"]);
    expect(badges[0]).toHaveClass("state-ok");
    expect(badges[1]).toHaveClass("state-warn");
    expect(screen.getByText("0.2.0 · linux/x86_64 · 8 ядер")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("токен не задан")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("токен задан")).toBeInTheDocument();
    // После сохранения токена статусы перечитываются.
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText("Токен агента gen-2"), "t");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Сохранить токен" })[1]);
    await waitFor(() => expect(api.agentProbe).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
  });

  it("adds and removes agents and flags bad ids, urls and weights", async () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    renderWithClient(<Harness onChange={onChange} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Добавить агента" }));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith([...initial, { id: "", url: "", weight: 1 }]);
    const ids = screen.getAllByLabelText("ID агента");
    expect(ids[2]).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    await userEvent.type(ids[2], "gen-1");
    expect(ids[2]).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(screen.getAllByLabelText("Адрес агента")[2]).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    await userEvent.type(screen.getAllByLabelText("Адрес агента")[2], "http://10.0.1.13:7420");
    expect(screen.getAllByLabelText("Адрес агента")[2]).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid");
    await userEvent.clear(screen.getAllByLabelText("Вес")[2]);
    await userEvent.type(screen.getAllByLabelText("Вес")[2], "0");
    expect(screen.getAllByLabelText("Вес")[2]).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    // Токен нельзя сохранить агенту с плохим или повторённым ID.
    expect(screen.getAllByLabelText(/Токен агента/)[2]).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Удалить gen-2" }));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith([initial[0], expect.objectContaining({ id: "gen-1" })]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Fragment, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { Agent, AgentProbeState, AgentStatus } from "../../api/types";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";
import { Hint } from "../common/Hint";
import { NumberInput } from "../common/NumberInput";

/** Формат ID агента — как у сервисов и стендов (`is_id` в Rust). */
export const AGENT_ID_RE = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$/;
const URL_RE = /^https?:\/\/\S+$/;

export const validAgentUrl = (url: string): boolean => URL_RE.test(url);
export const validAgentWeight = (w: number): boolean => Number.isInteger(w) && w >= 1;

/** Цвет бейджа probe: зелёный — готов, жёлтый — занят или без токена, красный — недоступен или другая версия. */
const BADGE: Record<AgentProbeState, "ok" | "warn" | "err"> = { ready: "ok", busy: "warn", no_token: "warn", unreachable: "err", version: "err" };

/** Бейдж состояния агента по ответу `agent_probe` с подробностью: версия и ядра, id чужого прогона или причина ошибки. */
export function AgentStateBadge({ status }: { status: AgentStatus }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const detail =
    status.state === "ready" && status.info
      ? t("agents.info", { version: status.info.version, os: status.info.os, arch: status.info.arch, cpus: status.info.cpus })
      : status.state === "busy" && status.info?.busy
        ? t("agents.busyRun", { run: status.info.busy })
        : (status.message ?? "");
  return (
    <span className="agent-status">
      <span className={`state-badge state-${BADGE[status.state]}`} data-testid="agent-state">
        {t(`agents.state.${status.state}`)}
      </span>
      {detail && <span className="muted"> {detail}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Поле токена: значение уходит только в `agent_set_token` (хранилище ОС) и не попадает в манифест. */
function TokenField({ path, envId, agent, status, disabled, onSaved }: { path: string; envId: string; agent: Agent; status: AgentStatus | undefined; disabled: boolean; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [token, setToken] = useState("");
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const set = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (value: string | null) => api.agentSetToken(path, envId, agent.id, value),
    onSuccess: (_r, value) => {
      setToken("");
      setSaved(value !== null);
      onSaved();
    },
  });
  const indicator = saved ? (
    <span className="muted">{t("agents.tokenSaved")}</span>
  ) : status?.state === "no_token" ? (
    <span className="warn">{t("agents.tokenMissing")}</span>
  ) : status ? (
    <span className="muted">{t("agents.tokenSet")}</span>
  ) : null;
  return (
    <div className="row">
      <input
        type="password"
        autoComplete="off"
        aria-label={t("agents.token", { id: agent.id })}
        placeholder={t("agents.tokenPlaceholder")}
        value={token}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(e) => setToken(e.target.value)}
      />
      <button type="button" disabled={disabled || !token || set.isPending} onClick={() => set.mutate(token)}>
        {t("agents.saveToken")}
      </button>
      <button type="button" disabled={disabled || set.isPending} onClick={() => set.mutate(null)}>
        {t("agents.removeToken")}
      </button>
      {indicator}
      {set.error && <ErrorBanner error={set.error} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Агенты стенда в форме проекта: таблица id/URL/вес, токен каждого (в хранилище ОС) и «Проверить» —
 * `agent_probe` по агентам сохранённого манифеста.
 */
export function EnvironmentAgents({ path, envId, agents, onChange, disabled = false }: { path: string; envId: string; agents: Agent[]; onChange: (agents: Agent[]) => void; disabled?: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const canProbe = AGENT_ID_RE.test(envId) && agents.length > 0;
  // Только по кнопке: probe ходит по сети, вкладка проекта не должна делать этого сама.
  const probe = useQuery({ queryKey: ["agentProbe", path, envId], queryFn: () => api.agentProbe(path, envId), enabled: false });
  const statuses = new Map((probe.data ?? []).map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const ids = agents.map((a) => a.id);
  const update = (i: number, patch: Partial<Agent>) => onChange(agents.map((a, j) => (j === i ? { ...a, ...patch } : a)));
  return (
    <section className="agents">
      <h4>
        {t("agents.title")} <Hint k="hints.project.agents" label={t("agents.title")} />
      </h4>
      {agents.length === 0 && <p className="muted">{t("agents.empty")}</p>}
      {agents.length > 0 && (
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>{t("agents.id")}</th>
              <th>{t("agents.url")}</th>
              <th>{t("agents.weight")}</th>
              <th>{t("agents.status")}</th>
              <th />
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {agents.map((a, i) => {
              const dupe = ids.indexOf(a.id) !== i;
              const badId = !AGENT_ID_RE.test(a.id) || dupe;
              const status = statuses.get(a.id);
              return (
                <Fragment key={i}>
                  <tr>
                    <td>
                      <input aria-label={t("agents.id")} aria-invalid={badId || undefined} value={a.id} disabled={disabled} onChange={(e) => update(i, { id: e.target.value })} />
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <input aria-label={t("agents.url")} aria-invalid={!validAgentUrl(a.url) || undefined} placeholder="http://10.0.1.11:7420" value={a.url} disabled={disabled} onChange={(e) => update(i, { url: e.target.value })} />
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <NumberInput aria-label={t("agents.weight")} aria-invalid={!validAgentWeight(a.weight) || undefined} min={1} step={1} value={a.weight} disabled={disabled} onChange={(v) => update(i, { weight: v ?? Number.NaN })} />
                    </td>
                    <td>{status ? <AgentStateBadge status={status} /> : <span className="muted">—</span>}</td>
                    <td>
                      <button type="button" className="icon" aria-label={`${t("common.delete")} ${a.id}`} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onChange(agents.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>
                        ×
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={5}>
                      <TokenField path={path} envId={envId} agent={a} status={status} disabled={disabled || badId} onSaved={() => probe.data && void probe.refetch()} />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </Fragment>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      <div className="row">
        <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onChange([...agents, { id: "", url: "", weight: 1 }])}>
          {t("agents.add")}
        </button>
        <button type="button" disabled={!canProbe || probe.isFetching} onClick={() => probe.refetch()}>
          {t("agents.probe")}
        </button>
        <span className="muted">{t("agents.probeSavedOnly")}</span>
      </div>
      {probe.error && <ErrorBanner error={probe.error} onRetry={() => probe.refetch()} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { CheckReport, HttpStep, SuiteView } from "../api/types";

/** Текст сьюта `orders`: строки совпадают с картой `lines` в `suiteView()`. */
export const SUITE_TEXT = `format: 1
name: orders
scenarios:
  - id: order-flow
    steps:
      - id: create
        http:
          operation: "http:orders:POST /v1/orders"
        expect: { status: 201 }
      - http:
          operation: "http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}"
        expect: { status: 200, max_ms: 800 }
`;

const http = (operation: string): HttpStep => ({ operation, path: {}, query: {}, headers: {}, body: null, body_text: null, timeout_ms: null });

/** Разобранный сьют `orders`: один сценарий, два HTTP-шага (второй без id). */
export function suiteView(): SuiteView {
  return {
    name: "orders",
    file: "suites/orders/suite.yaml",
    text: SUITE_TEXT,
    suite: {
      format: 1,
      name: "orders",
      secrets: [],
      data: {},
      defaults: { http: { timeout_ms: 5000, headers: {} }, kafka: {}, arrival: "poisson", max_in_flight: 1000 },
      scenarios: [
        {
          id: "order-flow",
          drives: null,
          on_fail: "stop",
          steps: [
            { id: "create", http: http("http:orders:POST /v1/orders"), expect: { status: 201, jsonpath: {}, schema: null, max_ms: null }, extract: {} },
            { id: null, http: http("http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}"), expect: { status: 200, jsonpath: {}, schema: null, max_ms: 800 }, extract: {} },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
    findings: [],
    lines: { "scenarios[0]": 4, "scenarios[0].steps[0]": 6, "scenarios[0].steps[1]": 10 },
  };
}

/** Отчёт `check`: ошибка со строкой, предупреждение без строки, покрытие с расхождением на второй операции. */
export function checkReport(): CheckReport {
  return {
    findings: [
      { level: "error", file: "suites/orders/suite.yaml", line: 8, message: "operation http:orders:POST /v1/orders is not in the registry" },
      { level: "warning", file: "suites/orders/suite.yaml", line: null, message: "operation http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id} is removed" },
    ],
    coverage: {
      rows: [
        { id: "http:orders:POST /v1/orders", kind: "http", target: 100, planned: 100, delta: 0 },
        { id: "http:orders:GET /v1/orders/{id}", kind: "http", target: 50, planned: 100, delta: 50 },
      ],
      uncovered: ["kafka_consume:orders.created"],
    },
    profile: "nominal",
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: `src/components/suites/SuiteTree.tsx`**

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { OpKind, Scenario, Step, SuiteView } from "../../api/types";

/** Вид и операция шага: ключ шага — вариант `Action`. */
export function stepAction(step: Step): { kind: OpKind; operation: string } {
  if ("http" in step) return { kind: "http", operation: step.http.operation };
  if ("kafka_produce" in step) return { kind: "kafka_produce", operation: step.kafka_produce.operation };
  return { kind: "kafka_consume", operation: step.kafka_consume.operation };
}

/** Число проверок шага: `status`, каждый `jsonpath`, `schema`, `max_ms`. */
export function checksCount(step: Step): number {
  const e = step.expect;
  return (e.status != null ? 1 : 0) + Object.keys(e.jsonpath).length + (e.schema ? 1 : 0) + (e.max_ms != null ? 1 : 0);
}

/** Операция, которую ведёт сценарий: `drives` либо операция первого шага (как `Scenario::drives` в Rust). */
export function drivesOf(s: Scenario): string {
  return s.drives ?? (s.steps[0] ? stepAction(s.steps[0]).operation : "");
}

/** Id шага: заданный или `step<N>` (1-based), как `Scenario::step_ids`. */
export const stepId = (step: Step, index: number): string => step.id ?? `step${index + 1}`;

/**
 * Строки текста с `from` по `to` (1-based, `to` не включается): фрагмент шага от его строки до строки
 * следующего ключа карты `lines`. Хвостовые пустые строки отбрасываются; `from` за концом текста — пусто.
 */
export function sliceYaml(text: string, from: number, to: number): string {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const start = Math.min(lines.length, Math.max(1, from) - 1);
  const end = Math.min(lines.length, Math.max(start, to - 1));
  const out = lines.slice(start, end);
  while (out.length > 0 && out[out.length - 1].trim() === "") out.pop();
  return out.join("\n");
}

/** Ближайшая строка карты `lines` после `from`, иначе `fallback` (строка за концом текста). */
export function nextLine(lines: Record<string, number>, from: number, fallback: number): number {
  let best = fallback;
  for (const l of Object.values(lines)) if (l > from && l < best) best = l;
  return best;
}

/** Сценарии и шаги деревом; выбранный шаг показан фрагментом YAML только для чтения. */
export function SuiteTree({ view, onOpenFile }: { view: SuiteView; onOpenFile: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const suite = view.suite;
  if (!suite) return <p className="muted">{t("suite.noSuite")}</p>;
  const total = view.text.split("\n").length + 1;
  const line = selected ? view.lines[selected] : undefined;
  const fragment = line ? sliceYaml(view.text, line, nextLine(view.lines, line, total)) : null;
  return (
    <div className="suite-body">
      <ul role="tree" className="tree suite-tree" aria-label={t("suite.scenarios")}>
        {suite.scenarios.map((s, i) => (
          <li role="treeitem" key={s.id} aria-expanded="true">
            <div className="tree-conn">
              <strong>{s.id}</strong>
              <span className="muted">{t("suite.drives", { operation: drivesOf(s) })}</span>
              <span className="kind-badge">{t(`suite.onFail.${s.on_fail}`)}</span>
              <span className="muted">{t("suite.steps", { n: s.steps.length })}</span>
            </div>
            <ul role="group" className="tree">
              {s.steps.map((step, j) => {
                const key = `scenarios[${i}].steps[${j}]`;
                const a = stepAction(step);
                return (
                  <li role="treeitem" key={key} aria-selected={selected === key}>
                    <button type="button" className={selected === key ? "link tree-name active" : "link tree-name"} onClick={() => setSelected(key)}>
                      <span className={`kind-badge kind-${a.kind}`}>{t(`registry.kinds.${a.kind}`)}</span> {stepId(step, j)} <code>{a.operation}</code>{" "}
                      <span className="muted">{t("suite.checks", { n: checksCount(step) })}</span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <div className="suite-step">
        {fragment === null ? (
          <p className="muted">{t("suite.selectStep")}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="row">
              <span className="muted">{t("suite.line", { line })}</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={onOpenFile}>
                {t("suite.openFile")}
              </button>
            </div>
            <pre data-testid="step-yaml">
              <code>{fragment}</code>
            </pre>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { Finding } from "../../api/types";

export const hasErrors = (findings: Finding[]): boolean => findings.some((f) => f.level === "error");

/** Таблица находок `check`: уровень, файл:строка (кнопка открывает файл), сообщение. */
export function CheckReport({ findings, onOpen }: { findings: Finding[]; onOpen: (file: string) => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (findings.length === 0) return <p className="muted">{t("suite.noFindings")}</p>;
  return (
    <table className="findings">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{t("suite.column.level")}</th>
          <th>{t("suite.column.where")}</th>
          <th>{t("suite.column.message")}</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {findings.map((f, i) => (
          <tr key={i}>
            <td>
              <span className={`sev sev-${f.level}`}>{t(`suite.level.${f.level}`)}</span>
            </td>
            <td>
              <button type="button" className="link" title={t("suite.openFile")} onClick={() => onOpen(f.file)}>
                <code>{f.line === null ? f.file : `${f.file}:${f.line}`}</code>
              </button>
            </td>
            <td>{f.message}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import type { Coverage, CoverageRow } from "../../api/types";
import { formatNumber } from "../../lib/format";
import { Hint } from "../common/Hint";

/** Расхождение заметно, если |delta| больше 10 % цели (при нулевой цели — любое ненулевое). */
export const isOff = (row: CoverageRow): boolean => Math.abs(row.delta) > 0.1 * row.target;

const signed = (v: number): string => (v > 0 ? `+${formatNumber(v, 1)}` : formatNumber(v, 1));

/** Покрытие профиля сьютом: операция, вид, цель, расчётная нагрузка, разница; «не покрыто» списком. */
export function CoverageTable({ coverage, profile }: { coverage: Coverage; profile: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <section>
      <h3>
        {t("suite.coverageTitle", { profile })} <Hint k="hints.suite.coverage" label={t("suite.coverageTitle", { profile })} />
      </h3>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>{t("suite.column.operation")}</th>
            <th>{t("suite.column.kind")}</th>
            <th>{t("suite.column.target")}</th>
            <th>{t("suite.column.planned")}</th>
            <th>{t("suite.column.delta")}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {coverage.rows.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.id}>
              <td>
                <code>{r.id}</code>
              </td>
              <td>
                <span className={`kind-badge kind-${r.kind}`}>{t(`registry.kinds.${r.kind}`)}</span>
              </td>
              <td>{formatNumber(r.target, 1)}</td>
              <td>{formatNumber(r.planned, 1)}</td>
              <td data-testid="delta" className={isOff(r) ? "warn" : undefined}>
                {signed(r.delta)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      {coverage.uncovered.length > 0 && (
        <details open>
          <summary className="warn">{t("suite.uncovered", { n: coverage.uncovered.length })}</summary>
          <ul>
            {coverage.uncovered.map((id) => (
              <li key={id}>
                <code>{id}</code>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { SuiteMeta } from "../../api/types";
import { trapTab } from "../../lib/focusTrap";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../state/workspace";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";

/** Имя сьюта — папка `suites/<имя>`, как `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}` в Rust. */
export const SUITE_NAME_RE = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$/;

/** Диалог «Создать сьют»: имя и активные операции реестра галочками; `suite_create` пишет заготовку и открывает вкладку. */
export function CreateSuiteDialog({ path, onClose }: { path: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const open = useWorkspace((s) => s.open);
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
  const ops = useQuery({ queryKey: ["registry", path, { status: "active" }], queryFn: () => api.registryList(path, { status: "active" }) });
  useEffect(() => root.current?.focus(), []);
  const list = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (ops.data ?? []).filter((r) => !q || r.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [ops.data, query]);
  const create = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => api.suiteCreate(path, name.trim(), [...picked]),
    onSuccess: (meta: SuiteMeta) => {
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suites", path] });
      open({ kind: "suite", path, name: meta.name });
      onClose();
    },
  });
  const trimmed = name.trim();
  const validName = SUITE_NAME_RE.test(trimmed);
  const toggle = (id: string) =>
    setPicked((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (!next.delete(id)) next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose}>
      <div
        ref={root}
        className="modal"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="create-suite-title"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
          else if (e.key === "Tab") trapTab(root.current, e);
        }}
      >
        <h3 id="create-suite-title">{t("suite.dialog.title")}</h3>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="suite-name">{t("suite.dialog.name")}</label>
          <input id="suite-name" value={name} aria-invalid={(trimmed !== "" && !validName) || undefined} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
          {trimmed !== "" && !validName && <span className="warn">{t("suite.dialog.badName")}</span>}
        </div>
        <input aria-label={t("suite.dialog.search")} placeholder={t("suite.dialog.search")} value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} />
        {ops.error && <ErrorBanner error={ops.error} onRetry={() => ops.refetch()} />}
        {ops.data && ops.data.length === 0 && <p className="muted">{t("suite.dialog.noOperations")}</p>}
        <ul className="pick-list" aria-label={t("suite.dialog.operations")}>
          {list.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.id}>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={picked.has(r.id)} onChange={() => toggle(r.id)} /> <span className={`kind-badge kind-${r.kind}`}>{t(`registry.kinds.${r.kind}`)}</span>{" "}
                <code>{r.id}</code> <span className="muted">{r.name}</span>
              </label>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <span className="muted">{t("suite.dialog.selected", { n: picked.size })}</span>
        {create.error && <ErrorBanner error={create.error} />}
        <div className="row">
          <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={!validName || picked.size === 0 || create.isPending} onClick={() => create.mutate()}>
            {t("suite.dialog.create")}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("common.cancel")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  suiteGet: vi.fn(),
  suiteCheck: vi.fn(),
  suiteCreate: vi.fn(),

  openPath: vi.fn(async () => undefined),
}));
vi.mock("../../api/client", () => ({ api, toAppError: (e: unknown) => e }));

describe("SuitePanel", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    api.suiteGet.mockImplementation(async () => suiteView());
    api.suiteCheck.mockImplementation(async () => checkReport());
  });

  it("shows the tree, the YAML of the selected step and opens the file", async () => {
    renderWithClient(<SuitePanel path="/p" name="orders" />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: /Сьют orders/ })).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(api.openPath).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/p", "/p/suites/orders/suite.yaml");
  });

  it("shows the check report and the coverage, and re-reads both on Check", async () => {
    renderWithClient(<SuitePanel path="/p" name="orders" />);
    expect(await screen.findByText("operation http:orders:POST /v1/orders is not in the registry")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "suites/orders/suite.yaml:8" }));
    expect(api.openPath).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/p", "/p/suites/orders/suite.yaml");
    expect(screen.getByText(/Покрытие профиля nominal/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getAllByTestId("delta")[1]).toHaveClass("warn");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Проверить" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(api.suiteGet).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    expect(api.suiteCheck).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("falls back to the findings of suite_get and explains the missing coverage", async () => {
    api.suiteGet.mockImplementation(async () => ({ ...suiteView(), suite: null, findings: [{ level: "error", file: "suites/orders/suite.yaml", line: 3, message: "unknown field `scenario`" }] }));
    api.suiteCheck.mockImplementation(async () => ({ findings: [{ level: "error", file: "suites/orders/suite.yaml", line: 3, message: "unknown field `scenario`" }], coverage: null, profile: "nominal" }));
```

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import { joinProjectPath } from "../../lib/paths";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";
import { Hint } from "../common/Hint";
import { CheckReport } from "./CheckReport";
import { CoverageTable } from "./CoverageTable";
import { CreateSuiteDialog } from "./CreateSuiteDialog";
import { SuiteTree } from "./SuiteTree";

/** Вкладка «Сьют»: дерево шагов, отчёт `check`, покрытие профиля; файл правят в редакторе — вкладка его перечитывает. */
export function SuitePanel({ path, name }: { path: string; name: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  // Файл меняют снаружи: при возврате фокуса в окно и по кнопке «Проверить» оба запроса перечитывают диск
  // (глобально во `App` перезапрос по фокусу выключен — здесь он нужен).
  const view = useQuery({ queryKey: ["suite", path, name], queryFn: () => api.suiteGet(path, name), refetchOnWindowFocus: true });
  const check = useQuery({ queryKey: ["suiteCheck", path, name], queryFn: () => api.suiteCheck(path, name), refetchOnWindowFocus: true });
  const openFile = useMutation({ mutationFn: (file: string) => api.openPath(path, joinProjectPath(path, file)) });
  const recheck = () => {
    void view.refetch();
    void check.refetch();
  };
  if (view.error) return <ErrorBanner error={view.error} onRetry={recheck} />;
  const v = view.data;
  if (!v) return <p className="empty">{t("common.loading")}</p>;
  // Пока отчёт не пришёл (или упал), показываем находки разбора из `suite_get`.
  const findings = check.data?.findings ?? v.findings;
  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <h2>
          {t("suite.title", { name: v.name })} <Hint k="hints.suite.title" label={t("suite.title", { name: v.name })} />
        </h2>
        <code className="muted">{v.file}</code>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => openFile.mutate(v.file)}>
          {t("suite.openFile")}
        </button>
        <button type="button" disabled={view.isFetching || check.isFetching} onClick={recheck}>
          {t("suite.check")}
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setCreating(true)}>
          {t("suite.create")}
        </button>
      </div>
      {openFile.error && <ErrorBanner error={openFile.error} />}
      {creating && <CreateSuiteDialog path={path} onClose={() => setCreating(false)} />}
      <SuiteTree view={v} onOpenFile={() => openFile.mutate(v.file)} />
      <section>
        <h3>{t("suite.findings")}</h3>
        {check.error && <ErrorBanner error={check.error} onRetry={() => check.refetch()} />}
        <CheckReport findings={findings} onOpen={(file) => openFile.mutate(file)} />
      </section>
      {check.data?.coverage ? <CoverageTable coverage={check.data.coverage} profile={check.data.profile} /> : check.data && <p className="muted">{t("suite.noCoverage")}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: `src/state/run.ts`**

```ts
import { listen } from "@tauri-apps/api/event";
import { create } from "zustand";
import { api, toAppError } from "../api/client";
import type { AgentRunState, AppError, ControllerEvent, ErrorSample, Mode, PhaseEvent, Point, RunResult, Tick } from "../api/types";

export type RunState = "idle" | "starting" | "running" | "stopping" | "done" | "failed";
/** Длина кольцевого буфера рядов — последний час посекундно. */
export const RING = 3600;
/** Сколько примеров ошибок держим в памяти. */
const SAMPLES = 50;

/** Ряды графиков: секунда от старта, суммарный RPS факт и цель, p95 по операциям (null — операции не было в тике). */
export interface RunSeries { t: number[]; rps: number[]; rpsTarget: number[]; p95ByOp: Record<string, (number | null)[]> }
export interface StartParams { suite: string; profile: string; env: string; mode: Mode; maxInFlight: number | null; timeline: Point[]; total: number }
export interface ProjectRun {
  status: RunState;
  params: StartParams | null;
  runId: string | null;
  dir: string | null;
  /** Ряды мутируются на месте (кольцевой буфер); `version` растёт с каждым тиком — по нему перерисовываются графики. */
  series: RunSeries;
  version: number;
  lastTick: Tick | null;
  agents: Record<string, AgentRunState>;
  requests: number;
  errors: number;
  dropped: number;
  phase: PhaseEvent | null;
  samples: ErrorSample[];
  result: RunResult | null;
  error: AppError | null;
}

export const emptyRun = (): ProjectRun => ({
  status: "idle",
  params: null,
  runId: null,
  dir: null,
  series: { t: [], rps: [], rpsTarget: [], p95ByOp: {} },
  version: 0,
  lastTick: null,
  agents: {},
  requests: 0,
  errors: 0,
  dropped: 0,
  phase: null,
  samples: [],
  result: null,
  error: null,
});

/** Процент цели в секунду `second`: линейная интерполяция таймлайна по минутам (как `scheduler::pct_at`). */
export function pctAt(timeline: Point[], second: number): number {
  if (timeline.length === 0) return 0;
  const m = second / 60;
  if (m <= timeline[0].minute) return timeline[0].pct;
  for (let i = 1; i < timeline.length; i++) {
    const a = timeline[i - 1];
    const b = timeline[i];
    if (m <= b.minute) {
      const span = b.minute - a.minute;
      return span <= 0 ? b.pct : a.pct + ((b.pct - a.pct) * (m - a.minute)) / span;
    }
  }
  return timeline[timeline.length - 1].pct;
}

function push<T>(arr: T[], v: T): void {
  arr.push(v);
  if (arr.length > RING) arr.splice(0, arr.length - RING);
}

const sum = (xs: number[]): number => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

/** Один тик в ряды: суммарный RPS, цель по таймлайну, p95 по операциям; счётчики запросов, ошибок и dropped. */
export function applyTick(run: ProjectRun, tick: Tick): ProjectRun {
  const s = run.series;
  const rps = sum(tick.ops.map((o) => o.n));
  push(s.t, tick.t);
  push(s.rps, rps);
  push(s.rpsTarget, (pctAt(run.params?.timeline ?? [], tick.t) / 100) * (run.params?.total ?? 0));
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const o of tick.ops) {
    seen.add(o.id);
    // Операция, появившаяся не с первой секунды, получает null за прошлые секунды, чтобы ряды были одной длины.
    const arr = s.p95ByOp[o.id] ?? (s.p95ByOp[o.id] = new Array<number | null>(s.t.length - 1).fill(null));
    push(arr, o.p95);
  }
  for (const [id, arr] of Object.entries(s.p95ByOp)) if (!seen.has(id)) push(arr, null);
  return {
    ...run,
    version: run.version + 1,
    lastTick: tick,
    requests: run.requests + rps,
    errors: run.errors + sum(tick.ops.map((o) => sum(Object.values(o.err)))),
    dropped: run.dropped + sum(tick.ops.map((o) => o.dropped)),
  };
}

/** Событие контроллера → новое состояние прогона. */
export function reduceEvent(run: ProjectRun, e: ControllerEvent): ProjectRun {
  switch (e.type) {
    case "started":
      return { ...run, status: "running", runId: e.run_id, dir: e.dir };
    case "tick":
      return applyTick(run, e);
    case "phase":
      return { ...run, phase: { t: e.t, index: e.index, pct: e.pct } };
    case "agent":
      return { ...run, agents: { ...run.agents, [e.id]: e.state } };
    case "error": {
      const { type: _type, ...sample } = e;
      return { ...run, samples: [...run.samples.slice(-(SAMPLES - 1)), sample] };
    }
    case "done": {
      const { type: _type, ...result } = e;
      return { ...run, status: "done", result, runId: result.run_id, dir: result.dir };
    }
  }
}

const ACTIVE: RunState[] = ["starting", "running", "stopping"];
export const isActive = (status: RunState): boolean => ACTIVE.includes(status);

interface RunStore {
  byProject: Record<string, ProjectRun>;
  /** Окно просят закрыть во время прогона (событие Tauri `run-close-requested`); диалог — `RunCloseDialog`. */
  closeRequested: boolean;
  setCloseRequested: (v: boolean) => void;
  start: (path: string, params: StartParams) => Promise<void>;
  stop: (path: string) => Promise<void>;
  onEvent: (path: string, e: ControllerEvent) => void;
  reset: (path: string) => void;
}

let closeListener: Promise<() => void> | null = null;
/** Подписка на запрос закрытия окна — одна на приложение, ставится при первом запуске прогона. */
function ensureCloseListener(): void {
  closeListener ??= listen("run-close-requested", () => useRunStore.setState({ closeRequested: true }));
}

/** Состояние прогонов по проектам живёт в сторе: уход с вкладки и её закрытие прогон не теряют. */
export const useRunStore = create<RunStore>((set, get) => {
  const patch = (path: string, f: (r: ProjectRun) => ProjectRun) => set((s) => ({ byProject: { ...s.byProject, [path]: f(s.byProject[path] ?? emptyRun()) } }));
  return {
    byProject: {},
    closeRequested: false,
    setCloseRequested: (v) => set({ closeRequested: v }),
    onEvent: (path, e) => patch(path, (r) => reduceEvent(r, e)),
    reset: (path) => patch(path, () => emptyRun()),
    start: async (path, params) => {
      const current = get().byProject[path];
      if (current && isActive(current.status)) return;
      ensureCloseListener();
      patch(path, () => ({ ...emptyRun(), status: "starting", params }));
      try {
        const result = await api.runStart(path, params.suite, params.profile, params.env, params.mode, params.maxInFlight, (e) => get().onEvent(path, e));
        patch(path, (r) => ({ ...r, status: "done", result, runId: result.run_id, dir: result.dir }));
      } catch (e) {
        patch(path, (r) => ({ ...r, status: "failed", error: toAppError(e) }));
      }
    },
    stop: async (path) => {
      patch(path, (r) => (r.status === "running" || r.status === "starting" ? { ...r, status: "stopping" } : r));
      await api.runStop(path);
    },
  };
});

const EMPTY = emptyRun();

/** Состояние прогона проекта (пустое, если прогона не было). */
export const useProjectRun = (path: string): ProjectRun => useRunStore((s) => s.byProject[path] ?? EMPTY);
```

```tsx
import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { trapTab } from "../../lib/focusTrap";

export interface DialogAction { label: string; onClick: () => void; primary?: boolean }

/** Модальный вопрос с одной-двумя кнопками действий и «Отмена»; Esc и клик по фону — отмена, Tab ходит по кругу. */
export function ConfirmDialog({ title, message, actions, onCancel, children }: { title: string; message: string; actions: DialogAction[]; onCancel: () => void; children?: ReactNode }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => root.current?.focus(), []);
  return (
    <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onCancel}>
      <div
        ref={root}
        className="modal"
        role="alertdialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="confirm-title"
        aria-describedby="confirm-message"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Escape") onCancel();
          else if (e.key === "Tab") trapTab(root.current, e);
        }}
      >
        <h3 id="confirm-title">{title}</h3>
        <p id="confirm-message">{message}</p>
        {children}
        <div className="row">
          {actions.map((a) => (
            <button key={a.label} type="button" className={a.primary ? "primary" : undefined} onClick={a.onClick}>
              {a.label}
            </button>
          ))}
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel}>
            {t("common.cancel")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import { isActive, useRunStore } from "../../state/run";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../common/ConfirmDialog";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";

/**
 * Окно закрывают во время прогона (спека L2 §7.1): остановить и закрыть, закрыть (агенты доработают сами, папка
 * достроится при следующем открытии проекта) или отменить. Смонтирован в `Layout`: вкладка прогона может быть закрыта.
 */
export function RunCloseDialog() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const requested = useRunStore((s) => s.closeRequested);
  const byProject = useRunStore((s) => s.byProject);
  const setRequested = useRunStore((s) => s.setCloseRequested);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  if (!requested) return null;
  const running = Object.entries(byProject)
    .filter(([, r]) => isActive(r.status))
    .map(([path]) => path);
  const close = async (stopFirst: boolean) => {
    try {
      if (stopFirst) await Promise.all(running.map((path) => api.runStop(path)));
      await api.confirmClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e);
    }
  };
  return (
    <ConfirmDialog
      title={t("run.close.title")}
      message={t("run.close.message")}
      actions={[
        { label: t("run.close.stop"), onClick: () => void close(true), primary: true },
        { label: t("run.close.leave"), onClick: () => void close(false) },
      ]}
      onCancel={() => {
        setError(null);
        setRequested(false);
      }}
    >
      {error ? <ErrorBanner error={error} /> : null}
    </ConfirmDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { AgentRunState, Environment } from "../../api/types";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";
import { AgentStateBadge } from "../project/EnvironmentAgents";

const LIVE_BADGE: Record<AgentRunState, "ok" | "warn" | "err"> = { ready: "ok", running: "ok", done: "ok", lost: "err", failed: "err" };

/** Агенты стенда: probe при открытии и по кнопке; во время прогона — состояние из событий `agent`. */
export function AgentsStatus({ path, env, live }: { path: string; env: Environment; live: Record<string, AgentRunState> }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const agents = env.agents ?? [];
  const probe = useQuery({ queryKey: ["agentProbe", path, env.id], queryFn: () => api.agentProbe(path, env.id), enabled: agents.length > 0 });
  const statuses = new Map((probe.data ?? []).map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  return (
    <section>
      <div className="row">
        <h4>{t("run.agents")}</h4>
        <button type="button" disabled={agents.length === 0 || probe.isFetching} onClick={() => probe.refetch()}>
          {t("agents.probe")}
        </button>
      </div>
      {agents.length === 0 && <p className="warn">{t("agents.empty")}</p>}
      {probe.error && <ErrorBanner error={probe.error} onRetry={() => probe.refetch()} />}
      <ul className="agent-list">
        {agents.map((a) => {
          const l = live[a.id];
          const s = statuses.get(a.id);
          return (
            <li key={a.id}>
              <code>{a.id}</code> <span className="muted">{a.url} · ×{a.weight}</span>{" "}
              {l ? (
                <span className={`state-badge state-${LIVE_BADGE[l]}`} data-testid="agent-live">
                  {t(`run.agentState.${l}`)}
                </span>
              ) : s ? (
                <AgentStateBadge status={s} />
              ) : probe.isFetching ? (
                <span className="muted">{t("common.loading")}</span>
              ) : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

`src/components/run/RunForm.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { Finding, Mode } from "../../api/types";
import { joinProjectPath } from "../../lib/paths";
import { isActive, useProjectRun, useRunStore } from "../../state/run";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";
import { Hint } from "../common/Hint";
import { NumberInput } from "../common/NumberInput";
import { CheckReport, hasErrors } from "../suites/CheckReport";
import { AgentsStatus } from "./AgentsStatus";

/** Форма прогона: сьют, профиль, стенд, режим, потолок одновременности; «Запустить» сначала выполняет `check`. */
export function RunForm({ path }: { path: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const run = useProjectRun(path);
  const start = useRunStore((s) => s.start);
  const stop = useRunStore((s) => s.stop);
  const reset = useRunStore((s) => s.reset);
  const project = useQuery({ queryKey: ["project", path], queryFn: () => api.projectView(path) });
  const suites = useQuery({ queryKey: ["suites", path], queryFn: () => api.suiteList(path) });
  const profiles = useQuery({ queryKey: ["profile", path], queryFn: () => api.profileGet(path) });
  const [suite, setSuite] = useState("");
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState("");
  const [env, setEnv] = useState("");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("run");
  const [maxInFlight, setMaxInFlight] = useState<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const [findings, setFindings] = useState<Finding[] | null>(null);
  // По умолчанию — первый сьют, профиль и стенд проекта.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!suite && suites.data && suites.data.length > 0) setSuite(suites.data[0].name);
  }, [suites.data, suite]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const names = Object.keys(profiles.data?.profiles ?? {});
    if (!profile && names.length > 0) setProfile(names[0]);
  }, [profiles.data, profile]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const envs = project.data?.manifest.environments ?? [];
    if (!env && envs.length > 0) setEnv(envs[0].id);
  }, [project.data, env]);
  // Цель RPS для графика считает фронтенд по таймлайну и сумме целей профиля.
  const computed = useQuery({ queryKey: ["profileComputed", path, profile], queryFn: () => api.profileCompute(path, profile), enabled: !!profile && mode === "run" });
  const check = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => (await api.suiteCheck(path, suite)).findings,
    onSuccess: setFindings,
  });
  const launch = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const found = (await api.suiteCheck(path, suite)).findings;
      setFindings(found);
      if (hasErrors(found)) return;
      await start(path, { suite, profile, env, mode, maxInFlight: maxInFlight ?? null, timeline: computed.data?.timeline ?? [], total: computed.data?.total ?? 0 });
    },
  });
  const busy = run.status === "failed" && run.error?.code === "RUN_BUSY";
  const stopRun = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      await stop(path);
      // Чужой прогон проекта остановлен — форма снова свободна.
      if (busy) reset(path);
    },
  });
  const openFile = useMutation({ mutationFn: (file: string) => api.openPath(path, joinProjectPath(path, file)) });
  const active = isActive(run.status);
  const blocked = findings !== null && hasErrors(findings);
  const maxInvalid = maxInFlight !== undefined && !(Number.isInteger(maxInFlight) && maxInFlight >= 1);
  const envs = project.data?.manifest.environments ?? [];
  const selectedEnv = envs.find((e) => e.id === env);
  const canStart = !active && !busy && !blocked && !!suite && !!profile && !!env && !maxInvalid && !launch.isPending && (mode === "smoke" || !!computed.data);
  return (
    <section className="form stack run-form">
      <div className="row">
        <label>
          {t("run.suite")}
          <select aria-label={t("run.suite")} value={suite} disabled={active} onChange={(e) => { setSuite(e.target.value); setFindings(null); }}>
            {(suites.data ?? []).map((s) => (
              <option key={s.name} value={s.name}>
                {s.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          {t("run.profile")}
          <select aria-label={t("run.profile")} value={profile} disabled={active} onChange={(e) => setProfile(e.target.value)}>
            {Object.keys(profiles.data?.profiles ?? {}).map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>
                {n}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          {t("run.env")}
          <select aria-label={t("run.env")} value={env} disabled={active} onChange={(e) => setEnv(e.target.value)}>
            {envs.map((e) => (
              <option key={e.id} value={e.id}>
                {e.id}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          {t("run.mode")}
          <select aria-label={t("run.mode")} value={mode} disabled={active} onChange={(e) => setMode(e.target.value as Mode)}>
            <option value="run">{t("run.modes.run")}</option>
            <option value="smoke">{t("run.modes.smoke")}</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          <span className="field-label">
            {t("run.maxInFlight")} <Hint k="hints.run.maxInFlight" label={t("run.maxInFlight")} />
          </span>
          <NumberInput optional aria-label={t("run.maxInFlight")} aria-invalid={maxInvalid || undefined} min={1} step={1} value={maxInFlight} disabled={active} onChange={setMaxInFlight} />
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="row">
        <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={!canStart} onClick={() => launch.mutate()}>
          {t("run.start")}
        </button>
        <button type="button" disabled={!(active || busy) || stopRun.isPending || run.status === "stopping"} onClick={() => stopRun.mutate()}>
          {t("run.stop")}
        </button>
        {blocked && (
          <button type="button" disabled={check.isPending} onClick={() => check.mutate()}>
            {t("run.recheck")}
          </button>
        )}
        <span className="muted">{t(`run.status.${run.status}`)}</span>
      </div>
      {busy && (
        <p className="warn" role="status">
          {t("run.busy")}
        </p>
      )}
      {blocked && <p className="warn">{t("run.checkFailed")}</p>}
      {findings && findings.length > 0 && <CheckReport findings={findings} onOpen={(file) => openFile.mutate(file)} />}
      {run.error && !busy && <ErrorBanner error={run.error} />}
      {launch.error && <ErrorBanner error={launch.error} />}
      {check.error && <ErrorBanner error={check.error} />}
      {stopRun.error && <ErrorBanner error={stopRun.error} />}
      {openFile.error && <ErrorBanner error={openFile.error} />}
      {suites.error && <ErrorBanner error={suites.error} onRetry={() => suites.refetch()} />}
      {profiles.error && <ErrorBanner error={profiles.error} onRetry={() => profiles.refetch()} />}
      {project.error && <ErrorBanner error={project.error} onRetry={() => project.refetch()} />}
      {mode === "run" && computed.error && <ErrorBanner error={computed.error} onRetry={() => computed.refetch()} />}
      {selectedEnv && <AgentsStatus path={path} env={selectedEnv} live={run.agents} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

export type SortDir = "asc" | "desc";
export interface Sort<T> { key: keyof T; dir: SortDir }

/** Клик по той же колонке меняет направление, по другой — сортирует по ней по возрастанию. */
export function toggleSort<T>(s: Sort<T>, key: keyof T): Sort<T> {
  return s.key === key ? { key, dir: s.dir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc" } : { key, dir: "asc" };
}

/** Копия строк, отсортированная по колонке: числа как числа, строки по локали, null всегда в конце. */
export function sortRows<T>(rows: T[], s: Sort<T>): T[] {
  const sign = s.dir === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
  return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const x = a[s.key];
    const y = b[s.key];
    if (x === y) return 0;
    if (x == null) return 1;
    if (y == null) return -1;
    return (typeof x === "number" && typeof y === "number" ? x - y : String(x).localeCompare(String(y))) * sign;
  });
}

/** Заголовок колонки с сортировкой по клику и `aria-sort`. */
export function SortTh<T>({ sort, column, label, onChange }: { sort: Sort<T>; column: keyof T; label: string; onChange: (s: Sort<T>) => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const active = sort.key === column;
  return (
    <th aria-sort={active ? (sort.dir === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending") : undefined}>
      <button type="button" className="link sort" aria-label={t("run.sort", { column: label })} onClick={() => onChange(toggleSort(sort, column))}>
        {label}
        {active ? (sort.dir === "asc" ? " ▲" : " ▼") : ""}
      </button>
    </th>
  );
}
```

`src/components/run/SummaryTable.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { AgentSummary, OpSummary } from "../../api/types";
import { formatNumber } from "../../lib/format";
import { joinProjectPath } from "../../lib/paths";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";
import { type Sort, sortRows, SortTh } from "./sorting";

const COLUMNS: { key: keyof OpSummary; label: string; digits: number }[] = [
  { key: "n", label: "requests", digits: 0 },
  { key: "rpsAvg", label: "rpsAvg", digits: 1 },
  { key: "rpsPeak", label: "rpsPeak", digits: 1 },
  { key: "errPct", label: "errPct", digits: 2 },
  { key: "dropped", label: "dropped", digits: 0 },
  { key: "p50", label: "p50", digits: 1 },
  { key: "p95", label: "p95", digits: 1 },
  { key: "p99", label: "p99", digits: 1 },
  { key: "max", label: "max", digits: 1 },
  { key: "target", label: "target", digits: 1 },
  { key: "achievedPct", label: "achieved", digits: 1 },
];

/** Итог прогона (`summary.yaml`) по операциям с сортировкой по колонкам и «Открыть папку». */
export function SummaryTable({ summary, path, dir }: { summary: AgentSummary; path: string; dir: string | null }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<Sort<OpSummary>>({ key: "id", dir: "asc" });
  const rows = useMemo(() => sortRows(summary.ops, sort), [summary, sort]);
  const openFolder = useMutation({ mutationFn: (d: string) => api.openPath(path, joinProjectPath(path, d)) });
  return (
    <section>
      <div className="row">
        <h4>{t("run.summary.title")}</h4>
        <span className="muted">
          {t(`run.runStatus.${summary.status}`)} · {t("run.summary.seconds", { seconds: summary.seconds })}
        </span>
        {dir && (
          <button type="button" disabled={openFolder.isPending} onClick={() => openFolder.mutate(dir)}>
            {t("run.summary.openFolder")}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {openFolder.error && <ErrorBanner error={openFolder.error} />}
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <SortTh sort={sort} column="id" label={t("run.ops.operation")} onChange={setSort} />
            {COLUMNS.map((c) => (
              <SortTh key={String(c.key)} sort={sort} column={c.key} label={t(`run.summary.${c.label}`)} onChange={setSort} />
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.id}>
              <td>
                <code>{r.id}</code>
              </td>
              {COLUMNS.map((c) => {
                const v = r[c.key];
                return (
                  <td key={String(c.key)} className={c.key === "errPct" && r.errPct > 0 ? "warn" : undefined}>
                    {typeof v === "number" ? formatNumber(v, c.digits) : "—"}
                  </td>
                );
              })}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { SmokeReport } from "../../api/types";
import { ErrorBanner } from "../common/ErrorBanner";
import { SummaryTable } from "./SummaryTable";

const when = (iso: string): string => iso.slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ");

/** `smoke.yaml` таблицей: сценарий → шаг → ок или код и причина. */
export function SmokeReportTable({ report }: { report: SmokeReport }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <section>
      <h4>{t("run.smoke.title")}</h4>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>{t("run.smoke.scenario")}</th>
            <th>{t("run.smoke.step")}</th>
            <th>{t("run.smoke.operation")}</th>
            <th>{t("run.smoke.result")}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {report.scenarios.flatMap((s) =>
            s.steps.map((step) => (
              <tr key={`${s.id}/${step.id}`}>
                <td>{s.id}</td>
                <td>{step.id}</td>
                <td>
                  <code>{step.operation}</code>
                </td>
                <td className={step.ok ? undefined : "warn"}>{step.ok ? t("run.smoke.ok") : `${step.code ?? ""}: ${step.message ?? ""}`}</td>
              </tr>
            )),
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Папки `runs/` с датой, сьютом, профилем и статусом; выбор показывает `summary.yaml` или `smoke.yaml`. */
export function PastRuns({ path }: { path: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const runs = useQuery({ queryKey: ["runs", path], queryFn: () => api.runList(path) });
  const [dir, setDir] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const details = useQuery({ queryKey: ["run", path, dir], queryFn: () => api.runGet(path, dir!), enabled: !!dir });
  return (
    <section>
      <h3>{t("run.past.title")}</h3>
      {runs.error && <ErrorBanner error={runs.error} onRetry={() => runs.refetch()} />}
      {runs.data?.length === 0 && <p className="muted">{t("run.past.empty")}</p>}
      {runs.data && runs.data.length > 0 && (
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>{t("run.past.started")}</th>
              <th>{t("run.past.suite")}</th>
              <th>{t("run.past.profile")}</th>
              <th>{t("run.past.env")}</th>
              <th>{t("run.past.mode")}</th>
              <th>{t("run.past.status")}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {runs.data.map((m) => {
              // Папка прогона приходит из `run_list` (`dir`), фронтенд её не вычисляет.
              const d = m.dir;
              return (
                <tr key={d} className={d === dir ? "selected" : undefined}>
                  <td>
                    <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => setDir(d)}>
                      {when(m.started_at)}
                    </button>
                  </td>
                  <td>{m.suite}</td>
                  <td>{m.profile}</td>
                  <td>{m.env}</td>
                  <td>{t(`run.modes.${m.mode}`)}</td>
                  <td>{m.status ? t(`run.runStatus.${m.status}`) : <span className="warn">{t("run.past.inProgress")}</span>}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      {dir && details.error && <ErrorBanner error={details.error} onRetry={() => details.refetch()} />}
      {dir && details.data?.summary && <SummaryTable summary={details.data.summary} path={path} dir={dir} />}
      {dir && details.data?.smoke && <SmokeReportTable report={details.data.smoke} />}
      {dir && details.data && !details.data.summary && !details.data.smoke && <p className="muted">{t("run.past.noDetails")}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}
```
